title: GTM Systems Administrator
description:
Designation: GTM Systems Administrator Experience (years) : 3-5+ years of relevant experience Work Timings: 7pm to 4am IST Location: Remote 
 Mandatory skills: 36 years of experience in GTM systems or a related technical role. Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201) certification is mandatory. Hands-on experience with GTM technology stacks, particularly Clay and ZoomInfo . Strong experience in GTM administration , including user and security management, platform configuration, access controls, and system administration. Experience in Salesforce and GTM automation/development . Experience integrating Salesforce with GTM systems , particularly Clay and ZoomInfo. Experience working with DevOps teams on integrations, automation, deployments, and technical troubleshooting. Experience with AI and Agentic AI operations , including exposure to AI Agentic OS . Strong understanding of system and API-based integrations across Salesforce and other GTM platforms. 
 What You Will Do: User & Security Management: You will manage user accounts and access, including new user setup and deactivation, license allocation, roles, profiles, permission sets, public groups, and organization-wide defaults (OWD)/sharing rule. Youll conduct regular security audits and implement access controls to keep our data safe. Platform Configuration: You will design and configure Salesforce features, creating and updating custom objects, fields, record types, page layouts, and validation rules to meet evolving business needs. Automation & Development: You will build and maintain automations using Lightning Flow (Flow Builder) and other declarative tools (Process Builder, Workflow), and work with external development teams to define Apex triggers or Lightning Web Components as needed for advanced requirements. AI & Agentic Operations: You will help design, build, and maintain the AI agents and agentic workflows that run inside our GTM stack, contributing to Leah Agentic OS and connecting agents to Salesforce and other systems through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). You will spot where an agent can take over repetitive enrichment, routing, or reporting work, then build and ship it. Building with AI: You will use AI tools such as Claude and Claude Code to build, test, and troubleshoot Salesforce automations and integrations faster, and help the wider RevOps team adopt these tools in their daily work. Integrations: You will manage integrations between Salesforce and other Go-To-Market systems (for example, 6Sense, ZoomInfo, Clay, and/or Customer Service platform), using APIs, MCPs, or middleware tools (like MuleSoft) to ensure data flows smoothly across systems. Data Quality & Reporting: You will maintain data integrity by using tools like Data Loader and Workbench to import/export data and implement validation rules. Youll also create and maintain reports and dashboards the business can act on. Release Management & Governance: You will coordinate release cycles, managing sandboxes, version control, change sets or CI/CD pipelines, and ensure that seasonal Salesforce releases and patches are tested and adopted successfully. You will document changes and enforce best practice governance for customizations. Clay Management: You will manage Clay workspaces, including setting up and optimizing enrichment workflows, configuring automations, maintaining data syncs to Salesforce, and monitoring pipeline jobs to ensure accurate and timely GTM data enrichment. Clay Data Governance: You will define and maintain data-matching rules, deduplication logic, and field mapping standards to ensure Clay-generated data aligns with Salesforce data structures and RevOps governance. Clay Operational Support: You will troubleshoot Clay automation errors, manage task queues, update recipes based on new GTM requirements, and partner with Marketing/Sales to scale outbound list generation. ZoomInfo Administration: You will manage ZoomInfo user accounts, role access, API usage, and configuration settings to support Sales and Marketing prospecting workflows. ZoomInfo Salesforce Sync: You will oversee enrichment and data-push rules, monitor sync logs, and optimize filters to ensure accurate account, contact, and intent data flows into Salesforce. ZoomInfo Data Quality: You will maintain data hygiene by auditing enrichment accuracy, adjusting update rules (overwrite, fill-in, append), and partnering with Sales to refine territory and lead routing strategies informed by ZoomInfo datasets. Partner Portal: You will assist in building a Partner Portal using Salesforce Experience Cloud, supporting access, workflows, and content for partners. User Support & Training: You will provide user support and training, resolving support tickets, creating documentation, and educating users on new features and best practices. Youll promote user adoption through clear communication and training materials. What You Will Need: Salesforce Experience: You have 3 to 5+ years of Salesforce administration experience, especially working with Sales Cloud (leads, opportunities, forecasts). You understand how to take projects from vision to reality and have a track record of improving Salesforce to support business growth. Certifications: You hold the Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM 201) credential (required) and preferably the Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist (CPQ Administrator) credential. Additional certifications (e.g. Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer, or Architect certifications) are a strong plus. Technical Skills: You are proficient with Salesforce admin tools (Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, Workbench) and data analytics (Salesforce Reports/Dashboards, Excel, Tableau CRM). You have expertise in Flow Builder and declarative automation, and familiarity with basic Apex code and integrations. Experience with version control and DevOps tools (Git, CI/CD pipelines) is a plus. Industry/Environment Fit: You have a growth mindset and curiosity for Salesforce innovations (Lightning Experience, AI features). You work well in agile teams and enjoy collaborating with

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description:
Welcome to Frontline Managed Services where innovation, technology, and efficiency converge to redefine the landscape of IT, Financial, and Administrative Managed Services for legal and professional service firms. As pioneers in the industry, we are driven by a relentless commitment to excellence. 
 Join Our Team and Be a Catalyst for Change! We don't just follow industry standards; we set them. Our dynamic environment thrives on pushing boundaries and embracing challenges. We are more than a workplace; we are a community of forward-thinkers dedicated to shaping the future. 
 Position Overview The Senior FP&A Analyst is responsible for supporting the company's financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and strategic decision-making processes. This role requires advanced financial modeling skills, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to translate financial data into actionable business insights. The analyst will partner with leaders across Finance and business functions to improve financial performance, support growth initiatives, and drive data-driven decisions. 
 Key Responsibilities Financial Planning & Analysis Develop and maintain annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-range financial plans. Perform monthly financial analysis, including variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior year. Prepare executive-level financial reports, dashboards, and presentations for senior leadership. Monitor key financial and operational performance indicators and recommend improvement opportunities. Financial Modeling Build and maintain sophisticated financial models supporting revenue, profitability, cash flow, headcount, and strategic initiatives. Develop scenario analyses, sensitivity analyses, and what-if models to evaluate business decisions. Support pricing analyses, investment decisions, capital allocation, and business case development. Create models to evaluate acquisitions, new service offerings, and strategic investments as needed. Business Partnership Partner with business leaders to understand operational drivers and financial impacts. Provide analytical support for strategic initiatives and operational improvement projects. Assist department leaders in managing budgets and identifying opportunities to improve financial performance. Reporting & Analytics Produce monthly management reporting packages and KPI dashboards. Analyze trends in revenue, margins, operating expenses, and cash flow. Develop automated reporting solutions using Excel, Power BI, or similar tools. Ensure data integrity across financial systems and reporting platforms. Process Improvement Improve budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes through automation and standardization. Support implementation and enhancement of FP&A tools and financial systems. Identify opportunities to streamline reporting and improve analytical capabilities. AI-Enabled ways of working Actively use AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate modelling, variance analysis, deck creation and reporting workflows Identify and pilot opportunities to automate manual FP&A process (data pulls, recurring reports, first-draft commentary) using AI and scripting. Bring an experimenters mindset- comfortable evaluating new tools and pushing the team towards modern, efficient workflows rather than legacy spreadsheet grind. 
 Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field. Minimum 6 years of experience in Corporate FP&A, Financial Analysis, or Corporate Finance. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, and financial modeling. Experience building integrated three-statement financial models. Proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, Oracle, NetSuite, SAP, or similar ERP/FP&A systems. Strong understanding of financial statements and corporate finance principles. Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present financial information to non-financial stakeholders. 
 Preferred Qualifications CA, MBA, CFA, or CPA is a plus. Experience in technology, SaaS, managed services, or professional services industries. Experience with SQL or Python for financial analytics is preferred. Experience supporting private equity-backed organizations is a plus. 
 Key Competencies Advanced financial modeling and valuation Forecasting and budgeting Business and financial analysis Strategic thinking Executive Communication and presentation skills Attention to detail and accuracy Data visualization and dashboard development Process improvement mindset Collaboration and business partnership 
 Not Sure You Meet Every Requirement? We know that great candidates may not match every qualification listed. If youre excited about the role and believe you could be a strong fit, we encourage you to apply. We value potential and a growth mindset as much as experience. 
 Join Us At Frontline Managed Services, we celebrate different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are committed to building a team that reflects the clients and communities we serve. 
 We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.”

 Role Overview 
 We are looking for a proactive and organised Junior Client Servicing professional to join Wockhardts internal agency team. The role will be responsible for coordinating with internal stakeholders and creative teams to ensure marketing and communication requirements are clearly understood, effectively executed, and delivered on time. The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in advertising, communication, and brand building, along with excellent coordination and interpersonal skills. This role is suited to someone who enjoys working with multiple stakeholders, managing timelines, and taking ownership of projects from brief to delivery. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Act as the day-to-day point of contact between internal Wockhardt stakeholders and the agency/creative team. Understand client briefs, clarify requirements, and translate them into clear creative briefs for the relevant teams. Coordinate with copywriters, designers, strategists, digital teams, and other agency functions to move projects forward. Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring timelines and deliverables are tracked. Prepare project briefs, timelines, status updates, meeting notes, and follow-up actions. Coordinate feedback and approvals between stakeholders and creative teams. Ensure all communication and creative outputs are aligned with the agreed brief, brand guidelines, and business requirements. Proactively follow up on pending inputs, feedback, approvals, and deliverables. Participate in client meetings and internal discussions and capture actionable next steps. Build strong working relationships with marketing, brand, medical, sales, and other internal teams. Support the team in presentations, campaign development, brand communication, digital assets, events, and other marketing initiatives. Maintain organised records of project briefs, artwork versions, approvals, and final deliverables. Flag potential delays, scope changes, or execution challenges to the Account Manager/Client Servicing Lead at an early stage. 
 Skills & Competencies 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills. Excellent coordination and follow-up abilities. Good organisational and time-management skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities. Attention to detail. Ability to understand a brief and communicate it clearly to creative teams. Comfortable working with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders. Good presentation and interpersonal skills. Basic understanding of advertising, branding, social media, and marketing communication. Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and Excel; familiarity with Google Workspace is an advantage. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet tight deadlines. A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a willingness to learn. 
 Qualification 
 Bachelors degree in Marketing, Advertising, Mass Communication, Business Administration, or a related field. 02 years of experience in client servicing, account management, advertising, marketing, or a creative agency environment. Freshers with relevant internships and strong communication/coordination skills may also be considered. 
 Preferred Attributes 
 Prior exposure to pharma, healthcare, FMCG, or other regulated industries is a plus. Interest in creative communication and advertising. Comfortable working with creative professionals and business stakeholders. High ownership and accountability. Curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. Ability to balance being client-focused with protecting the quality and feasibility of creative execution. title: Data Engineer
description:
Overview 
Under the mission of "Money Forward. Move your life forward," Money Forward aims to resolve the financial concerns and anxieties of individuals and businesses through the power of technology.
We have partnered with Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Inc. and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation to establish a new company in preparation for the launch of a new digital bank.
We are currently seeking candidates for the position of Data Engineer as part of this initiative.
*Based on the press release announced on April 16, 2025.

 This position involves employment with Money Forward, Inc., and a secondment to the new company (SMBC Money Forward Bank Preparatory Corporation). The evaluation system and employee benefits will follow the policies of Money Forward, Inc.

 Responsibilities and Duties 
As a Mid-level Data Engineer in the MIDAS (Management Integration & Data Analytics System) Data Platform Team, you will build from scratch and maintain the central data hub connecting most systems within one of Japan's more innovative digital banks. You will work with modern cloud-based data technologies to ingest data from various banking systems, apply complex business logic, and serve it to downstream systems for enterprise management, regulatory reporting, risk management, and many other applications. Due to the high expectations in the banking domain, you will face complex data engineering challenges including data quality, reconciliation across systems, time-critical data processing, and complete traceability. title: Senior Project Engineer Civil
description:
SENIOR CIVIL ENGINEER 
 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 Project: Premium High-Rise Residential Development 7 Towers / 196 Apartments
 Apartment Configuration: Large 4 & 5 Bedroom Residences
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Experience Required: 8 - 12+ Years
 Industry: Real Estate / High-Rise Residential Construction 

 ROLE OVERVIEW 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Civil Engineer to manage and supervise civil construction activities for a premium high-rise residential development comprising 7 towers and 196 large 4 and 5 bedroom apartments in Ahmedabad . 
 The candidate will be responsible for day-to-day execution, quality, progress, contractor coordination and technical supervision of assigned towers/areas from structural works through finishing and handover. This is a site-based role requiring strong practical construction knowledge and the ability to independently identify and resolve execution issues. 

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Civil & Structural Execution Supervise RCC works including foundations, columns, shear walls, beams, slabs, staircases and other structural elements. Verify reinforcement, shuttering/formwork, levels, dimensions, line and alignment before concreting. Coordinate concrete pours and ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications and quality requirements. Monitor masonry, plastering, waterproofing, screeding and other civil works. Ensure construction is carried out strictly as per approved structural and architectural drawings. 
 2. Finishing Works Supervise and control finishing activities including: Flooring and stone works Internal and external plaster Waterproofing False ceiling coordination Doors and windows Painting Bathrooms and wet areas Balconies and terraces Faade-related civil interfaces Common areas, lobbies and staircases Maintain high finishing standards appropriate for a premium residential project. 
 3. Site & Contractor Management Manage and coordinate civil contractors, subcontractors and site supervisors. Allocate work fronts and ensure adequate manpower, machinery and materials are available. Monitor contractor productivity and identify delays or underperformance. Conduct daily site inspections and progress reviews. Ensure contractors rectify defective or incomplete work promptly. Verify contractor measurements and quantities before certification. 
 4. Drawing & Technical Coordination Review architectural, structural and relevant MEP drawings before execution. Identify drawing discrepancies and constructability issues before work begins. Raise RFIs and coordinate resolutions with architects, structural consultants and other consultants. Ensure only the latest approved drawings are being used at site. Coordinate civil openings, shafts, sleeves, embeds and other MEP requirements before concreting or finishing. 
 5. Quality Control Ensure all work complies with approved drawings, specifications, IS codes and project quality standards. Carry out pre-pour inspections and construction checklists. Monitor concrete quality, cube testing and other required material tests. Inspect reinforcement, shuttering, waterproofing, masonry and finishing works. Maintain inspection and quality records. Identify defective workmanship and ensure corrective action before subsequent work proceeds. Minimise rework through proper supervision and planning. 
 6. Planning & Progress Monitoring Work with the Project Manager and planning team to achieve project milestones. Prepare short-term execution plans and weekly work targets. Monitor actual progress against planned progress. Identify potential delays in advance and recommend corrective actions. Coordinate upcoming material, manpower, drawing and equipment requirements. Maintain daily and weekly progress records. 
 7. Material Management Estimate short-term material requirements based on planned activities. Coordinate with procurement and stores to ensure uninterrupted availability. Check incoming materials against approved specifications. Monitor consumption and minimise material wastage. Report abnormal consumption, shortages or misuse. 
 8. MEP & INTERDISCIPLINARY COORDINATION Coordinate closely with electrical, plumbing, fire-fighting, HVAC, lift and other specialist teams to ensure: Required openings and sleeves are provided correctly. Civil and MEP activities are properly sequenced. Services do not conflict with structural or architectural elements. Finished civil work is not unnecessarily damaged for subsequent MEP installation. 
 9. Safety & Site Discipline Ensure contractors follow project safety requirements. Coordinate with the safety team before high-risk activities. Maintain proper housekeeping and safe access throughout assigned areas. Stop or escalate unsafe construction practices when required. 
 10. SNAGGING & HANDOVER Conduct internal inspections before consultant/client inspections. Prepare and close snag lists. Ensure apartments and common areas meet required finishing standards before handover. Coordinate rectification of defects. Assist with as-built documentation and final handover. 

 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 
 812+ years of civil construction experience , preferably with significant experience in high-rise residential projects. Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering. Strong hands-on experience in RCC structure and residential finishing works . Experience independently handling at least one high-rise tower or substantial project zone is strongly preferred. Good understanding of construction drawings, specifications and IS codes. Experience coordinating architects, structural consultants, MEP teams and contractors. Ability to check quantities and contractor measurements. Strong understanding of construction sequencing and site logistics. 

 REQUIRED SKILLS 
 The candidate should demonstrate: Strong technical knowledge Excellent site execution capability High attention to quality and finishing Contractor management skills Problem-solving ability Ability to read and coordinate drawings Planning and organisational ability Strong communication and reporting Ability to work under schedule pressure Ownership and accountability 

 REPORTING STRUCTURE 
 Reports To: Project Manager / Construction Manager / Project Head Coordinates With: Architects, Structural Consultants, MEP Consultants, Planning Team, QA/QC, Safety Team, Procurement, Stores, Quantity Surveyors and Contractors. 

 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS 
 Performance will primarily be measured on: Quality of Work | Schedule Achievement | Rework Control | Contractor Productivity | Material Wastage | Snag Closure | Safety Compliance | Handover Readiness 

 IDEAL CANDIDATE 
 We are looking for someone who is site-oriented rather than purely office-oriented . The ideal candidate should be capable of walking onto a tower, understanding the current construction status, identifying technical or quality issues, coordinating the required teams and driving the work to completion without requiring constant supervision. Previous experience delivering premium or luxury high-rise residential projects from RCC through finishing and handover will be given preference.

Key Skills: High Rise Building,Construction Management,Civil Construction,Civil Project Management,Civil Engineering,Building Construction,Civil,Project engineering

Understanding of applicable pipe sizing, fitting selection, valve selection and piping support requirements.

Ensure all designs comply with applicable structural steel standards, regional building codes, and internal QA requirements. Prepare technical documentation design calculation reports, structural drawings, specification sheets for client and internal review. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve structural design issues during execution. Participate in design reviews, root-cause investigations for structural failures/non-conformances, and continuous improvement of design standards Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering / Structural Engineering / Mechanical Engineering Masters degree preferably ME/MS in Structural Engineering 8 to 10 Yrs of experience in Structural design for HVAC equipment. Soft Tools: Highly proficient in STAAD.Pro RISA-3D RISAConnection IDEA StatiCa

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to drive system reliability, scalability, and operational excellence across our production environments. This is a hands-on, high-impact Individual Contributor role where you will: Own production reliability and availability Define and enforce SRE practices and standards Lead incident response and operational excellence Coach and guide engineers on building reliable systems You will play a critical role in ensuring systems are measurable, observable, resilient, and scalable. Core SRE Responsibilities Reliability Engineering & System Health Ensure high availability, reliability, and fault tolerance of distributed systems. Define and implement: Service Level Indicators (SLIs) Service Level Objectives (SLOs) Error Budgets Continuously improve system reliability using data-driven approaches. Track and improve key reliability metrics: Availability Error rates Latency Observability, Monitoring & APM Build and maintain end-to-end observability systems: Metrics Logs Distributed tracing Implement effective: Monitoring Alerting (low noise, high signal) Use APM tools to track: Latency Error rates Service dependencies Scalability & Performance Engineering Ensure systems scale efficiently under load. Perform: Capacity planning Load testing & performance tuning Optimize for: Latency Throughput Resource utilization Automation & Toil Reduction Identify and eliminate manual, repetitive operational tasks (toil). Build automation for: Incident response Remediation workflows System recovery Improve engineering productivity through self-healing systems. Security & Reliability Integration Ensure systems follow secure-by-design principles. Integrate reliability with: Security controls Compliance requirements Partner with security teams on incident handling and risk mitigation. Coaching & Technical Leadership Mentor engineers on: SRE principles Production readiness Reliability engineering Drive adoption of SRE best practices across teams. Influence architecture for resilient system design. Operational Excellence & Incident Management Own and lead production incident management (L2/L3 support). Act as Incident Commander during critical outages. Drive blameless postmortems (RCA) and ensure action closure. Improve: Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) Mean Time to Recover (MTTR) Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) Establish strong on-call practices, runbooks, and escalation mechanisms. Key Reliability Metrics (Must Have Experience) Candidates must have hands-on experience defining, measuring, and improving: Availability (%) Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) Mean Time to Failure (MTTF) Error Rates / Failure Rates SLO Compliance Error Budget Management Customer Impact Metrics (user-facing reliability) CI/CD & Automated Testing Ensure reliable and safe deployments through: Automated testing (unit, integration, reliability testing) Automated deployment pipelines Improve deployment success rate and rollback mechanisms. Support progressive delivery (canary, blue/green deployments). Disaster Recovery & Resilience Design and validate Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies. Define and test: RTO (Recovery Time Objective) RPO (Recovery Point Objective) Conduct failure testing / chaos engineering where applicable. Required Qualifications 510 years of experience, with minimum 3+ years in a dedicated SRE role Strong experience in: Production systems ownership Incident management & on-call Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Hands-on experience with: Reliability metrics (SLO/SLI/Error Budgets) Observability & monitoring systems Performance and scalability engineering Strong experience with: AWS cloud Kubernetes (EKS) in production DevOps and Platform Engineering Proficiency in one programming language (Go, Python, Java) Proven ability to handle and resolve high-severity production incidents 
 Preferred candidate profile Experience in chaos engineering / resilience testing Strong background in APM tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.) Experience defining organization-wide SRE practices Experience mentoring engineers and leading reliability initiatives Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for engineers who: Have owned production systems end-to-end Have led incidents and handled outages Have defined and worked with SLOs and error budgets Think in terms of system reliability, not just infrastructure

In this role, you will own features end to end — from responsive user interfaces through APIs, data, and background processing — for high-availability web applications used by healthcare practices. You will collaborate closely with product and design to ship modular, accessible, and reliable experiences across the stack. We want someone who is strong in React / TypeScript and C# / .NET, comfortable in a multi-tenant SaaS environment, and keen on spec-driven development and AI-augmented SDLC practices to raise quality and delivery speed. 
 Key Responsibilities • Feature development: Design and ship end-to-end features in React, TypeScript, and ASP.NET Core — UI, API contracts, persistence, and async workflows. • Architecture & contracts: Keep frontend and backend aligned on a single contract (auth, pagination, error handling). Contribute to evolving a large existing codebase without breaking public APIs or tenant boundaries. • Payments & integrations: Build checkout and saved-card experiences using hosted payment fields (card data never touches our servers), and implement idempotent server-side handling of provider webhooks and retries. • Security & tenancy: Enforce authentication/authorization on both the SPA and the API. Scope data by tenant in the URL and in queries;  • Observability: Instrument client and server with structured logs, metrics, and distributed traces. Define SLIs/SLOs (latency, error rate, saturation), use dashboards and alerts to find regressions, and drive issues to root cause rather than restart-and-hope. • Performance & scaling: Profile and tune hot paths — query plans, N+1 access, payload size, bundle/cache strategy, p95/p99 API and page latency. Plan for horizontal scale (stateless APIs, connection pooling, queue- backed work, pagination) and load/capacity characteristics of multi-tenant traffic. • Quality: Write automated tests on both stacks and participate in code review with focused, maintainable diffs. • AI-augmented workflows: Work spec-first (requirements and design before implementation). Use AI coding assistants to draft, then own correctness, security, and production behaviour. Required Skills & Qualifications • Experience: 4+ years building production web products, with recent, substantial time in both a React frontend and a typed backend. • Frontend: Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, and JavaScript (ES6+); comfortable with authenticated SPAs, forms, routing, and responsive layouts. • Backend: Strong C# / .NET (or equivalent, with ability to ramp quickly): REST APIs, async programming, and dependency injection. • Data: Hands-on PostgreSQL (or equivalent) at the query level — joins, transactions, and safe concurrent writes. • Full-stack ownership: You regularly ship features across UI, API, and data • Tooling: Proficient with Git, CI/CD, and writing clean, reviewable code on both sides of the stack. 
 • Problem solving: Strong debugging across browser, API, and database; experience with multi-tenant or high- sensitivity data (access control, least privilege, no secrets in source). • Cloud & Infrastructure: Familiarity with containerization (Docker), cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent), and CI/CD pipelines. Company Profile - 
 Healthedge is an agile and innovative 21st century software company focused on providing 
 next-generation, business-transforming technology products to the healthcare payer market. 
 We enable our customers to radically innovate, drastically reduce costs, and efficiently address 
 the business imperatives of the evolving healthcare economy. Healthedge is headquartered in 
 Burlington, MA (USA) with development offices in Hyderabad (India), Bangalore (India), Pune 
 (India) and Powell, OH (USA). 
 Healthedge has been listed as a sample vendor for Next-Generation Core Administrative 
 Systems in Gartners 2017 hype cycle for U.S. healthcare payers. 
 Additionally, Healthedge is a proud winner of 3 awards from Comparably : Best Company Work
 Life Balance, Happiest Employees of 2024, and Best Company Perks & Benefits! These awards only 
 reinforces what we’ve known all along: the best and brightest work at Healthedge. 
 Designation: Senior Software Engineer 
 Location: Hyderabad 
 About the Role : 
 We are seeking a seasoned Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and scale next
 generation healthcare technology solutions that improve patient outcomes, streamline clinical 
 workflows, and drive operational efficiency across health systems. The ideal candidate will 
 bring deep expertise in the .NET ecosystem, a passion for engineering excellence, and a proven 
 track record of delivering high-impact, production-grade systems in complex, regulated 
 domains. 
 This role sits at the intersection of technology, healthcare, and innovation — offering the 
 opportunity to architect and shape products that serve millions of patients and truly make a 
 difference. If you thrive on solving hard problems at scale, care deeply about code quality and 
 system resilience, and want your engineering work to have real-world impact beyond business 
 metrics — we'd love to hear from you. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Design, develop, and deliver production-grade software as per defined requirements 
 and technical specifications, ensuring adherence to healthcare domain standards and 
 compliance frameworks. 
 • Build and maintain user interfaces, databases, APIs, and client-facing displays across our 
 healthcare platform, ensuring seamless end-to-end user experiences for our end users. 
 • Initiate and drive technical design — architect complex application features, evaluate 
 design trade-offs, and make sound decisions that balance delivery speed with long-term 
 system maintainability. 
 • Produce well-organized, optimized, and thoroughly documented source code in line 
 with established coding guidelines and best practices, maintaining a high bar for 
 readability and consistency. 
 • Debug, troubleshoot, and refine existing source code — identify root causes efficiently, 
 polish feature sets, and improve system performance and reliability with every release 
 cycle. 
 • Contribute to technical design documentation — author and maintain architecture 
 decision records (ADRs), design specs, and runbooks that enable the team to move fast 
 without breaking things. 
 • Build and execute comprehensive unit and integration test cases to ensure code quality, 
 reduce regression risk, and maintain confidence in every deployment. 
 • Test features in controlled, real-world scenarios before go-live — participate in staging 
 validations, UAT coordination, and production rollout monitoring to ensure zero
 disruption releases. 
 • Innovate and develop high-value technology solutions that streamline clinical 
 workflows, reduce manual overhead, and unlock new capabilities for healthcare 
 providers and patients. 
 • Coordinate with fellow engineers and cross-functional teams — collaborate closely with 
 product managers, clinicians, QA, DevOps, data science, and compliance teams to 
 deliver cohesive, high-quality solutions. 
 • Work independently when required — take ownership of ambiguous problems, drive 
 them to resolution with minimal handholding, and communicate progress proactively 
 to stakeholders. 
 • Maintain meticulous attention to detail — every task, from code reviews to 
 documentation to production deployments, must be carried out to the highest standard 
 of quality and precision. 
 Qualifications & Experience: 
 • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field. 
 • 5+ years of total software development experience. 
 • Proven experience building and delivering complex, scalable software systems — 
 preferably in the healthcare domain. 
 • Strong programming expertise in C# and the .NET framework. 
 • Working experience in MVC architecture is a must. 
 • Hands on experience with Design patterns and Entity frameworks is a must. 
 • Strong hands-on experience with Relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or 
 MySQL), Expert-level knowledge of SQL queries including stored procedures, functions 
 and views. 
 • Experience with UI frameworks such as Angular or React (added advantage). Working 
 experience on client-side technologies such as JavaScript, jQuery is required. 
 • Demonstrated proficiency in automation testing and adherence to Test-Driven 
 Development (TDD) principles. 
 • Solid experience in CI/CD pipeline design and implementation, with exposure to 
 automation tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions). 
 • Familiarity with cloud environments (Azure or AWS) and containerization (Docker, 
 Kubernetes) is preferred. 
 • Ability to work independently and in small teams, adaptability to a fast-paced 
 environment and a keen interest in staying current with the latest trends. 
 • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills. 
 Why Join Us: 
 • Be part of a mission-driven organization revolutionizing healthcare delivery through 
 technology. 
 • Collaborate with product, clinical, and data teams solving real-world healthcare 
 challenges. 
 • Work with a technically strong team that values innovation, integrity, and impact. 
 • Competitive compensation, flexible work arrangements, and significant career growth 
 opportunities.

title: Embedded Test & Systems Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking an Embedded Test & Systems Software Engineer to join our hardware-software integration team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between firmware development and system-level validation. You will build robust Python-based test automation frameworks, interface directly with hardware peripherals and communication protocols, and contribute directly to embedded C software development when required. 
 Core Responsibilities Test Automation & Frameworks: Design, develop, and maintain automated regression test suites using Python (pytest or Robot Framework) integrated into CI/CD pipelines. Firmware & C Development: Read, debug, and contribute to low-level embedded C code, drivers, and system services during feature development and hardware bring-up. Protocol & Hardware Validation: Perform functional and system-level validation for protocols including CAN/CAN-FD, $\text{I}^2\text{C}$, PMBus, SPI, and UART . System Management & Security: Validate RESTful Redfish APIs via Postman/curl and execute validation suites for Secure Boot sequences. Linux System Debugging: Configure embedded Linux environments ( Yocto Project ), manage Systemd services, and analyze journalctl logs to isolate hardware-software bugs. 
 Technical Requirements 
 Mandatory Skills: 3 to 8 years of experience in embedded software development, hardware bring-up, or system test engineering. Strong proficiency in Python for test framework development and scripting. Solid background in embedded C programming and firmware debugging. Hands-on experience with hardware peripherals ( EEPROM, eMMC, GPIO, Sensors ). Deep understanding of embedded Linux , command-line diagnostics, Systemd, and log analysis tools. Experience validating server management APIs ( Redfish ). 
 Good to Have: Exposure to OpenBMC architecture, D-Bus IPC, and system inventory services. Experience with network protocols ( SNMP, HTTPS, SSH ). Familiarity with hardware-level debugging tools (logic analyzers, oscilloscopes). Performance, stress, and load testing experience on embedded systems.

description:
We are looking for Senior SIEM Engineer to support a clients Next Generation Security Event Management program. The client is migrating SIEM capability from IBM QRadar to Elastic Security Stack and needs experienced engineers to support data-source onboarding, Elastic ingestion, ECS normalization, and detection logic development . 
 Role Summary The Senior SIEM Engineer will be responsible for onboarding and operationalizing prioritized security telemetry into Elastic Security , including creation and maintenance of data streams, ingest pipelines, index templates, field mappings, ECS normalization, and detection rules . The role requires strong hands-on experience in Elastic SIEM engineering, security log ingestion, parsing, detection engineering, and working with SOC/security monitoring teams. 
 Key Responsibilities Assess security log sources for onboarding readiness, including connectivity, log format, volume, collection method, parsing needs, data quality, field availability, and detection suitability. Design, configure, test, and maintain Elastic data streams , index templates, component templates, mappings, naming conventions, lifecycle policies, and retention settings. Develop and maintain Elastic ingest pipelines to parse, enrich, transform, and normalize security events. Map source fields to Elastic Common Schema (ECS) or approved security data models. Validate end-to-end telemetry ingestion into Elastic, including timestamp accuracy, parsing success, field extraction, mapping conflicts, duplicate events, data loss, and pipeline failures. Design, develop, test, tune, and deploy detection rules and security use cases in Elastic Security . Build detection logic using KQL, EQL, ES|QL, threshold rules, correlation logic, exceptions, risk scoring, and rule metadata . Map detections to relevant MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques, and sub-techniques . Document detection logic, test evidence, tuning decisions, false-positive considerations, known limitations, and production-readiness recommendations. Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, ECS mapping, indexing, alerting, detection, and performance issues across Elasticsearch and Kibana. Partner with SIEM Engineering, SOC, Threat Intelligence, application owners, source-system owners, and third-party teams such as Cribl. Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, implementation evidence, deployment records, risks, dependencies, and operational handover artifacts. Provide regular status updates on progress, blockers, risks, dependencies, and decisions required. 
 Required Skills and Experience 7+ years in cybersecurity / SIEM engineering , with at least 3+ years of hands-on Elastic Security / Elasticsearch / Kibana experience preferred. Strong hands-on experience as a SIEM Engineer / Detection Engineer / Security Data Engineer . Practical experience with Elastic Security / Elastic SIEM / Elasticsearch / Kibana . Experience creating and maintaining data streams, ingest pipelines, mappings, index templates, and lifecycle configurations . Strong knowledge of security log ingestion, parsing, enrichment, transformation, and normalization . Experience with Elastic Common Schema (ECS) mapping and data-model alignment. Hands-on experience writing detection rules using KQL, EQL, ES|QL , threshold logic, and correlation logic. Good understanding of SOC operations, alert triage, incident detection, and security monitoring use cases . Experience mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK . Ability to troubleshoot log ingestion, parsing, indexing, pipeline, and alerting issues. Strong documentation skills, including runbooks, design notes, validation evidence, and operational handover documents. Ability to work independently with multiple technical stakeholders and source-system owners. 
 Good to Have Experience with IBM QRadar to Elastic migration . Experience with Cribl for log routing, transformation, and enrichment. Experience with cloud, endpoint, identity, network, firewall, application, and infrastructure log sources. Familiarity with change-management and production deployment processes in enterprise environments. Experience in regulated or large enterprise environments. 
 Tools / Technologies Elastic Security Elasticsearch Kibana Elastic Ingest Pipelines Elastic Common Schema KQL / EQL / ES|QL MITRE ATT&CK Cribl IBM QRadar Jira / Confluence or similar tracking and documentation tools 
 Expected Profile Senior-level SIEM professional with strong hands-on Elastic engineering experience. Must be comfortable with both data engineering for security telemetry and detection engineering . title: Senior Engineer, Identity Access Management (IAM Engineer)
description:
Senior Engineer, Identity Access Management The Identity Access Management (IAM) Engineer is responsible for supporting, administering, engineering, and continuously improving enterprise identity and access management services. This role works as part of the Digital Identity Access team to deliver secure, reliable, and efficient identity services across the organization. The IAM Engineer will support identity lifecycle management, authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access, application integrations, certificates, and related identity technologies. The successful candidate will combine strong technical capabilities with disciplined operational practices, documentation, change management, and collaboration across Technology and Information Security teams. This is a hybrid role and work hours are 2pm 11pm IST. Responsibilities: Identity Access Management Support the administration and engineering of enterprise identity and access management platforms and services. Configure and maintain Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), authentication policies, and Conditional Access controls. Support Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory identity services. Support identity lifecycle processes including user provisioning, modification, deprovisioning, and access changes. Troubleshoot complex authentication, authorization, and access-related issues. Support application onboarding and integration with enterprise identity platforms using technologies and standards such as SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and related authentication protocols. Support identity federation and authentication integrations with SaaS, cloud, and internally developed applications. Assist with the administration and support of Auth0 and other enterprise authentication platforms. Support role-based access control and group-based access management. Identity Security Governance Partner with Information Security to implement and maintain identity security standards and controls. Support periodic access reviews, certifications, audit requests, and compliance activities. Assist with the implementation and maintenance of appropriate separation-of-duties controls. Identify excessive, inappropriate, or outdated access and work with appropriate stakeholders to remediate identified issues. Support privileged identity and access management processes where applicable. Assist with investigation and remediation of identity-related security events. Ensure identity configurations and processes align with organizational security standards and established governance requirements. PKI Certificate Management Support enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and certificate-management processes. Monitor certificate expiration and coordinate certificate renewals to prevent service disruption. Assist application and technology teams with certificate requests, renewals, deployment, and troubleshooting. Maintain accurate documentation and visibility into enterprise certificates and associated ownership. Engineering Automation Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IAM activities and improve operational efficiency. Develop and maintain scripts and automation supporting identity administration, reporting, provisioning, and operational processes. Support integrations between IAM platforms, enterprise applications, HR systems, and other technology services. Participate in identity-platform upgrades, enhancements, migrations, and modernization initiatives. Contribute to the development and maintenance of IAM architecture, standards, technical documentation, and operational procedures. Service Management Operations Manage IAM incidents, requests, problems, and changes in accordance with established service-management processes. Develop implementation, testing, validation, rollback, and communication plans for production changes. Ensure changes are appropriately documented, reviewed, approved, and communicated prior to implementation. Maintain accurate and timely visibility into assigned work, projects, changes, risks, and commitments. Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, and support runbooks. Participate in troubleshooting and resolution of major incidents involving identity or authentication services. Identify recurring issues and contribute to root-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions. Collaboration Customer Experience Partner with Digital Workplace, Information Security, Infrastructure, Application Development, Enterprise Systems, HR, Service Management, and other technology teams. Provide technical guidance to application owners integrating applications with enterprise identity services. Communicate technical issues, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Balance security requirements with the need to provide reliable and intuitive authentication and access experiences for practitioners. Demonstrate a collaborative, accountable, and service-oriented approach to delivering identity services. Essential traits: 35+ years of experience supporting or engineering enterprise Identity Access Management technologies. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory. Experience implementing or supporting Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Conditional Access. Experience integrating enterprise applications using SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, or similar authentication standards. Experience troubleshooting complex authentication and access-related issues.  About the Role As a Senior Associate, Data Engineer within the Business Intelligence Unit, you will own the data foundations that power analytics, reporting, applications, and emerging AI/ML use cases. This hands-on onsite role combines production engineering, data modelling, platform optimisation, and stakeholder partnership. You will strengthen existing SQL Server pipelines, support the transition to Snowflake and dbt, and embed disciplined engineering practices across the BIU. Working with Analysts, Power Platform Developers, and regional business users, you will turn requirements into reliable, maintainable data solutions. Your work will improve data quality, reporting performance, operational resilience, and the speed at which A&M converts information into objective business decisions. 
 Key Responsibilities Own and improve production ETL scripts, SQL Server processes, and data pipelines, increasing reliability, maintainability, and availability of data used by business-critical reports and applications. Design and maintain business-ready dimensional and relational data models that provide trusted foundations for analytics, reporting, application development, and future AI/ML solutions. Support the enterprise data warehouse transition to Snowflake by implementing scalable transformations, performance improvements, documentation, and deployment practices using dbt where appropriate. Embed application lifecycle management across BIU through Git-based version control, automated testing, controlled releases, and CI/CD processes for database and transformation assets. Diagnose and optimise report queries and data workloads, improving response times, scalability, and operational stability for key regional reporting and application use cases. Act as the regional technical subject matter expert for BIU data assets, resolving data questions, report issues, permissions, access requirements, and environment setup needs. Partner with Analysts, Power Platform Developers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions that deliver measurable insight and operational efficiency. 
 Essential Skills & Technologies Five to eight years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, platform engineering, or a comparable technical role, with ownership of production-grade pipelines and ETL processes. Strong SQL and SQL Server expertise, including query optimisation, relational design, troubleshooting, SQL Server Agent jobs, and production support for business-critical reporting or application data. Hands-on experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data warehouse, including warehouse performance optimisation, data modelling, and engineering practices for scalable analytical workloads. Practical experience with dbt or a comparable transformation framework, covering model development, testing, documentation, lineage, and repeatable deployment of data assets. Experience using Git, CI/CD, version-controlled database objects, and controlled deployment processes within an application lifecycle management framework. Experience with Azure Data Factory and the broader Azure data ecosystem, including permissions, access management, and data setup supporting analytics and application development. Working knowledge of Python or a similar scripting language for data transformation, automation, operational support, and process improvement. 
 Additional Plus Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, documentation standards, lineage, and controls that improve trust, discoverability, and responsible use of enterprise data. Experience enabling data products or platforms for Power Platform applications, business intelligence solutions, and emerging artificial intelligence or machine learning use cases. Exposure to consulting, professional services, or multi-region stakeholder environments where technical teams must respond quickly to changing business priorities. 
 What You'll Bring You bring a strong production mindset and the judgement to distinguish between a quick fix and an engineering solution that will remain reliable at scale. You have built, maintained, and improved data pipelines in live environments, and you are comfortable investigating failures, optimising SQL, and supporting business-critical data assets. You can work confidently across SQL Server and cloud data warehouse environments, with hands-on experience in Snowflake, data modelling, and preferably dbt. You understand why Git, testing, CI/CD, documentation, permissions, and repeatable deployments matter, and you apply those practices pragmatically rather than as process for its own sake. You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, explain trade-offs, and provide hands-on support when regional users need answers. You work independently while collaborating closely with analysts, application developers, and business partners. Most importantly, you are curious, detail-oriented, and willing to challenge the status quo when a better, more robust way of delivering data can improve decision-making and operational outcomes. 
 Why Join Us Shape the data architecture behind a rapidly growing global consulting capability center, with direct influence on analytics, applications, operational efficiency, and emerging AI/ML initiatives. Work alongside experienced consultants, analysts, developers, and business leaders across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC on high-impact, cross-functional problems. Grow through formal training, on-the-job learning, continuous performance development, and a meritocratic culture that rewards ownership, contribution, and measurable impact. 
 What We Offer A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment grounded in Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, with meaningful opportunities to improve how work is delivered. Structured performance development, technical training, and on-the-job learning that support continuous skill development and long-term career progression. Well-being benefits and personal resources designed to support your professional growth and personal journey while working with a growing global team.

description:

 Hi we are urgently looking for Senior data engineer having experience in either of the two cloud domain (Azure or AWS) So if the JDs given below suits your profile and you can join as early as possibile (within 30 days) then we look forward to hearing from you. 

 Job Description (Azure Data Engineer): 

 Desired Competencies (Technical/Behavioral Competency) Must-Have** 
 Hands on Experience working as a Senior Data Engineer. 
PySpark & Python for building and optimizing complex data pipelines. 
Experience with Databricks, SQL warehousing, Unity Catalog. 
Experience in ETL on Azure with Data Bricks.

 Job Description (AWS Data Engineer): 

 Role Overview: We are looking for a strong, hands-on, highly autonomous Lead Data Engineer to design, build, and operate the Service Layer platform that powers enterprise Quote-to-Cash (QTC), customer lifecycle, and finance integrations across strategic enterprise applications. Alongside deep technical contribution, you will provide technical leadership to a team of engineers, driving solution design, engineering excellence, delivery execution, and operational support across multiple integration initiatives. You will be instrumental in building and evolving a cloud-native, event-driven integration platform based on AWS, Kafka, Go and Python, leveraging canonical data models, and asynchronous messaging, while leading the adoption of best practices for architecture, engineering standards, observability, security, and platform reliability. The platform processes high-volume business-critical events while providing end-to-end visibility, reliability, security, and scalability. This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, event-driven architecture, microservices, data engineering, and cloud-native development. You will contribute to the design and implementation of Service Layer foundation capabilities including messaging, observability, orchestration, data migration, reconciliation, canonical data management, and operational tooling. Key responsibilities: Own end-to-end technical delivery of key initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered with quality, scalability, security, and operational readiness. Lead and mentor a team of engineers, fostering technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement across the team. Drive architecture and design decisions for event-driven integrations, canonical data models, orchestration frameworks, and platform capabilities. Define and enforce engineering standards, secure-by-design principles, cloud best practices, data governance and non-functional requirements for resilience, scalability, and supportability. Design, develop, and operate real-time event-driven integration services using Golang and Python. Build and enhance the Service Layer platform that orchestrates Quote-to-Cashworkflows across enterprise applications. Design and implement canonical data models, transformation frameworks, validation rules, and integration contracts that standardize communication across multiple business systems. Design and implement scalable Kafka-based event processing solutions with support for retries, idempotency, sequencing, replay, and fault recovery. Design and implement large-scale ETL, migration, reconciliation, and data-quality solutions using AWS Glue, Step Functions, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, and ClickHouse. Design and implement observability, monitoring, alerting, and operational dashboards to enable end-to-end workflow visibility and supportability. Partner with Product Managers, Architects, Enterprise Data teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders to define technical roadmaps and execution plans. Lead code reviews, design reviews, technical governance activities, and engineering best-practice adoption across the team. Drive engineering standards covering software development lifecycle, CI/CD, security, observability, resiliency, and cloud-native architecture patterns. Must Have Skills: Proven experience leading and mentoring engineering teams, including task planning, technical guidance, code reviews, and delivery management. Strong experience driving architecture and design decisions for large-scale distributed systems and enterprise integration platforms. Strong hands-on experience in Golang and Python for building scalable backend services, event-driven integrations, orchestration workflows, and data processing solutions. Strong experience designing and building cloud-native applications on AWS, including AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, IAM, CloudWatch, VPC, and related serverless architecture patterns. Experience managing technical delivery across multiple concurrent initiatives while balancing business priorities, technical debt, and platform evolution. Strong experience designing and operating event-driven and asynchronous systems using Kafka, AWS MSK, RabbitMQ, or equivalent messaging technologies. Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, including scalability, resiliency, fault tolerance, idempotency, retry patterns, dead-letter queues, message replay, and eventual consistency. Strong experience with PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, relational databases, and NoSQL databases such as DynamoDB, including data modelling, query optimization, and performance tuning. Hands-on experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, integration services, and enterprise system interfaces using secure API design principles. Experience building and enforcing canonical data models, data contracts, transformation layers, and validation frameworks for enterprise integrations. Hands-on experience building and supporting high-availability, business-critical applications on AWS with strong focus on performance, reliability, and operational supportability. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code quality, and secure software delivery practices, using tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, SonarQube, Trivy, Semgrep etc. Experience with observability, monitoring, and operational analytics, using CloudWatch, Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent platforms. Strong understanding of cloud security and secure-by-design principles, including IAM, OAuth2, JWT authentication, encryption at rest and in transit, Secrets Manager, vulnerability management, audit logging, and compliance controls. Strong problem-solving skills with experience in production support, incident management, root cause analysis, and performance optimization within large-scale distributed environments. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline. 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years focused on cloud-native, data engineering, integration, or distributed platforms. 2+ years of experience leading engineering teams or acting as technical lead for large-scale enterprise initiatives. 5+ years building cloud-native solutions on AWS. 5+ years of experience working with Golang, Python, AWS Service, and Kafka in production environments. Proven experience designing, building, and operating highly available enterprise integration and event-driven platforms. Nice to have: AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Data Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, AWS Certified Developer, or equivalent. Experience in Quote-to-Cash, CRM, ERP, Customer Lifecycle Management, or Enterprise Data domains. 

 For AWS Data Engineer we are looking for candidates having experience in between 8 to 15 years.

Build data pipelines and reusable data products supporting operational analytics, advanced analytics, AI, and machine learning workloads. Optimize Fabric capacity utilization, storage, workload placement, refresh performance, concurrency, reliability, and operating cost. Optimize semantic models for scale, query performance, refresh efficiency, consistency, maintainability, security, and reuse. Establish semantic model standards, ownership, versioning, documentation, testing, certification, and lifecycle governance. Develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned with enterprise terminology and business rules. Define reusable canonical entities, attributes, relationships, identifiers, event structures, and data contracts. Partner with architects, data owners, stewards, engineers, and business stakeholders to resolve conflicting definitions and establish trusted data assets. Reduce duplicate transformations and point-to-point mappings by creating reusable canonical integration and analytical structures. Azure Data Factory and Enterprise Integration Architect, build, and maintain Azure Data Factory and Fabric Data Factory solutions for enterprise-scale ingestion, transformation, movement, and orchestration. Develop ETL and ELT pipelines, incremental processing, Change Data Capture, event-driven integrations, streaming patterns, and resilient recovery workflows. Integrate data from databases, files, APIs, SaaS applications, cloud services, on-premises platforms, and third-party systems. Create reusable ingestion frameworks, metadata-driven pipelines, parameterized components, and integration accelerators. Implement secure connectivity, secrets management, data validation, error handling, logging, alerting, observability, and automated recovery. Integrate Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services with Azure Machine Learning, Fabric Data Science, MLflow, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, model registries, and data science workbench environments. Design feature engineering and data preparation pipelines for model training, validation, testing, batch scoring, real-time inference, and model monitoring. Build data architectures supporting Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector search, semantic retrieval, knowledge platforms, AI agents, and intelligent assistants. Enable secure, permission-aware, traceable, and governed access to enterprise data for AI and machine learning solutions. Collaborate with data science and AI teams to productionize experiments and establish repeatable data-to-model workflows. Data Warehouse and Lakehouse Engineering Design and implement enterprise Lakehouse and Warehouse environments using modern cloud data architecture patterns. Build fact models, conformed dimensions, canonical business entities, curated data products, and aggregation layers. Apply Delta Lake practices for reliable, scalable, and maintainable data processing. Optimize storage layout, partitioning, file sizing, data access patterns, transformation placement, and workload performance. Support structured, semi-structured, batch, streaming, analytical, and AI-oriented data workloads. Performance, Reliability, and Operational Excellence Optimize pipelines, semantic models, lakehouses, warehouses, notebooks, and integration workloads for performance and cost efficiency. Troubleshoot end-to-end data processing issues, including ingestion failures, query latency, transformation bottlenecks, resource contention, and data quality defects. Establish performance baselines, service objectives, health metrics, operational dashboards, alerting, and capacity indicators. Improve deployment quality through automated testing, data reconciliation, schema validation, observability, and controlled release practices. Data Governance, Security, and Quality Implement metadata management, data lineage, cataloging, classification, retention, data quality, and stewardship controls. Apply least-privilege access, encryption, row-level controls, object-level controls, sensitivity labels, and auditability where required. Support integration with Microsoft Purview and enterprise governance processes. Design data quality rules, validation frameworks, reconciliation processes, exception handling, and measurable quality indicators. Ensure solutions comply with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, risk, and regulatory requirements. Collaboration and Technical Leadership Partner with data architects, AI engineers, machine learning engineers, data scientists, application teams, product owners, governance teams, and business stakeholders. Translate business and analytical requirements into scalable data architecture, integration, modeling, and delivery solutions. Communicate technical designs, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Participate in architecture reviews, establish engineering standards, mentor other engineers, and promote reusable delivery patterns. Create clear documentation for data models, pipelines, interfaces, data contracts, operational procedures, and support ownership. Equivalent practical experience may be considered. Experience 6+ years of professional data engineering, data platform engineering, or related experience. Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and delivering solutions with Microsoft Fabric. Experience developing and optimizing enterprise semantic models and canonical data models. Experience building production-grade Azure Data Factory and/or Fabric Data Factory solutions. Experience with enterprise data warehouses, lakehouses, data lakes, dimensional models, and cloud data integration. Experience enabling data science, machine learning, AI, or advanced analytics workloads. Required Technical Skills Microsoft Fabric: OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Fabric Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, Spark notebooks, Data Engineering, Data Science, and Real-Time Intelligence. Semantic and Canonical Modeling: Enterprise semantic models, canonical data models, conceptual/logical/physical modeling, dimensional modeling, star schemas, hierarchies, metrics, KPIs, business rules, and data contracts. Data Integration: Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, ETL/ELT, Change Data Capture, incremental processing, APIs, event-driven integration, streaming, orchestration, and metadata-driven pipelines. AI and Data Science: Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, MLflow, data science workbenches, feature engineering, model data preparation, RAG, vector data, and AI data pipelines. Programming: Advanced SQL and T-SQL, Python, PySpark, notebooks, scripting, and automation. Engineering Practices: Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, observability, source control, and controlled deployment. Data Platforms: Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Snowflake, Databricks, Delta Lake, or comparable enterprise platforms. Preferred Qualifications Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer, Fabric Analytics Engineer, Azure Data Engineer, Azure AI Engineer, or related certification. Experience integrating Microsoft Purview with enterprise metadata, lineage, classification, and governance processes. Experience supporting Generative AI, AI agents, vector search, machine learning lifecycle management, and production inference workloads. Experience with data contracts, master data, canonical integration patterns, and domain-oriented data products. Experience supporting regulated, mission-critical, high-volume, or globally distributed data environments. Critical Competencies Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to connect business requirements to scalable data engineering and modeling solutions. Ownership mindset with attention to quality, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability. Collaborative approach and ability to work effectively across architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, data science, and business teams. Commitment to reusable engineering, documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. Success Measures Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency of Microsoft Fabric and Azure data solutions. Quality, reuse, consistency, and adoption of semantic models and canonical data assets. Pipeline success rates, data freshness, processing latency, recoverability, and operational supportability. Data quality, governance compliance, lineage coverage, security, and stakeholder trust. Speed and repeatability of data delivery for AI, machine learning, data science, and analytics use cases. Reduction in redundant data transformations, inconsistent definitions, and point-to-point integrations. Stakeholder satisfaction and measurable business value enabled by trusted enterprise data products. They are equally comfortable working with data architects, AI engineers, machine learning engineers, data scientists, application teams, and business stakeholders to deliver trusted, scalable, reusable, and AI-ready enterprise data assets. description:
We are looking for Senior SIEM Engineer to support a clients Next Generation Security Event Management program. The client is migrating SIEM capability from IBM QRadar to Elastic Security Stack and needs experienced engineers to support data-source onboarding, Elastic ingestion, ECS normalization, and detection logic development . 
 Role Summary The Senior SIEM Engineer will be responsible for onboarding and operationalizing prioritized security telemetry into Elastic Security , including creation and maintenance of data streams, ingest pipelines, index templates, field mappings, ECS normalization, and detection rules . The role requires strong hands-on experience in Elastic SIEM engineering, security log ingestion, parsing, detection engineering, and working with SOC/security monitoring teams. 
 Key Responsibilities Assess security log sources for onboarding readiness, including connectivity, log format, volume, collection method, parsing needs, data quality, field availability, and detection suitability. Design, configure, test, and maintain Elastic data streams , index templates, component templates, mappings, naming conventions, lifecycle policies, and retention settings. Develop and maintain Elastic ingest pipelines to parse, enrich, transform, and normalize security events. Map source fields to Elastic Common Schema (ECS) or approved security data models. Validate end-to-end telemetry ingestion into Elastic, including timestamp accuracy, parsing success, field extraction, mapping conflicts, duplicate events, data loss, and pipeline failures. Design, develop, test, tune, and deploy detection rules and security use cases in Elastic Security . Build detection logic using KQL, EQL, ES|QL, threshold rules, correlation logic, exceptions, risk scoring, and rule metadata . Map detections to relevant MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques, and sub-techniques . Document detection logic, test evidence, tuning decisions, false-positive considerations, known limitations, and production-readiness recommendations. Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, ECS mapping, indexing, alerting, detection, and performance issues across Elasticsearch and Kibana. Partner with SIEM Engineering, SOC, Threat Intelligence, application owners, source-system owners, and third-party teams such as Cribl. Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, implementation evidence, deployment records, risks, dependencies, and operational handover artifacts. Provide regular status updates on progress, blockers, risks, dependencies, and decisions required. 
 Required Skills and Experience 7+ years in cybersecurity / SIEM engineering , with at least 3+ years of hands-on Elastic Security / Elasticsearch / Kibana experience preferred. Strong hands-on experience as a SIEM Engineer / Detection Engineer / Security Data Engineer . Practical experience with Elastic Security / Elastic SIEM / Elasticsearch / Kibana . Experience creating and maintaining data streams, ingest pipelines, mappings, index templates, and lifecycle configurations . Strong knowledge of security log ingestion, parsing, enrichment, transformation, and normalization . Experience with Elastic Common Schema (ECS) mapping and data-model alignment. Hands-on experience writing detection rules using KQL, EQL, ES|QL , threshold logic, and correlation logic. Good understanding of SOC operations, alert triage, incident detection, and security monitoring use cases . Experience mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK . Ability to troubleshoot log ingestion, parsing, indexing, pipeline, and alerting issues. Strong documentation skills, including runbooks, design notes, validation evidence, and operational handover documents. Ability to work independently with multiple technical stakeholders and source-system owners. 
 Good to Have Experience with IBM QRadar to Elastic migration . Experience with Cribl for log routing, transformation, and enrichment. Experience with cloud, endpoint, identity, network, firewall, application, and infrastructure log sources. Familiarity with change-management and production deployment processes in enterprise environments. Experience in regulated or large enterprise environments.
