title: Technical Account Manager
description:
MongoDB Technical Account Managers are at the forefront of technical problem solving with key customers, working on some of the most complex and exciting application ecosystems built on the MongoDB platform. TAMs combine: Deep product knowledge and expertise across multiple domains Polished technical communications Strong account leadership, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the customer Ability to not only proactively engage, but anticipate and preempt needs a customer may have or issues they could experience A high degree of ownership and willingness to go above and beyond for our customers The TAMs primary remit is the cultivation of customer confidence and delivery of positive, account-wide technical outcomes that solve big customer problems while showcasing the capabilities of the MongoDB product portfolio. They do this through a systematic engagement process including deep discovery and the development of a roadmap of shared objectives. They are able to operate in complex environments where there may be shared or even ambiguous responsibilities between the customer and MongoDB. The TAM is able to shift gears between enabling, coaching and mentoring, and marshaling resources to get the right things done at the right time. The TAM also acts as the eyes and ears of the product team while working with marquee customers as they will sometimes surface new requirements or potential areas of opportunity for future development. They work closely with these teams to understand these requirements, manage expectations, and ensure MongoDB is staying one step ahead of customer needs. This role will be an early hire into the new Technical Account Management function and will help pioneer the new service offering for MongoDB. Successful candidates will have the flexibility to work around the schedules of customers with 100% uptime systems while enjoying the life/work balance MongoDB promotes. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. Cool things you'll do 
 MongoDB is on a mission to unlock the inner genius of our customers by making data stunningly easy to work with. Along the way, our customers encounter questions and issues about how our approach to databases works for their use case. In Technical Services, it's our job to help our customers succeed with MongoDB As a Technical Account Manager, you'll be highly engaged with a handful of our largest customers, building key relationships with technical leaders and collaborating with them on their projects to build and scale MongoDB solutions - resolving questions and demonstrating solutions related to architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between You'll be an expert resource on the best way to run MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You will identify deep dive opportunities to educate our customers on crucial topics of concern to them and either conduct those deep dives yourself or make timely connections between customers and subject matter experts within MongoDB You will also mentor and ramp new team members, and take initiatives in building knowledge of new product lines within the MongoDB ecosystem What you need 
 You should have 7+ years of relevant experience. We consider all candidates, with an eye for those who combine formal education with self-teaching, are insatiably curious, and are multi-faceted It's crucial for every candidate to check these boxes: Communicator: Foster open lines of communication amongst internal stakeholders; The TAM ensures all concerned parties, including in some cases the MongoDB executive team, are well informed about accounts within the TAMs portfolio (especially during critical or escalated situations) Great communication and account leadership skills of external stakeholders, with a good organizational understanding of customers and ability to calibrate communication style based on the audience The TAM must quickly understand and communicate about customer workloads, use cases, and resiliency criteria, including performance, availability, and scalability Collaborator: Ability to work independently as well as cross-functionally to ensure customer needs are being met Genuine desire to help people, and to increase their confidence and good will Ability to cultivate strong team partnerships: Understanding of when and how to seek help from team members, skill in choosing from potentially conflicting perspectives or approaches; title: Robotic Intern
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for students looking to kick-start their careers. Please review the Job Description shared below and apply if your skills and interests align with the role. 
 Position:  Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development (Internship)
 Location:  Ahmedabad (Fx31Labs Office)
 Address:  205, Amrakunj Avis, Near Tapovan Circle, Above Gwalbhog Restaurant, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424 
 Job Description: Fx31Labs is seeking a passionate and hands-on Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development  to join our advanced robotics team. This internship offers a fast-paced, end-to-end engineering experience involving aerial robotics, embedded systems, autonomous navigation, perception, and real-world prototype development.This role is ideal for students and early-career engineers looking to gain practical experience in designing, building, testing, and improving autonomous robotic platforms. 
 Key Responsibilities: Design & Build Assemble and integrate motors, ESCs, sensors, flight controllers, microcontrollers, and communication modules. Design and prototype electronic systems for rapid testing and development. Assist in mechanical assembly, wiring, and hardware integration of robotic platforms. Embedded Systems & Control Develop Python and C/C++ software for sensor integration, control systems, and autonomous behaviors. Interface with hardware using UART, CAN, IC, SPI, USB, and wireless communication protocols. Implement safety mechanisms, telemetry systems, and fault-detection routines. Autonomous Navigation & Perception Integrate sensors such as IMUs, GPS, LiDAR, cameras, depth sensors, and range finders. Develop and test localization, navigation, and obstacle-avoidance capabilities. Work with computer vision and perception pipelines for environmental awareness. ROS 2 & SLAM Implement and tune SLAM and localization frameworks using ROS 2. Work with tools such as Cartographer, RTAB-Map, Nav2, and related autonomy stacks. Support mapping, path planning, and autonomous mission execution. System Integration & Testing Integrate hardware, firmware, and software into a fully functional robotic system. Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and validation across electronics, software, and mechanical subsystems. Conduct field testing and analyze system performance. Rapid Prototyping & Iteration Build, test, evaluate, and refine prototypes through iterative development cycles. Document experiments, test results, and design improvements. Contribute innovative ideas to improve system reliability and performance. Team Collaboration Collaborate closely with robotics, embedded, AI, mechanical, and software engineers. Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, testing sessions, and technical discussions. Present findings, challenges, and proposed solutions to the engineering team. 
 Qualifications: Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with robotics, embedded systems, drones, autonomous vehicles, or related projects. Proficiency in Python and basic C/C++ programming. Understanding of sensors, control systems, communication protocols, and microcontroller-based development. Experience with hardware assembly, wiring, debugging, and soldering. Comfortable working on both software and physical hardware systems. 
 Nice-to-Haves: Experience with ROS 2 and robotic middleware. Knowledge of SLAM, localization, path planning, and autonomous navigation. Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, or similar robotics/autonomy frameworks. Familiarity with OpenCV, computer vision, or AI-based perception systems. Experience with Linux (Ubuntu) development environments. Familiarity with CAD tools such as Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or Onshape. Understanding of wireless communication systems and telemetry. 
 Soft Skills: Self-driven and highly proactive. Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Curious mindset with a passion for building real-world robotic systems. Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a rapid prototyping environment. Strong communication and teamwork skills. 
 Why Join Us? End-to-End Engineering Experience:   Work on complete autonomous robotic systems from design and prototyping to testing and deployment. Advanced Robotics Exposure:   Gain hands-on experience in embedded systems, aerial robotics, autonomous navigation, perception, and ROS 2-based autonomy. Learning & Mentorship:   Collaborate with experienced engineers and receive practical guidance in real-world R&D projects. Innovation-Driven Environment:   Be part of a team focused on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and cutting-edge technology development. 
 Internship Details: Duration:  3–6 Months
 Type:  Internship with mentorship, certification, and learning opportunities
 Location:  On-site at Fx31Labs, Ahmedabad 
 About Fx31Labs: Fx31Labs is an innovation-driven tech company delivering solutions at the intersection of robotics, AI, and software development. We specialize in building intelligent, scalable, and automation-first systems for startups and enterprises alike.

title: Robotic Intern
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for students looking to kick-start their careers. Please review the Job Description shared below and apply if your skills and interests align with the role. 
 Position:  Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development (Internship)
 Location:  Ahmedabad (Fx31Labs Office)
 Address:  205, Amrakunj Avis, Near Tapovan Circle, Above Gwalbhog Restaurant, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424 
 Job Description: Fx31Labs is seeking a passionate and hands-on Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development  to join our advanced robotics team. This internship offers a fast-paced, end-to-end engineering experience involving aerial robotics, embedded systems, autonomous navigation, perception, and real-world prototype development.This role is ideal for students and early-career engineers looking to gain practical experience in designing, building, testing, and improving autonomous robotic platforms. 
 Key Responsibilities: Design & Build Assemble and integrate motors, ESCs, sensors, flight controllers, microcontrollers, and communication modules. Design and prototype electronic systems for rapid testing and development. Assist in mechanical assembly, wiring, and hardware integration of robotic platforms. Embedded Systems & Control Develop Python and C/C++ software for sensor integration, control systems, and autonomous behaviors. Interface with hardware using UART, CAN, IC, SPI, USB, and wireless communication protocols. Implement safety mechanisms, telemetry systems, and fault-detection routines. Autonomous Navigation & Perception Integrate sensors such as IMUs, GPS, LiDAR, cameras, depth sensors, and range finders. Develop and test localization, navigation, and obstacle-avoidance capabilities. Work with computer vision and perception pipelines for environmental awareness. ROS 2 & SLAM Implement and tune SLAM and localization frameworks using ROS 2. Work with tools such as Cartographer, RTAB-Map, Nav2, and related autonomy stacks. Support mapping, path planning, and autonomous mission execution. System Integration & Testing Integrate hardware, firmware, and software into a fully functional robotic system. Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and validation across electronics, software, and mechanical subsystems. Conduct field testing and analyze system performance. Rapid Prototyping & Iteration Build, test, evaluate, and refine prototypes through iterative development cycles. Document experiments, test results, and design improvements. Contribute innovative ideas to improve system reliability and performance. Team Collaboration Collaborate closely with robotics, embedded, AI, mechanical, and software engineers. Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, testing sessions, and technical discussions. Present findings, challenges, and proposed solutions to the engineering team. 
 Qualifications: Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with robotics, embedded systems, drones, autonomous vehicles, or related projects. Proficiency in Python and basic C/C++ programming. Understanding of sensors, control systems, communication protocols, and microcontroller-based development. Experience with hardware assembly, wiring, debugging, and soldering. Comfortable working on both software and physical hardware systems. 
 Nice-to-Haves: Experience with ROS 2 and robotic middleware. Knowledge of SLAM, localization, path planning, and autonomous navigation. Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, or similar robotics/autonomy frameworks. Familiarity with OpenCV, computer vision, or AI-based perception systems. Experience with Linux (Ubuntu) development environments. Familiarity with CAD tools such as Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or Onshape. Understanding of wireless communication systems and telemetry. 
 Soft Skills: Self-driven and highly proactive. Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Curious mindset with a passion for building real-world robotic systems. Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a rapid prototyping environment. Strong communication and teamwork skills. 
 Why Join Us? End-to-End Engineering Experience:   Work on complete autonomous robotic systems from design and prototyping to testing and deployment. Advanced Robotics Exposure:   Gain hands-on experience in embedded systems, aerial robotics, autonomous navigation, perception, and ROS 2-based autonomy. Learning & Mentorship:   Collaborate with experienced engineers and receive practical guidance in real-world R&D projects. Innovation-Driven Environment:   Be part of a team focused on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and cutting-edge technology development. 
 Internship Details: Duration:  3–6 Months
 Type:  Internship with mentorship, certification, and learning opportunities
 Location:  On-site at Fx31Labs, Ahmedabad

The role involves working closely with software development, analytics, and DevOps teams to ensure reliable, secure, and high-performing database environments. 
 About Us 
Join Comfort Click, a premier e-commerce multinational specializing in branded nutraceuticals, vitamins, minerals, and healthcare products for humans and pets. Since our inception in 2005, we have rapidly expanded across Europe and continue to strengthen our footprint globally.
In 2025, Comfort Click became a proud part of Zydus Wellness Ltd., one of India’s most respected and publicly listed healthcare and wellness companies. Backed by the legacy, trust, and innovation of Zydus, we are now entering an exciting new phase of growth — combining our strong e-commerce expertise with the stability and scale of a global healthcare leader.
Our UK headquarters, along with our dynamic Indian offices in Hyderabad and Vadodara, are at the forefront of continuous innovation, strongly focused on nurturing in-house talent. We cultivate a collaborative and entrepreneurial culture, where decision-making is swift, ideas are valued, and your contributions make a visible impact. At the same time, being part of Zydus Wellness provides the credibility, career stability, and opportunities that come with a world-renowned healthcare group.
Be part of Comfort Click’s exhilarating growth story within the Zydus family, where your career is empowered by both speed and scale. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Install, configure, administer, and maintain PostgreSQL databases. Manage and support Google Cloud AlloyDB environments. Monitor database performance and proactively identify bottlenecks. Optimize SQL queries, indexes, and database configurations for improved performance. Perform regular database health checks and capacity planning. Configure and monitor automated backups and recovery procedures. Implement disaster recovery strategies and perform periodic recovery testing. Manage database users, roles, permissions, and security policies. Ensure database availability, reliability, and data integrity. Troubleshoot production database issues and provide timely resolutions. Support database migrations, upgrades, and patch management. Collaborate with application developers to design efficient database structures. Create and maintain database documentation, SOPs, and operational runbooks. Monitor storage utilization, replication, and database growth. Participate in production deployments and release activities. 
 Qualification 
 3–5 years of hands-on experience administering PostgreSQL databases. Good understanding of database architecture and relational database concepts. Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), preferably AlloyDB. Strong knowledge of SQL and query optimization. Experience with backup, restore, replication, and disaster recovery. Knowledge of PostgreSQL extensions and performance tuning. Familiarity with Linux system administration. Understanding of database security, access management, and auditing. Experience using monitoring tools such as pg Admin, Prometheus, Grafana, or Cloud Monitoring. Ability to troubleshoot database performance and operational issues. Good to Have: 
 Experience with Cloud SQL or other managed PostgreSQL services. Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with CI/CD pipelines. Understanding of ETL workflows and data warehousing concepts. Exposure to Big Query or other cloud analytics platforms. Google Cloud certification is an added advantage. Benefits

 We are looking for an experienced DevOps GCP Engineer with 12 to 14 years of hands-on expertise in building, deploying, and managing scalable cloud-native applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The ideal candidate will have strong experience in CI/CD pipeline design, Kubernetes-based container orchestration, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud automation, and enterprise DevOps practices. 
 Role: Devops GCP Engineer Location: Hyderabad Experience: Between 12 to 14 Years Job Type: Full Time Employment 
 What You'll Do: 
 Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket, Bamboo, and related DevOps tools. Automate application build, testing, deployment, and release management processes. Develop and maintain automation scripts using Shell Scripting and PowerShell. Build and manage scalable cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Deploy, manage, and optimize containerized applications using Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies. Support microservices-based applications and distributed system architectures. Implement deployment strategies such as Blue-Green, Canary, Rolling, and Big Bang deployments. Integrate security and quality tools such as Veracode, Black Duck, SonarQube, Lighthouse, AppDynamics, and Cypress into CI/CD pipelines. Provide ongoing build, deployment, and production support across multiple environments. Collaborate closely with development teams to streamline release processes and improve software delivery efficiency. Troubleshoot infrastructure, application deployment, networking, and platform-related issues. Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform. Develop Pipeline as Code solutions and automate operational workflows. Support cloud migration, modernization, and platform transformation initiatives. Implement monitoring, logging, and observability solutions for proactive issue detection. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize deployment speed, reliability, and operational efficiency. Participate in architecture discussions and recommend DevOps and cloud best practices. Create and maintain technical documentation, deployment guides, and operational runbooks. Mentor team members and promote DevOps culture across engineering teams. 
 Expertise You'll Bring: 
 12 to 14 years of experience in DevOps Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering. Strong expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and cloud architecture. Hands-on experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Jenkins, or similar tools. Strong experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies. Expertise in Shell Scripting and PowerShell Scripting for automation and operational management. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Knowledge of Pipeline as Code and automated deployment frameworks. Strong understanding of DevOps principles and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices. Experience working with microservices architectures and cloud-native application deployments. Knowledge of deployment methodologies including Blue-Green, Canary, and Big Bang deployment strategies. Experience integrating application security and quality assessment tools such as Veracode, Black Duck, SonarQube, AppDynamics, and Cypress. Experience providing production deployment support and troubleshooting complex issues. Strong Linux and Windows system administration experience. Experience working with databases such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar platforms. Good understanding of networking, security, authentication, and cloud governance principles. Proven debugging and root-cause analysis skills. Experience working within Agile and Scrum software development environments. Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management capabilities. Ability to lead technical initiatives and drive operational excellence. Passion for continuous learning and adopting emerging technologies. 
 Benefits: 
 Competitive salary and benefits package Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards Annual health check-ups Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents 
 Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:

Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities. Lead Platform Engineer
 
The Database Engineering team is looking for a Lead Platform Engineer to drive our customer experience strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem-solving. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.

- Drive intellectual property development and use for projects, team, and Database Engineering.
- Sharp shooters in identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving complex technical challenges or operational issues across Mastercard.
 
 
Education (preferred)

- Integrate database operations with CI/CD pipelines using tools like Bitbucket, Github, Jenkins, XLR, CloudFormation, Terraform, and AWS Lambda.

You would be responsible for driving reusable terraform based cloud platform for different cloud providers like GCP, AWS, Azure. You would be responsible for supporting the Head of IT Operations in setting up cloud center of excellence and FinOps best practices across the organizations. You would be responsible for maintaining the Burn down charts, Velocity Chart using JIRA and Confluence of documentation. You would be Involved in driving the adoption of DevOps best practices across different projects in an organization. You should be tracking Service Incidents/ Problem tickets and documenting RCA for cloud infrastructure incidents. You would be point of contact for external communications (e.g. from customers or stakeholders) You would ensure deliverables are up to quality standards at the end of each sprint. You should have excellent knowledge of Scrum techniques and artifacts (such as definition of done, user stories, automated testing, backlog refinement). title: Senior Clinical Trial Manager (Sr. CTM) - Internal Medicine
description:
Job Summary As a Senior Clinical Team Manager (Sr. CTM), you combine deep knowledge, therapeutic expertise, and robust tools to help our clients deliver life-changing therapies to market. You take ownership of all start-up and clinical deliverables, anticipate problems, find solutions and deliver results; coordinating the activities of start-up and clinical team members which are allocated to a project on a Regional or Country basis. You will work in partnership with the Project Manager to ensure the necessary training, tracking and quality systems are in place for the clinical management team and be primarily responsible for the start-up and clinical deliverables of the Project within agreed timelines and budget. Clinical Team Managers provide contact and support to the project sponsor for all clinical aspects. At PPD we hire the best, develop ourselves and each other, and recognize the power of being one team. We offer continued career advancement opportunities, award winning training and benefits focused on the health and wellbeing of our employees. Summarized Purpose: Accountable for achieving the final start-up and clinical deliverables (usually clean data from evaluable patients as specified in the study protocol) within the time period specified in the contract with the customer. Interprets data on complex issues and makes good business decisions with support from line management. Works to ensure that all start-up and clinical deliverables meet the customers time/quality/cost expectations. Maintains profitability by ensuring start-up and clinical activity is conducted within contract scope, through efficient management of the country start-up and clinical team. Typically works independently on projects of moderate to high complexity and may assume regional lead or Clinical Study Manager responsibilities. Therapeutic Scope The therapeutic scope includes Cardiovascular Internal Medicine - Dermatology, GI, (UC/CD), Cardiovascular, Liver, Nephrology, Immunology, Rare Disease, Diabetes, Obesity, Dyslipidemia, Womens Health. Essential Functions Manages all clinical and start-up activities, operational and quality aspects of allocated studies, of moderate to high complexity, in compliance with ICH GCP. In accordance to project specific requirements, may assume Lead CTM responsibilities on regional level, Clinical Study Manager (CSM) responsibilities or take on additional responsibilities; e.g. process improvements, manage complex programs, have wider management or project coordination responsibilities. Acts as the primary point of contact for study start-up activities and site activation across the assigned region and/or globally, driving timelines and ensuring operational excellence. Develops start-up and clinical tools (e.g. Essential Document Checklist, Monitoring Plan, Monitoring Guidelines) in conjunction with the study requirements and Data Quality Plan. Contributes to the development of the Master Action Plan (MAP) for providing clinical related documents. Ensures timely set up, organization, content and quality of the relevant sections of the Trial Master File (local and central). May participate in the design and development of CRFs, CRF guidelines, patient informed consent templates and other protocol specific documents as required.  Network Engineer – AWS & Cisco Migration 
 Requirements:

We are seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer with deep expertise in Cisco networking technologies and AWS cloud networking to lead and execute the migration of onpremises and Ciscobased network infrastructure into AWS. Deep expertise in Cisco routing and switching, including BGP and OSPF. Strong experience with Cisco firewalls (ASA, FTD, ASAv/FTDv) and VPN technologies. Solid understanding of AWS VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, and Elastic Load Balancing. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex network issues in production environments.  Cisco to AWS Migration Lead network migration initiatives from Cisco onpremises and datacenter environments to AWS. Assess existing Cisco architectures (ASA/FTD, routers, switches) and define migration strategies to AWSnative or virtualized equivalents (ASAv/FTDv, Transit Gateway, AWS Network Firewall). Build and operate hybrid connectivity using SitetoSite VPN and AWS Direct Connect with BGP and high availability. Implement Transit Gateway architectures for largescale, multiaccount environments. Network Security & Compliance Deploy and manage Cisco firewalls (ASA, FTD, ASAv/FTDv) and/or AWSnative security services. Implement network security best practices using security groups, NACLs, and logging (VPC Flow Logs). Support compliance initiatives (SOC, PCI, HIPAA where applicable) through secure network design and documentation. Automation, Operations & Troubleshooting Use Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation) to standardize and automate network deployments. Troubleshoot complex network issues across Layer 3–7 in hybrid and cloud environments. Leverage AWS tooling such as Reachability Analyzer, CloudWatch, and traffic monitoring to ensure network reliability. Create and maintain architecture diagrams, runbooks, and operational documentation.

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our goal is to create meaningful impact with a focus on the developing world. We aim to make insights from Earth Observation data accessible to all. With a founding team rooted in the Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology (IIST), Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), and the Indian Institute of Remote Sensing (IIRS), and a leadership team with diverse industry experience (IBM, Samsung, Intel, USC, IITKGP, IITB, IITG, IITM), we value technical innovation and scale. If you are interested in working in an environment focused on societal impact, driven by cutting-edge technology, and offering the freedom to innovate and be creative with no hierarchies, SatSure is the place for you.

 As a Lead Data Scientist , you will: Own technical charters and roadmap for multiple ML/CV initiatives. Lead and mentor applied scientists, mapping complex EO problems into actionable, scalable decision systems. Drive hypothesis generation, experimentation, architecture design, model development, and deployment for production ML pipelines. Own E2E delivery of large-scale ML/CV systems - from problem framing to data design, model development, deployment, and monitoring. Collaborate with Product, MLOps, Platform, and Geospatial experts to convert ambiguous requirements into elegant solutions. Communicate technical findings to leadership, customers, and cross-functional partners with clarity and precision. Contribute to hiring and technical excellence, including mentoring junior team members and interns.

title: Country Safety and Security Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities: 
 The Country Safety and Security Manager (CSSM) will drive safety, security, and risk management initiatives for Aga Khan Education Service, India (AKES, I) and the Aga Khan Academy, Hyderabad (AKAH). S/he will develop and implement risk-based strategies, policies, standards, and procedures in line with wider AKDN policy. A strategic safety and security perspective will be maintained through links with local organizations and official departments to inform appropriate operational level decisions for AKES, I and AKAH leadership. The CSSM has a responsibility to monitor, mentor, guide, and support safety and security staff at AKAH and the schools security focal points (SFPs) in Mumbai, Gujrat and Telangana regions. The CSSM will provide leadership with security analysis by continuously monitoring the security environment and will also inform and work under the functional guidance of the Global Safety and Security Lead (GSSL) for Aga Khan Schools. The incumbent shall work in close collaboration with the Department of International Security (DIS) of AKDN. 
 Safety and Security Management and Planning: Develop and implement a structured safety and security management system , in line with the AKDN Security Level System (SLS), and provide directions on safety and security strategy, policy, standards and procedures. Develop and implement mandated (SLS) assessments, procedures, plans, and mechanisms appropriate to regional threat levels and the schools context. Conduct audits of the schools and review safety and security mitigation measures/manage the remedial action plans. Review and implement the safety and security mitigation strategies for schools, hostels and offices, address vulnerabilities, and lead the audit process. Develop and implement the organizations strategic safety and security plans including the business continuity plans. Collect and analyze safety and security information and disseminate advisories. Oversee the implementation and ensure that the security systems and equipment, such as surveillance cameras, access control systems, and alarm systems including fire extinguishers are in working condition. Escalate to the relevant function for any resolution of issues with such system/equipments. Develop and maintain a strong contextual understanding of all AKES, I areas of operation. Oversee the planning, implementation and quality control of AKES, I security manpower, technical assets, and physical protection measures such as CCTV cameras, access control systems, alarm systems, and firefighting equipment, are appropriate, maintained and correctly utilized. 
 Incident Management: Develop at all schools critical incident management teams and prepare the team to manage critical incidents including coordination and supporting emergency services during any critical incident. Develop and maintain a Critical Incident Management Team (CIMT) and prepare contingency plans to manage critical incidents, including coordination with and support to emergency services during such events. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of safety and security measures through incident reporting, data analysis, and feedback mechanisms. Support the supervisor and CIMT in managing all safety and security aspects of incident response. In coordination with the school Safeguarding Lead implement the Safeguarding policy requirements in this respect. Develop and maintain a communications system that is robust and reliable to ensure effective communication with required services and personnel during emergencies. Gather and analyze safety and security information relevant to education/schools in areas of operations to strengthen the AKES safety and security planning and preparedness. 
 Coordination and Relationships: Work under the functional guidance and in close coordination with the AKDN Department of International Security (DIS) along with AKS Safety & Security Lead. Establish relationships with the relevant law enforcement agencies, community leaders, and emergency services to ensure their support as required. Through the school Safety and Security focal point, establish relationships with relevant local law enforcement agencies, community leaders, and emergency services to ensure their support as required Through the school Safety & Security focal point, monitor and manage the activities and performance of contracted security providers in accordance with AKES, India policies, established KPIs and the service agreement; conduct quarterly review meetings with the service provider, liaise as required. Coordinate and support the School Safeguarding focal point in the implementation and execution of the Safeguarding policy under the guidance of the AKES, India Safeguarding Lead. Actively participate in monthly security coordination cell (SCC) meetings. 
 Training and Briefings: Deliver or coordinate safety and security workshop/ training and drills for AKES, India personnel Conduct or coordinate safety and security training for security guards, housekeeping staff and drivers on a regular basis Develop and implement capacity building for any staff undertaking security and safety functions, full or part time. Deliver student safety, security and safeguarding awareness programs under the guidance of the AKES, India Safeguarding Lead, including induction and briefing of all new employees on these. Stay informed about current trends, best practices, and legal requirements related to school safety and security, and recommend updates to policies and procedures as needed. Ensure the statutory standards for fire and first aid preparedness are met and that provision for fire and first aid training is made where applicable. Private Security Management Advice on the selection of sub- contracted security service companies (guards/technical security/response) and managing such contracts to ensure the operational requirement stated by AKES, I and AKAH SLT is properly met. Manage the activities and performance of contracted private security providers in accordance with AKES, I and AKAH policies, established KPIs, and the service agreement. Conduct monthly and quarterly review meetings with the private security company. Liaise with the private security company as required. 
 Support: Investigate safety and security breaches and non-compliance. Ensure that the required documentation is maintained, retained, and stored at all schools regarding Safety, Security and Safeguarding including training conducted, communications done, all reports generated, etc. Produce reports, attend meetings, and undertake any other duties, in line with the position, as required by the supervisors. 
 Preferred candidate profile:

 Experience: Minimum 5 years of previous experience in Security/Armed or such allied forces Preference will be given to experience in safety and security management in the Education industry, at a similar level. High level of contextual understanding of the political, social, economic, and security situation in India. Ability to undertake regular in-country travel to operational areas (40%). Previous risk management experience with the UN or NGOs/INGOs in India, or a strong background in educationrelated security. Relevant security industry certifications such as CPP PSP APP – PMP etc.

title: Information Technology Compliance Officer/Cybersecurity Risk Analyst
description:
A Senior Compliance Executive in a technology department plays a crucial role in ensuring that the organization adheres to various legal, regulatory, and industry-specific standards related to Information Technology and data management such as GDPR, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SoC2 Type 2, ISO 9001. 1. Regulatory Compliance Monitoring:
o Ensure the technology department complies with relevant laws and regulations, such as GDPR, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SoC2 Type 2, ISO 9001 and other data protection or cybersecurity laws.
o Stay updated on new or changing regulations that impact the tech landscape.
2. Policy Development & Enforcement:
o Develop and implement internal policies and procedures to ensure compliance with external regulations and internal standards.
o Regularly review and update policies to ensure they remain aligned with changing regulations and industry best practices.
3. Risk Management:
o Assess risks related to technology operations, particularly data privacy and cybersecurity risks.
o Ensure that the tech department implements appropriate security measures to mitigate potential threats and risks.
o Conduct regular audits and reviews of IT systems to ensure they meet compliance standards.
4. Training & Awareness:
o Educate and train technology teams and other employees on compliance-related matters, such as data security, privacy policies, and risk mitigation strategies.
o Promote awareness of compliance issues, helping staff understand their responsibilities in maintaining compliance.
5. Audit & Reporting:
o Prepare reports for management, regulators, or auditors, demonstrating compliance with relevant regulations and policies.
o Coordinate internal and external audits related to technology compliance.
o Implement corrective actions where necessary to address non-compliance findings.
6. Data Privacy Management:
o Oversee data protection strategies and ensure proper handling of sensitive information, including encryption, access control, and data retention policies.
o Manage consent collection and user privacy preferences in accordance with privacy regulations.
7. Incident Management:
o Oversee the handling of data breaches or other incidents that might affect compliance, ensuring timely reporting and response in accordance with regulatory requirements.
o Coordinate with relevant authorities if there is a need to disclose any breaches or security incidents.

title: Robotic Intern
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for students looking to kick-start their careers. Please review the Job Description shared below and apply if your skills and interests align with the role. 
 Position:  Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development (Internship)
 Location:  Ahmedabad (Fx31Labs Office)
 Address:  205, Amrakunj Avis, Near Tapovan Circle, Above Gwalbhog Restaurant, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424 
 Job Description: Fx31Labs is seeking a passionate and hands-on Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development  to join our advanced robotics team. This internship offers a fast-paced, end-to-end engineering experience involving aerial robotics, embedded systems, autonomous navigation, perception, and real-world prototype development.This role is ideal for students and early-career engineers looking to gain practical experience in designing, building, testing, and improving autonomous robotic platforms. 
 Key Responsibilities: Design & Build Assemble and integrate motors, ESCs, sensors, flight controllers, microcontrollers, and communication modules. Design and prototype electronic systems for rapid testing and development. Assist in mechanical assembly, wiring, and hardware integration of robotic platforms. Embedded Systems & Control Develop Python and C/C++ software for sensor integration, control systems, and autonomous behaviors. Interface with hardware using UART, CAN, IC, SPI, USB, and wireless communication protocols. Implement safety mechanisms, telemetry systems, and fault-detection routines. Autonomous Navigation & Perception Integrate sensors such as IMUs, GPS, LiDAR, cameras, depth sensors, and range finders. Develop and test localization, navigation, and obstacle-avoidance capabilities. Work with computer vision and perception pipelines for environmental awareness. ROS 2 & SLAM Implement and tune SLAM and localization frameworks using ROS 2. Work with tools such as Cartographer, RTAB-Map, Nav2, and related autonomy stacks. Support mapping, path planning, and autonomous mission execution. System Integration & Testing Integrate hardware, firmware, and software into a fully functional robotic system. Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and validation across electronics, software, and mechanical subsystems. Conduct field testing and analyze system performance. Rapid Prototyping & Iteration Build, test, evaluate, and refine prototypes through iterative development cycles. Document experiments, test results, and design improvements. Contribute innovative ideas to improve system reliability and performance. Team Collaboration Collaborate closely with robotics, embedded, AI, mechanical, and software engineers. Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, testing sessions, and technical discussions. Present findings, challenges, and proposed solutions to the engineering team. 
 Qualifications: Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with robotics, embedded systems, drones, autonomous vehicles, or related projects. Proficiency in Python and basic C/C++ programming. Understanding of sensors, control systems, communication protocols, and microcontroller-based development. Experience with hardware assembly, wiring, debugging, and soldering. Comfortable working on both software and physical hardware systems. 
 Nice-to-Haves: Experience with ROS 2 and robotic middleware. Knowledge of SLAM, localization, path planning, and autonomous navigation. Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, or similar robotics/autonomy frameworks. Familiarity with OpenCV, computer vision, or AI-based perception systems. Experience with Linux (Ubuntu) development environments. Familiarity with CAD tools such as Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or Onshape. Understanding of wireless communication systems and telemetry. 
 Soft Skills: Self-driven and highly proactive. Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Curious mindset with a passion for building real-world robotic systems. Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a rapid prototyping environment. Strong communication and teamwork skills. 
 Why Join Us? End-to-End Engineering Experience:   Work on complete autonomous robotic systems from design and prototyping to testing and deployment. Advanced Robotics Exposure:   Gain hands-on experience in embedded systems, aerial robotics, autonomous navigation, perception, and ROS 2-based autonomy. Learning & Mentorship:   Collaborate with experienced engineers and receive practical guidance in real-world R&D projects. Innovation-Driven Environment:   Be part of a team focused on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and cutting-edge technology development. 
 Internship Details: Duration:  3–6 Months
 Type:  Internship with mentorship, certification, and learning opportunities
 Location:  On-site at Fx31Labs, Ahmedabad 
 About Fx31Labs: Fx31Labs is an innovation-driven tech company delivering solutions at the intersection of robotics, AI, and software development. We specialize in building intelligent, scalable, and automation-first systems for startups and enterprises alike.

title: Planning Engineer/PPC Engineer
description:
Job description 
 Planning Engineer/ PPC Engineer(Production Planning and Control) Department : SCM & Operations
 Sub Department : Planning
 Work Location : Pirana, Near Ode Village, Aslali
 Mode of Work: In-office
 Working Days: Monday to Friday ( Saturday Sunday Week off)
 Working Time : 9:00 AM to 6.30PM
 Reporting To: SCM Head 
 About PressureJet Systems Pvt. Ltd. PressureJet Systems Pvt. Ltd. is a reputed manufacturing company in the high-pressure triplex plunger pump and engineered systems segment. We work with a strong focus on quality, timely delivery, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement. We are looking for a capable and result-oriented Senior PPC Engineer who can strengthen our production planning and delivery control system. 
 Role Summary The Planning Engineer/Sr. Planning Engineer will be responsible for planning, scheduling, monitoring, and controlling production activities to ensure on-time delivery of customer orders with the required quality and quantity. This role is highly important because PPC acts as the central coordination point between Sales, Production, Machine Shop, Procurement, Quality, Testing, Warehouse, and Dispatch. 
 Key Responsibilities Review sales orders daily and prepare production plans based on demand, resource availability, capacity, and lead time. Prepare detailed production schedules considering material availability, production capacity, and delivery commitments. Release job orders and purchase requisitions as per order priority and production requirements. Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Machine Shop, Quality, Testing, Warehouse, Sales, and Service teams for smooth order execution. Monitor daily production progress and ensure adherence to the planned schedule. Identify and resolve material shortages, capacity issues, production delays, and scheduling conflicts. Provide advance written communication to Sales / Application teams in case of expected delay, rescheduling, or quality rejection. Prepare delay feedback and RCA inputs to prevent repeated issues. Lead order delivery review meetings and guide execution priorities. Prepare weekly and monthly reports related to order status, delivery performance, late delivery RCA, and unreleased jobs. Required Qualification BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering Required Experience 2 to 5 years of experience in Production Planning & Control. Experience in a discrete manufacturing industry will be preferred. Experience in handling or coordinating with a small support team will be an added advantage. 
 Required Skills Production Planning & Scheduling Material Planning Capacity Planning ERP / SAP / Oracle knowledge Advanced Excel Progress Monitoring Inventory Management Data Analysis Problem Solving Cross-functional Coordination Follow-up and Reporting Delivery Performance Monitoring 
 What Kind of Candidate Are We Looking For? We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and growth-oriented Planning Engineer/Senior Planning Engineer who does not wait for instructions but actively takes ownership of planning, follow-up, coordination, and delivery commitments. 
 The ideal candidate should have: Positive attitude and willingness to take responsibility. Strong ownership mindset for customer order delivery. Habit of continuous follow-up until the task is completed. Strong belief in continuous learning and continuous improvement. Accountability for results, not only for assigned tasks. Confidence to communicate delays, risks, and issues in advance. Readiness to work in a challenging manufacturing environment. Getting things done attitude with discipline and professional maturity. At PressureJet, we value people who are active, accountable, positive, disciplined, and improvement-focused. If you are someone who wants to grow with responsibility and contribute directly to customer satisfaction, this role can be a strong career opportunity for you. 
 Who Should Apply? This role is suitable for candidates currently working as: PPC Engineer Senior PPC Engineer Production Planning Engineer Planning Engineer SCM Planning Engineer

Manage application builds, signing, versioning and release processes. Publish and maintain applications on Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Work closely with backend developers, UI and UX designers, QA and product teams. Participate in code reviews and maintain coding standards across the application. Experience with Firebase Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging, Analytics and other Firebase services. Good understanding of mobile application architecture and separation of UI, business logic and data layers. Experience with secure authentication, token handling and secure local storage. Experience integrating third party libraries and SDKs. Strong debugging and problem solving skills. Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows. Good understanding of Android and iOS application build and release processes. Experience publishing applications to Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Understanding of mobile application performance optimization and memory management. 

 Production Experience : Candidates must have worked on at least one production level Flutter application and should be able to explain their individual contribution to the application. Working with existing production code without affecting current functionality. Candidates should provide Play Store or App Store links for applications they have worked on wherever possible.

Experience with CI/CD and automated mobile application deployment. Experience working on B2C applications with a significant active user base. 

 What We Are Looking For : We are looking for a developer who has experience maintaining a real production application and not only developing standalone features or UI screens. description:
At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways. In this role, you will be responsible for evaluating, installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting complex network communication infrastructures to support seamless global connectivity . You will join a dedicated, collaborative global team that values operational reliability, innovation, and high-impact technical support. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion. 
 About the Role: Role : Service Desk Engineer – L2 Location: Bangalore, India (on-site) 
 1. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Service Desk Engineer (L2) to deliver second-level technical support to a geographically distributed employee base. The position is based in India and forms part of a follow-the-sun global service desk that provides continuous coverage to users located across India as well as international locations including the United States, the United Kingdom, the Philippines and Mexico. The successful candidate will act as the primary point of escalation for incidents and service requests that cannot be resolved at L1, taking end-to-end ownership from diagnosis through to resolution and closure. The role demands strong hands-on technical capability across end-user computing, endpoint management and endpoint security platforms, combined with the maturity to communicate effectively with users of varying technical proficiency and with senior stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones. This is a delivery-focused, customer-facing role within IT Operations. It requires disciplined adherence to ITIL-aligned processes, consistent achievement of service level agreements, and a proactive contribution to problem management, knowledge management and continual service improvement. 2. Scope of Support and Global Coverage •     The role is based in India; however, the supported user community is global. Support is delivered remotely to employees across all operating locations. •     Primary user base: employees across multiple office locations and remote sites within India. •     International user base: employees located in the United States, the United Kingdom, the Philippines and Mexico. •     Coverage is provided on a 24x7 rotational shift model, with shift allocation aligned to the business hours of the regions being supported (including North American, European and APAC time windows). •     All support is provided in English, using remote support tooling, voice, chat, email and the enterprise ticketing platform. No international travel or relocation is required. •     The engineer is expected to remain aware of regional public holidays, local business calendars and site-specific requirements when planning, prioritising and communicating on incidents. 
 3. Key Responsibilities 3.1 Incident, Request and Escalation Management •     Provide L2-level technical support, diagnosis and troubleshooting for end-user issues raised across all supported geographies. •     Own, manage and resolve incidents and service requests logged through Zendesk and Freshworks (Freshservice), ensuring resolution within agreed service level agreements. •     Act as the escalation point for L1 analysts; validate the accuracy of triage, provide guidance, and take handover of complex or ageing tickets. •     Prioritise and categorise tickets correctly based on business impact, urgency, VIP status and regional criticality. •     Escalate to L3 teams, infrastructure specialists or external vendors where required, retaining ownership of the user communication and follow-through until closure. •     Maintain timely, accurate and professional updates in the ticketing system so that users and stakeholders in any region have visibility of progress. 3.2 Endpoint and Device Management •     Administer, configure and troubleshoot corporate devices through Microsoft Intune, including enrolment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment and conditional access issues. •     Support Windows and macOS endpoints, covering operating system issues, patching, driver and peripheral faults, performance degradation and profile corruption. •     Manage device lifecycle activities such as provisioning, imaging, re-imaging, remote wipe, retirement and asset record accuracy for users across all supported countries. •     Troubleshoot mobile device management issues on corporate and BYOD devices in line with organisational policy. •     Provide support for collaboration and productivity platforms, including Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint, along with identity and access issues in Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory. •     Diagnose network connectivity and remote access issues, including Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS and printing, coordinating with network teams where required. 3.3 Endpoint Security and Compliance •     Monitor, triage and respond to endpoint security alerts and incidents raised through SentinelOne, taking appropriate containment action in accordance with defined runbooks. •     Investigate detections, perform initial analysis, quarantine or isolate affected endpoints and escalate confirmed threats to the information security team. •     Support security hygiene activities such as agent health verification, policy compliance checks, patch compliance reporting and remediation follow-up. •     Ensure that all support activity is carried out in line with organisational information security, data protection and access control policies, recognising that regional data handling requirements may differ. 3.4 Stakeholder Coordination and Global Communication •     Coordinate with team leads, regional IT contacts and senior stakeholders to drive resolution of complex, high-impact or escalated technical issues. •     Communicate clearly and professionally with users of differing technical backgrounds, adapting tone and language to the audience while maintaining a consistent service standard across all regions. •     Provide structured handover at shift change so that in-flight incidents transition seamlessly between engineers in the follow-the-sun model. •     Participate in major incident calls and bridge conversations when required, providing accurate status updates and endpoint-level diagnostics. •     Support onboarding and offboarding activity for joiners and leavers across all supported locations, ensuring timely and compliant completion. 3.5 Documentation, Reporting and Continuous Improvement •     Document root cause, diagnostic steps and resolution detail for every ticket, maintaining records to a standard suitable for audit and reporting purposes. •     Create and maintain knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures and self-help content to enable L1 shift-left and user self-service. •     Identify recurring and trending issues, contribute to formal root-cause analysis and propose permanent corrective actions. •     Contribute to automation and process improvement initiatives that reduce ticket volume, manual effort and resolution time. •     Support periodic reporting on ticket volumes, SLA attainment, backlog and regional service performance as required by leadership. 
 4. Required Skills and Technical Competencies •     4–5 years of demonstrable experience in a Service Desk, IT Support or End-User Computing role, with at least 2 years operating at L2 level. •     Prior experience supporting an international or multi-region user base, preferably including North America, EMEA or APAC locations. •     Hands-on administration experience with Microsoft Intune, covering device enrolment, compliance and configuration policies, and application deployment. •     Working knowledge of SentinelOne or an equivalent endpoint detection and response (EDR) platform, including alert triage and containment actions. •     Practical experience with enterprise ticketing platforms, specifically Zendesk and Freshworks (Freshservice), including queue management and SLA workflows. •     Strong troubleshooting capability across Windows and macOS operating systems, endpoint hardware, peripherals and commonly used business applications. •     Sound understanding of Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 administration, group policy and role-based access management. •     Working knowledge of core networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN and wireless connectivity troubleshooting. •     Familiarity with ITIL service management disciplines, particularly incident, request, problem and change management. •     Proven ability to work effectively in a 24x7 rotational shift environment while sustaining quality and responsiveness. 
 5. Preferred / Desirable Experience •     Exposure to remote monitoring and management, software distribution or patch management tooling. •     Experience with scripting or automation using PowerShell or a comparable language to streamline routine administrative tasks. •     Experience supporting VIP or executive users, including white-glove support standards. •     Familiarity with Jamf or other macOS management platforms. •     Prior experience in a managed services, shared services or global capability centre environment. 
 6. Behavioural and Interpersonal Skills •     Excellent verbal and written communication in English, with the clarity and cultural sensitivity required to support a multinational audience. •     Strong sense of ownership and follow-through, with the discipline to drive issues to closure without prompting. •     Professional, composed and customer-focused demeanour, particularly when handling escalations, outages or pressure situations. •     Effective coordination and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders. •     Analytical and structured problem-solving approach, with attention to detail in diagnosis and documentation. •     Adaptability and a positive attitude towards rotational shifts, changing priorities and evolving technology. •     Collaborative team orientation, with a willingness to mentor L1 colleagues and share knowledge openly. 
 7. Qualifications and Certifications •     Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. •     Relevant certifications are advantageous, including Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, ITIL Foundation, CompTIA A+ or CompTIA Network+. •     Vendor-specific training or certification on SentinelOne, Zendesk or Freshservice will be considered a plus. 
 8. Working Conditions •     Working location: India (Bangalore). The role does not require relocation or travel to overseas locations. •     Shift pattern: 24x7 rotational coverage, including night shifts, weekends and public holidays as per the published roster. •     Shift rotation is aligned to the business hours of the supported geographies (India, United States, United Kingdom, Philippines and Mexico) and is subject to periodic change based on business demand. •     Reliable participation in the roster, including planned coverage during peak periods and regional holiday windows, is a core requirement of the role. 
 9. Key Performance Indicators •     SLA attainment for response and resolution across assigned incidents and service requests. •     First-time-right resolution rate and reduction in ticket reopens or reassignments. •     End-user satisfaction and quality scores from post-resolution feedback. •     Accuracy and completeness of ticket documentation and asset records. •     Contribution to knowledge base coverage, L1 shift-left and reduction in recurring incidents. •     Timeliness of endpoint security alert triage and containment actions.

Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, automation, and engineering velocity through reusable patterns and process improvements. Collaboration & Leadership

Detail-oriented, collaborative, and adaptable in balancing technical and operational priorities.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Job Description I&O Platform Infrastructure Network Engineer Supervising Associate | Enterprise Technology   The opportunity In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a proven Network Engineer to support and evolve EY's global data center and enterprise network infrastructure. The role will provide engineering, operational support, automation and lifecycle management across EY's campus, data center and wide-area network environments. The successful candidate will work with cutting-edge networking technologies with a specific focus on routing and switching, data center fabric, network security, SD-WAN, load balancing and network automation.   Your key responsibilities The I&O Platform Infrastructure Network Engineer provides technical support and engineering of complex nature for the firm's global enterprise network platforms. This professional applies knowledge of multi-vendor routing and switching, data center networking, network security, WAN technologies and automation tooling to support enterprise-scale connectivity and availability. The role requires in-depth knowledge of the firm's network architecture to implement platform enhancements, lifecycle management activities, patching programs, security initiatives and operational improvements. The engineer will assist in maintaining highly available, high-performance network environments across global data center and office locations while ensuring compliance, resiliency and operational excellence.   Skills and attributes for success Strong experience designing and administering enterprise data center and campus network environments. Deep knowledge of routing protocols including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP and IS-IS. Strong Layer 2 switching experience including VLANs, STP, RSTP, MSTP and VPC/MLAG. Experience with Cisco, Arista or Juniper data center switching platforms (exclusionary). Experience maintaining mission-critical production network environments in a global data center setting (exclusionary). Experience supporting SD-WAN platforms (Cisco Viptela, VMware VeloCloud or equivalent). Strong knowledge of network security technologies including: Firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA/FTD, Fortinet or equivalent) Network Access Control (NAC) IDS/IPS VPN — IPsec and SSL/TLS Microsegmentation Experience with data center fabric technologies including: VXLAN EVPN Spine-leaf architecture ACI or equivalent SDN platforms Experience with load balancing platforms (F5 BIG-IP, Citrix ADC or equivalent). Knowledge of DNS, DHCP and IPAM (DDI) management. Experience with network automation and Infrastructure-as-Code tooling including: Ansible Python / Netmiko / NAPALM Terraform Experience with network monitoring and observability platforms (SolarWinds, PRTG, ThousandEyes or equivalent). Ability to create technical documentation, network diagrams and operational runbooks. Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks. Ability to work effectively with clients, management and global engineering teams.   To qualify for the role, you must have experience with Enterprise routing and switching administration — 5–7 years. BGP, OSPF and other dynamic routing protocol configuration and troubleshooting — 5–7 years. Data center switching platforms (Cisco Nexus, Arista EOS, Juniper QFX or equivalent) — 5–7 years. Layer 2 technologies including VLANs, VPC, MLAG, STP and trunking — 5–7 years. Enterprise firewall administration (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD, Fortinet or equivalent) — 5–7 years. SD-WAN deployment and operational management — 3–5 years. VXLAN/EVPN data center fabric design and administration. Spine-leaf architecture deployment and operations. F5 BIG-IP LTM/GTM load balancer administration. IPsec and SSL VPN configuration and troubleshooting. DDI management (DNS, DHCP, IPAM). Network automation scripting using Python, Ansible or equivalent. Network change management, patching and firmware lifecycle management. Network monitoring, alerting and capacity management. Packet capture and traffic analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump or equivalent). Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity planning for network platforms. Security hardening and vulnerability remediation of network infrastructure. Cloud networking fundamentals — Azure Virtual Network, AWS VPC or equivalent. Hybrid connectivity including ExpressRoute, Direct Connect or equivalent (preferred).   Ideally, you'll also have Cisco CCNP (Enterprise, Data Center or Security) certification (desired). Arista ACE certification (desired). Palo Alto PCNSE certification (desired). Juniper JNCIP certification (better to have). F5 201 / 301 certification (better to have). ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary). Cisco CCIE (Enterprise Infrastructure or Data Center) — better to have. Experience with network telemetry and streaming (gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig). Experience with Cisco ACI or VMware NSX SDN platforms. Familiarity with zero-trust network access (ZTNA) frameworks and implementation.   What we look for An experienced and technically strong network engineer to help build, maintain and modernize EY's global enterprise network infrastructure. We are looking for an individual with deep multi-vendor networking expertise, a passion for automation and security, and the ability to support highly available, high-performance network platforms while driving continuous operational improvement across EY's data center and wide-area network estate.

Key Skills: Routing and Switching,patch deployment,Arista,Vulnerability Management,Scripting,Networking,Security,Routing

The care team at Hinge Health is multi-disciplinary consisting of physical therapists, health coaches, nurse practitioners, care coordinators, orthopedic surgeons and will continue to evolve with new additional roles in the future. Our care team members execute complex clinical workflows as they coordinate and deliver timely, high quality care at scale for our members. As a product manager, you will be responsible for defining the vision, strategy and key objectives for the care team products that enable our care team members to deliver high quality personalized care at scale. This role will have a huge impact on the operational
effectiveness of the product and care teams and ultimately on our member, customer and
partner outcomes as it unlocks the ability to quickly experiment and iterate on key care team solutions.

title: Intern- UX Analyst
description:
Title: Intern- UI/UX Analyst, D2C Product 
 Who we are and Why we exist At The Whole Truth, our mission is to re-build the world s trust in its food . Consumers have lost faith in big food companies that hide behind misleading claims. We exist to change that with honesty, simplicity, and unmissable storytelling. We are India s first (and maybe only) 100% Clean Label food brand. That means we proudly declare every single ingredient on the front of the pack. But that s not all We don t just make products. We build brand love. Loudly, proudly, and consistently through content, community, and creative campaigns that break clutter. And now, we re ready to scale that brand love even further through smart, memorable, and well-placed media. That s where you come in. About The Role As Intern UI/UX Analyst, youll diagnose friction, design better user experiences, and validate improvements through data. Youre not a pure designer. Youre not a pure analyst. Youre the bridge - using session recordings, heatmaps, and funnel data to identify why customers drop off, and designing solutions to test. Key Responsibilities Session recording analysis - watch session recordings 2-3x/week to spot friction and user behavior patterns UX friction diagnosis - combine session data, heatmaps, and GA4 to build a prioritized list of improvements A/B test variant design - sketch solutions in Figma based on your findings; collaborate with the product and design teams on testing strategy Design system maintenance - collaborate with the design strategy team to document components and ensure consistency across the website Insight reporting - weekly conversion updates to the team; monthly deep dives on major findings Tool evaluation - research and recommend new UX testing tools (UserTesting, Maze, etc.) as you identify gaps in our workflow Youll collaborate closely with the product and engineering teams to drive user-centric improvements across the platform. 
 Technical Capabilities Required Design Tools Prototyping: Figma proficiency (non-negotiable) - component-based design, design systems, interactive prototypes Ability to create A/B test variants quickly and hand off clean specs to engineering Understanding of mobile-first design Analytics Data Tools( good to have): GA4 -funnel visualization, event tracking, custom reports (not deep SQL, but comfortable navigating the tool) Session recording tools - session recording, heatmaps, and user behavior identification Ability to interpret data and translate findings into design improvements Basic statistical thinking (correlation vs. causation, sample size matters) Platform E-Commerce Context: Familiarity of e-commerce platforms - enough to know whats possible and whats a technical constraint Familiarity with conversion funnel - browse add-to-cart checkout payment confirmation Tools You Can Learn Suggest: Youre encouraged to research and recommend new tools that fit your workflow - UserTesting, Maze, Hotjar, Pendo , etc. You should stay current on UX testing and session recording tools 
 Functional Capabilities Required Conversion Psychology: Understand micro-interactions that drive decision-making (button color, copy, social proof, urgency) Know how to reduce friction (form fields, payment options, trust signals) Apply JTBD (Jobs to Be Done) thinking - what job is the customer hiring this product for UX Research Data Literacy: Can read a session recording and identify 3-5 UX issues Can spot patterns in heatmap data (click clusters, scroll depth, attention areas) Comfortable asking "why" - always validate assumptions with data before designing A/B Testing Iteration: Design test variants based on hypothesis, not guesswork Understand statistical rigor (sample size, test duration, confidence levels) Iterate based on results - learn from losses, compound wins Communication Collaboration: Sketch ideas quickly in Figma and get feedback early Present findings to product and design teams in a structured way Comfortable with ambiguity - youll be expected to own problems, not just execute specs Required Skills Experience UX/UI design or product analytics experience (agency, SaaS, e-commerce, or D2C preferred) Figma expertise - can create designs, components, and interactive prototypes; not a designer by training, but by fluency Conversion psychology - understand how small UX changes impact user behavior Data literacy - comfortable with GA4 funnels, segment analysis, and session recording tools Mobile-first thinking - design for phones first, then desktop India D2C context - nice-to-have but not mandatory. Understanding of Indian customer behavior, payment methods, and logistics is valuable Written communication - can document findings clearly and present to non-designers 

 Disclaimer: This job posting and Location has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
