 We are looking for an experienced Senior Civil Engineer to manage and supervise civil construction activities for a premium high-rise residential development comprising 7 towers and 196 large 4 and 5 bedroom apartments in Ahmedabad . 
 The candidate will be responsible for day-to-day execution, quality, progress, contractor coordination and technical supervision of assigned towers/areas from structural works through finishing and handover. This is a site-based role requiring strong practical construction knowledge and the ability to independently identify and resolve execution issues. 

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Civil & Structural Execution Supervise RCC works including foundations, columns, shear walls, beams, slabs, staircases and other structural elements. Verify reinforcement, shuttering/formwork, levels, dimensions, line and alignment before concreting. Coordinate concrete pours and ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications and quality requirements. Monitor masonry, plastering, waterproofing, screeding and other civil works. Ensure construction is carried out strictly as per approved structural and architectural drawings. 
 2. Finishing Works Supervise and control finishing activities including: Flooring and stone works Internal and external plaster Waterproofing False ceiling coordination Doors and windows Painting Bathrooms and wet areas Balconies and terraces Faade-related civil interfaces Common areas, lobbies and staircases Maintain high finishing standards appropriate for a premium residential project. 
 3. Site & Contractor Management Manage and coordinate civil contractors, subcontractors and site supervisors. Allocate work fronts and ensure adequate manpower, machinery and materials are available. Monitor contractor productivity and identify delays or underperformance. Conduct daily site inspections and progress reviews. Ensure contractors rectify defective or incomplete work promptly. Verify contractor measurements and quantities before certification. 
 4. Drawing & Technical Coordination Review architectural, structural and relevant MEP drawings before execution. Identify drawing discrepancies and constructability issues before work begins. Raise RFIs and coordinate resolutions with architects, structural consultants and other consultants. Ensure only the latest approved drawings are being used at site. Coordinate civil openings, shafts, sleeves, embeds and other MEP requirements before concreting or finishing. 
 5. Quality Control Ensure all work complies with approved drawings, specifications, IS codes and project quality standards. Carry out pre-pour inspections and construction checklists. Monitor concrete quality, cube testing and other required material tests. Inspect reinforcement, shuttering, waterproofing, masonry and finishing works. Maintain inspection and quality records. Identify defective workmanship and ensure corrective action before subsequent work proceeds. Minimise rework through proper supervision and planning. 
 6. Planning & Progress Monitoring Work with the Project Manager and planning team to achieve project milestones. Prepare short-term execution plans and weekly work targets. Monitor actual progress against planned progress. Identify potential delays in advance and recommend corrective actions. Coordinate upcoming material, manpower, drawing and equipment requirements. Maintain daily and weekly progress records. 
 7. Material Management Estimate short-term material requirements based on planned activities. Coordinate with procurement and stores to ensure uninterrupted availability. Check incoming materials against approved specifications. Monitor consumption and minimise material wastage. Report abnormal consumption, shortages or misuse. 
 8. MEP & INTERDISCIPLINARY COORDINATION Coordinate closely with electrical, plumbing, fire-fighting, HVAC, lift and other specialist teams to ensure: Required openings and sleeves are provided correctly. Civil and MEP activities are properly sequenced. Services do not conflict with structural or architectural elements. Finished civil work is not unnecessarily damaged for subsequent MEP installation. 
 9. Safety & Site Discipline Ensure contractors follow project safety requirements. Coordinate with the safety team before high-risk activities. Maintain proper housekeeping and safe access throughout assigned areas. Stop or escalate unsafe construction practices when required. 
 10. SNAGGING & HANDOVER Conduct internal inspections before consultant/client inspections. Prepare and close snag lists. Ensure apartments and common areas meet required finishing standards before handover. Coordinate rectification of defects. Assist with as-built documentation and final handover. 

 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 
 812+ years of civil construction experience , preferably with significant experience in high-rise residential projects. Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering. Strong hands-on experience in RCC structure and residential finishing works . Experience independently handling at least one high-rise tower or substantial project zone is strongly preferred. Good understanding of construction drawings, specifications and IS codes. Experience coordinating architects, structural consultants, MEP teams and contractors. Ability to check quantities and contractor measurements. Strong understanding of construction sequencing and site logistics. 

 REQUIRED SKILLS 
 The candidate should demonstrate: Strong technical knowledge Excellent site execution capability High attention to quality and finishing Contractor management skills Problem-solving ability Ability to read and coordinate drawings Planning and organisational ability Strong communication and reporting Ability to work under schedule pressure Ownership and accountability 

 REPORTING STRUCTURE 
 Reports To: Project Manager / Construction Manager / Project Head Coordinates With: Architects, Structural Consultants, MEP Consultants, Planning Team, QA/QC, Safety Team, Procurement, Stores, Quantity Surveyors and Contractors. 

 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS 
 Performance will primarily be measured on: Quality of Work | Schedule Achievement | Rework Control | Contractor Productivity | Material Wastage | Snag Closure | Safety Compliance | Handover Readiness 

 IDEAL CANDIDATE 
 We are looking for someone who is site-oriented rather than purely office-oriented . The ideal candidate should be capable of walking onto a tower, understanding the current construction status, identifying technical or quality issues, coordinating the required teams and driving the work to completion without requiring constant supervision. Previous experience delivering premium or luxury high-rise residential projects from RCC through finishing and handover will be given preference.

title: Sr. Staff Engineer PD
description:
Job Summary The Physical Design Engineer delivers hands-on expertise in designing and implementing custom silicon solutions to meet detailed customer requirements. This role executes physical design flows-including synthesis, place-and-route, and verification-while applying standardized methodologies for efficient IP reuse, rapid turnaround, and high-quality tape-outs. Responsibilities Implement DFT architectures including ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, scan insertion, and analog test features Execute all phases of physical design: synthesis, floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis, place-and-route, timing closure, power/noise analysis, and signoff verification. Implement design strategies to achieve performance, area, and power targets for customer-specific ICs under lead guidance. Apply re-use methodologies, leveraging standard IP blocks, libraries, and flows to accelerate project execution. Resolve timing, congestion, and power issues in high-speed, high-density designs using EDA tools and scripting. Collaborate with RTL design, verification, DFT, and package teams to integrate requirements and ensure design convergence. Perform physical verification (DRC, LVS) and support debug for clean tape-out deliverables. Automate flows with TCL, Python, or Perl scripts to improve productivity and repeatability. Analyze design metrics and contribute to process improvements through data-driven insights. Other Responsibilities Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety Security requirements and programs. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 4+ years of hands-on physical design experience on SoCs, covering RTL-to-GDSII flows. Proficiency with EDA tools like Synopsys ICC2/Fusion Compiler, Cadence Innovus/Genus, or Mentor Calibre for synthesis, PNR, STA, and verification. Strong knowledge of STA (PrimeTime/Tempus), power analysis, and congestion mitigation techniques. Experience with scripting (TCL, Python, Perl) for flow automation and debugging. Familiarity with advanced nodes, multi-corner multi-mode (MCMM) analysis, and IP integration. Analytical mindset for tackling complex timing/power challenges and effective cross-team communication. Preferred Qualifications Experience with custom silicon for automotive, high-performance computing, or AI applications. Proactive in adopting new tools, flows, and best practices for re-use and efficiency. Detail-oriented team player committed to quality and on-time delivery.

 Larsen & Toubro Ltd, commonly known as L&T, is an Indian multinational conglomerate company, with business interests in engineering, construction, manufacturing, technology, information technology and financial services, headquartered in Mumbai. The company is counted among world's top five construction companies.

 Job Role: Internal Auditor

 Key Responsibilities: 
 Audit Planning: Develop and implement risk-based internal audit plans for project operations. Identify key risks associated with project execution, including financial, operational, and compliance risks. Design audit scopes, objectives, and timelines for reviewing projects. 
 Internal Control Evaluation: Assess the effectiveness and efficiency of internal controls related to project activities, including procurement, budgeting, financial reporting, and resource allocation. Identify weaknesses in controls and recommend improvements.

Identify potential risks in project management processes and suggest strategies to mitigate them. Review the efficiency of project resource utilization (staff, equipment, etc.). Conduct post-implementation audits to assess the success and sustainability of projects. 
 Reporting and Recommendations: Prepare audit reports with findings, conclusions, and recommendations for management. Present audit results to project managers, senior leadership, and other stakeholders. Follow up on audit recommendations to ensure corrective actions are implemented. 
 Advisory and Improvement Initiatives: Provide consultative support to project teams to strengthen internal controls and enhance risk management strategies. Offer insights for process improvements and opportunities for cost-saving and efficiency in project management. 
 Coordination and Collaboration: Collaborate with project managers, finance teams, and other stakeholders to gather audit evidence and ensure transparency. Work closely with external auditors where necessary, providing required documentation and insights.

title: Osp Design Engineer
description:
Title: Designer-II
 Business Unit: Telecom
 Operating Company: OSP
 Reports to: Supervisor
 Classification: Worker
 
 JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY 
The OSP Designer II creates project designs, estimates costs, identifies appropriate materials and equipment, creates drawings, and estimates project timelines for the placement of fiber optic cables, poles, conduit, transmission equipment and associated electronics. The OSP Designer II creates designs based on current and past network architectures. OSP Designer II will be responsible for performing quality checks on OSP designs.
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities 
 Effectively work on multiple fiber design projects from award to completion including site acquisition, engineering, permitting, construction and project closeout. Effectively communicate any obstacles that may impact budget or schedule to senior management and customer Read, analyze, & understand specific project scopes of work and translate into design requirements Provide suggested cable routings, drop/house/unit count and proposed/actual pedestal locations and other topographical data intended to afford design personnel the optimum opportunity to design the most effective plant placement. Mentor and assist newer designers. May be asked to have someone job shadow as a part of the training process. Learn from Qc points and improve for future projects Research system plant maps to determine system extension effects on surrounding cable plant and node placement sizing. Responsible for underground and aerial permitting with state DOTs, cities, counties, railroads, environmental, and other permitting authorities. Proficiency with IKE software is preferred but not required. Convert field notes, architectural, engineering and/or plan sketches into working construction drawings using the required software per customer specifications. Revise construction drawings per customer and internal redlines. Maintain a familiarity with individual client requirements and adapt to new client preferences. Work collaboratively with field staff and the permitting groups to prepare, draft, and review the necessary drawings for construction, permitting, and records. Perform moderate to complex CAD, GIS, WALDO or ARAMIS tasks Manage timelines and deliverable quality on small to medium sized projects with the assistance of the Project Manager. May perform as a project lead or technical specialist on the team on smaller projects Perform detailed checking and redlines work performed by others on assigned project(s). Work with the Manager to develop new templates, tool palettes, macros, LISPs, and other time saving processes. Ensure accurate project status tracking to facilitate project management reporting. Provide due date projection of the task to manager and complete the job within due date given. Regularly updating Site Tracker, Leave Tracker and Daily Status Tracker for project management. Ensure ADP hours are logged in time along with other trackers. 
 
 Managerial Responsibility 
 No direct reports. Review and Training Responsibility: 
 Has regular deliverable product review responsibility over peers and junior staff Train junior staff in different type of AT&T projects based on discussion with Senior OSP Designer (Managers) Train staff for CIVIC and other Designing projects on regular basis as instructed by Manager as core part of this role 
 Skills and Abilities Required 
 Proficiency in conduit, manhole, hand hole, underground, submarine, buried and aerial construction methods Proficiency with IQGEO tool is Preferred. Proficiency with ArcGIS is preferred. Proficiency using Verizons 3GIS and COFFEE systems is preferred. Proficiency using AT&Ts systems including, but not limited to, PACE, PED ASE, PED ADE Dynamite, Geolink/GPM, OBC, CSV, MIC, LMC, WCMT, Insight, FRVT, Transport Conversion SharePoint, TFW, ALM, Opti, OSP-FM, CFAS, IMAGINE, JAM, JPMTS, LFACS, MIC, NJUNS, Q MESSENGER, ARES, and ARAMIS is preferred. Proficiency in Copper jobs, F1 and ASE jobs along with the F2 and IQ jobs. Must demonstrate understanding of access networks on various fiber architectures Experience with fiber to the home (FTTH) networks is preferred Solid knowledge in OSP construction methods and practices as set by RUS, Telcordia, and BICSI Ability to review both technical and non-technical aspects of field work Ability to review work completed by others and adequately convey required corrections Effectively communicate and work with both internal Engineering and Project Management teams as well as customers Strong computer skills required, including proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite Basic mathematics skills, moderate special reasoning skills, and professional written and verbal communication skills Ability to set priorities for self and others and work in a fast-paced environment Ability to efficiently multi-task and work on several projects simultaneously Ability to sketch site layout and surrounding areas, read and take measurements Education and Experience Required 
 3-6 years of experience in telecom OSP engineering preferred. Degree in Engineering field Telecom design experience or fiber construction experience is preferred.

title: Principal Software Development Engineer
description:
Job Overview This is an expert-level position responsible for working with Product Development architects, management, and product managers to ensure products are meeting technical and business requirements; providing high-level research and analysis related to software design and development; solving complex problems; and establishing technical standards and best practices. This role sits at the heart of ELB Learning's flagship Lectora Online product as it enters an exciting period of modernization, including the delivery of new AI-powered authoring features. The successful candidate will be a senior member of a small, high-trust engineering team and will own significant architectural decisions across the product. Key Responsibilities Design and code units/modules that meet functional, non-functional, quality requirements on schedule; satisfying definition of done. Put forward accurate time estimates of work to be done on a project. Complete all scheduled tasks on time. Perform unit/module testing of software to find errors and confirm programs meet specifications. Fix bugs, add enhancements, and convert software to other platforms. Evaluate impact of software performance, and recommend improvements. Write and maintain documentation to describe program development, logic, coding, testing, changes, and corrections. Provide product content to technical writers and review for technical accuracy. Lead improvement of Product Development practices and procedures. Participate in design and code reviews with other developers. Assist quality assurance team and support personnel as needed to determine system problems. Mentor, train, develop, and serve as a knowledge resource for less experienced Software Engineers. Perform strategic research and design for a major technical area. Design patentable technology and propose and review patent applications. Serve as subject matter expert on product or components. Own a major component of the product. Work with marketing and product management to ensure ELB Learning's technology is positioned effectively. Participate in grooming of product backlog with product management, development, architecture, and other stakeholders. Communicate project status to all interested parties and ensure the team stays on track to satisfy business needs and client expectations. Ensure completeness and quality of all project deliverables. Identify and escalate issues and, when necessary, pull appropriate teams together to solve challenges/issues. Recognize potential risks and implement a course of action to address them appropriately. Provide leadership and direction for test automation, test planning, triage, isolation, and troubleshooting. Drive test plan reviews and continuous improvement efforts. Effectively communicate testing activities and findings in oral and written format. Develop and utilize automated test scripts to perform duties. Develop and execute customer-focused test cases and maintain associated records. Integrate test suites into the test management system and test harness. Visualize, articulate, and break down complex testing areas into simpler parts. Initiate and influence test strategies across specific product areas. Preferred Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field required, Master's degree preferred. Additional leadership training is beneficial. Work Experience 6+ years of experience in software development. Possess extensive experience with complex products and expert-level knowledge across multiple product areas. Experience in a technical lead role with demonstrated ability to mentor other Software Development Engineers. Skills & Competencies Expert-level design/debugging/coding skills. Quality-driven thought process. Complex problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Strong analytical skills. Strong technical skills. Familiarity with learning technologies preferred. Technical leadership. Self-motivated. Proactively solve problems for the benefit of the team. Strong teamwork skills for cross-group cooperation. Skilled in time management. Accurate time estimates. Ability to perform under pressure. Business domain expertise. Ability to prioritize workload. Coaching and mentoring skills. Requirements analysis. Defect root cause identification and analysis. Specific Skills & Technologies for this Position Primary Skills (required): Java 8 (deep expertise required): server-side application development. J2EE technologies (Web Applications, Servlets, Filters). Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web front-end frameworks. MySQL: schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning. Apache Tomcat: application server configuration, deployment, and tuning. Strong understanding of web application architecture, REST APIs, and multi-tenant SaaS patterns. Secondary Skills (strongly preferred): Experience migrating from monolithic architectures to modern frameworks (Vue 3, Tailwind CSS). Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and CI/CD pipelines. Nice-to-Have Skills: Exposure to AI / LLM-powered product features. Experience with the eLearning or content authoring domain.

title: Senior Embedded Linux Firmware Development Lead Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Embedded Linux Firmware Development Lead Engineer 
Job Description:
 Senior Embedded Linux Firmware Development Lead Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance, secure Linux-based systems for embedded devices (ARM/MIPS, IoT hubs, gateways). The role spans the full product lifecycle, from bootloader/board bring-up to kernel optimization, middleware integration, and production provisioning. The Embedded Lead will be responsible for designing and developing embedded systems architecture, integrating hardware and firmware components, and ensuring that embedded systems meet high-quality standards. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to define system requirements, develop architectural guidelines, and lead the development of innovative solutions to meet customer needs.
 Key Responsibilities:
 System Architecture & Design: Lead the architectural design of embedded Linux systems, selecting proper middleware, libraries, and kernel versions. Board Support Package (BSP) Development: Develop and maintain custom BSPs, including U-Boot optimization, Device Tree configurations, and kernel customization. Driver & Kernel Development: Write, debug, and optimize Linux kernel drivers and modules (I2C, SPI, UART, PCIe, USB, Display, Camera). User-space Development: Implement complex applications in C/C++ for embedded Linux, utilizing IPC, POSIX threads, and sockets. Build Systems & Toolchains: Build, maintain, and customize firmware images using Yocto Project or Buildroot . Performance Optimization: Optimize system boot time, resource usage (CPU/memory), and power consumption. Security & Over-the-Air (OTA) Updates: Implement secure boot, hardware security modules (HSM), and reliable OTA mechanisms (e.g., SWUpdate, Mender). Debugging & Testing: Drive deep debugging using GDB, JTAG, logic analyzers, and system tracing tools (perf, strace). Mentorship: Provide technical leadership and mentor junior engineers. Skills and Tools Required: - Strong experience in embedded systems design and architecture.
 - Proficient in programming languages such as C and C++, Python with hands-on experience in embedded domain Languages: Expert-level C/C++ programming; proficient in scripting (Bash, Python). Kernel/Driver: Deep understanding of Linux kernel internals, device drivers, and device tree. - Embedded web app experience is good to have - Expertise in Microcontrollers (STM32) and Microprocessors
 - Experience with real-time operating systems (FreeRTOS or any RTOS) and embedded Linux.
 - Knowledge of hardware design principles, including microcontrollers and microprocessors.
 - Familiarity with software development life cycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies. - Good to have Azure Deveops knowledge.
 - Experience with debugging tools and methodologies for embedded software.
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
 - Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and project management tools.
 Preferred Qualifications:
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in Electronics Engineering or a related field.
 Mandatory Skills WiFi, Embedded C, Communication Protocols

title: Robotic Intern
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for students looking to kick-start their careers. Please review the Job Description shared below and apply if your skills and interests align with the role. 
 Position:  Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development (Internship)
 Location:  Ahmedabad (Fx31Labs Office)
 Address:  205, Amrakunj Avis, Near Tapovan Circle, Above Gwalbhog Restaurant, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424 
 Job Description: Fx31Labs is seeking a passionate and hands-on Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development  to join our advanced robotics team. This internship offers a fast-paced, end-to-end engineering experience involving aerial robotics, embedded systems, autonomous navigation, perception, and real-world prototype development.This role is ideal for students and early-career engineers looking to gain practical experience in designing, building, testing, and improving autonomous robotic platforms. 
 Key Responsibilities: Design & Build Assemble and integrate motors, ESCs, sensors, flight controllers, microcontrollers, and communication modules. Design and prototype electronic systems for rapid testing and development. Assist in mechanical assembly, wiring, and hardware integration of robotic platforms. Embedded Systems & Control Develop Python and C/C++ software for sensor integration, control systems, and autonomous behaviors. Interface with hardware using UART, CAN, IC, SPI, USB, and wireless communication protocols. Implement safety mechanisms, telemetry systems, and fault-detection routines. Autonomous Navigation & Perception Integrate sensors such as IMUs, GPS, LiDAR, cameras, depth sensors, and range finders. Develop and test localization, navigation, and obstacle-avoidance capabilities. Work with computer vision and perception pipelines for environmental awareness. ROS 2 & SLAM Implement and tune SLAM and localization frameworks using ROS 2. Work with tools such as Cartographer, RTAB-Map, Nav2, and related autonomy stacks. Support mapping, path planning, and autonomous mission execution. System Integration & Testing Integrate hardware, firmware, and software into a fully functional robotic system. Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and validation across electronics, software, and mechanical subsystems. Conduct field testing and analyze system performance. Rapid Prototyping & Iteration Build, test, evaluate, and refine prototypes through iterative development cycles. Document experiments, test results, and design improvements. Contribute innovative ideas to improve system reliability and performance. Team Collaboration Collaborate closely with robotics, embedded, AI, mechanical, and software engineers. Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, testing sessions, and technical discussions. Present findings, challenges, and proposed solutions to the engineering team. 
 Qualifications: Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with robotics, embedded systems, drones, autonomous vehicles, or related projects. Proficiency in Python and basic C/C++ programming. Understanding of sensors, control systems, communication protocols, and microcontroller-based development. Experience with hardware assembly, wiring, debugging, and soldering. Comfortable working on both software and physical hardware systems. 
 Nice-to-Haves: Experience with ROS 2 and robotic middleware. Knowledge of SLAM, localization, path planning, and autonomous navigation. Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, or similar robotics/autonomy frameworks. Familiarity with OpenCV, computer vision, or AI-based perception systems. Experience with Linux (Ubuntu) development environments. Familiarity with CAD tools such as Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or Onshape. Understanding of wireless communication systems and telemetry. 
 Soft Skills: Self-driven and highly proactive. Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Curious mindset with a passion for building real-world robotic systems. Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a rapid prototyping environment. Strong communication and teamwork skills. 
 Why Join Us? End-to-End Engineering Experience:   Work on complete autonomous robotic systems from design and prototyping to testing and deployment. Advanced Robotics Exposure:   Gain hands-on experience in embedded systems, aerial robotics, autonomous navigation, perception, and ROS 2-based autonomy. Learning & Mentorship:   Collaborate with experienced engineers and receive practical guidance in real-world R&D projects. Innovation-Driven Environment:   Be part of a team focused on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and cutting-edge technology development. 
 Internship Details: Duration:  3–6 Months
 Type:  Internship with mentorship, certification, and learning opportunities
 Location:  On-site at Fx31Labs, Ahmedabad 
 About Fx31Labs: Fx31Labs is an innovation-driven tech company delivering solutions at the intersection of robotics, AI, and software development. We specialize in building intelligent, scalable, and automation-first systems for startups and enterprises alike.

title: Assistant Manager - Procurements
description:
Department : Procurement & Assurance
 Reporting To : Senior Manager Procurements & Assurance 

 Role Overview : The Assistant Manager Procurement is responsible for managing end-to-end procurement functions for construction, infrastructure, and CSR projects. The role involves planning, sourcing, vendor development, commercial evaluation, negotiations, contract and PO management, and close coordination with internal stakeholders to ensure timely, cost-effective, and compliant procurement. The position plays a critical role in ensuring value for money, quality assurance, donor/CSR compliance, and audit readiness across projects.
 Key Roles & Responsibilities
1. Project & Procurement Planning
 Prepare, maintain, and regularly update procurement plans and trackers aligned with project schedules.
Coordinate closely with project teams to understand BOQs, technical specifications, drawings, and timelines.
Align procurement activities with approved budgets, CSR guidelines, and donor requirements.
Support project teams in cost estimation, rate analysis, and procurement budgeting during planning and execution stages.
 2. Sourcing & Vendor Development
 Identify, evaluate, empanel, and onboard local, regional, and national vendors for construction materials, civil works, MEP works, and project-related services.
Float RFQs/RFPs/EOIs as per procurement policies and prepare Comparative Bid Analysis (CBA).
Conduct vendor meetings, technical discussions, site visits, sample/product evaluations, and due diligence checks.
Build and maintain a robust, reliable vendor database suitable for CSR and infrastructure projects across multiple locations.
 3. Commercial Evaluation & Negotiation
 Analyse bids and quotations based on cost, technical compliance, quality standards, delivery timelines, and risk parameters.
Lead and support commercial negotiations, including pricing, payment terms, credit periods, warranties, and delivery schedules.
Finalise commercial terms in coordination with project, finance, and management teams.
Ensure procurement decisions deliver value for money while adhering to CSR objectives and ethical procurement practices.
 4. Contract, PO & Documentation Management
 Prepare, issue, track, and manage Purchase Orders (POs), Work Orders (WOs), and Rate Contracts.
Review and monitor vendor contracts, service agreements, and work contracts in coordination with legal and management.
Ensure all procurement documentation complies with internal policies, donor guidelines, CSR norms, and statutory requirements.
Maintain complete procurement records including RFQs, CBAs, approvals, contracts, invoices, compliance certificates, and vendor documents.
 5. Audit, Compliance & Risk Management
 Ensure procurement processes are audit-ready at all times.
Support internal, statutory, and third-party audits by providing accurate and complete documentation.
Coordinate with auditors and internal teams to address and close audit observations within defined timelines.
Adhere to ethical procurement standards, conflict-of-interest policies, and transparency requirements.
 6. Stakeholder & Internal Coordination 
Act as a single point of contact for procurement-related requirements for assigned projects.
Maintain effective coordination with project teams, CSR teams, finance, accounts, legal, and management.
Provide regular procurement MIS, status updates, and reports to management.
Support smooth execution of projects by resolving procurement-related issues proactively.
 Required Skills & Competencies
 Strong understanding of construction and project-based procurement Sound knowledge of BOQs, civil materials, works contracts, and service agreements Proficiency in MS Excel / MS Office (CBAs, trackers, MIS, dashboards) Strong negotiation, vendor management, and commercial acumen Excellent coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills High level of integrity, compliance awareness, and attention to detail. 
 Qualifications & Experience
 Bachelors degree in Engineering (Civil) / Commerce / Supply Chain / Business Management or related field Minimum 7-10 years of relevant experience in construction, infrastructure, or CSR project procurement Prior experience in handling CSR-funded, donor-funded, or development sector projects is preferred. 
 Preferred Attributes Experience working with NGOs, CSR foundations, and private limited companies Ability to manage multiple sites, vendors, and parallel projects Willingness for field visits and site-level coordination Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under tight timelines Kannada, English and Hindi fluency is must .

Assists with managing the budget, capital expenditure projects, preventative maintece and energy conservation. Responsible for maintaining regulatory requirements. Assists with leading the emergency response team for all facility issues. CANDIDATE PROFILE Education and Experience - High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the engineering and maintece or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing. OR - 2-year degree from an accredited university in Building and Construction, Engineering, Mechanics, or related major; no experience required. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES Assisting with the Management of Engineering Operations and Budgets - Assists with managing the physical plant including equipment, refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment and electrical systems. - Assists with ensuring regulatory compliance to facility regulations and safety standards. - Assists with managing and controlling heat, light and power and recommends current best methods for energy conservation and economical facility operations. - Assists with the development of specifications and requirements for service contracts and administers such contracts to support building needs. - Distributes preventive maintece and repair work orders and monitors timeliness and quality of completion. - Assists with the oversight of the maintece of grounds, guestrooms, public space, restaurants, property vehicles and recreational facilities. - Assists with the development of a long term plan for preventative maintece and asset protection and overseeing execution of plan. - Assists with the development of project plans in accordance with renovation or new construction needs. - Coordinates with contractors for bids and construction to ensure timely completion of projects within budgetary guidelines. - Builds positive relationships with external customers such as city building/zoning department, fire prevention bureau and vendors. - Ensures fire crew has complete understanding of all procedures, equipment and alarms. - Performs monthly property inspection to ensure buildings and grounds are maintained in excellent condition. - Conducts guest room and common area inspection to ensure guest satisfaction. - Inspects and evaluates the physical condition of facilities in order to determine the type of work required. - Recommends or arranges for additional services such as painting, repair work, renovations, and the replacement of furnishings and equipment. - Selects and orders or purchases new equipment, supplies, and furnishings. - Manages parts and equipment inventory. Maintaining Property Standards - Ensures building and equipment licenses and certifications are current. - Maintains property life safety systems (fire fighting equipment, sprinkler systems and alarm systems). Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service - Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifying excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for guest relations. - Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters. - Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement. - Shares plans with property leadership and ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve guest satisfaction. - Strives to improve service performance. title: Associate Logistics
description:
Role Objective 
 The Associate - Logistics will be responsible for managing and improving courier performance across delivery, NDR, RTO, SLA adherence, customer-impact metrics, and operational escalations . The role will work closely with courier partners, Customer Support, Warehouse, Product, and internal Logistics teams to ensure that courier performance gaps are identified early, challenged with data, and driven to closure. The key objective is to ensure high delivery success, lower RTO, better TAT, minimal operational leakage, and strong courier accountability . 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Courier Performance Monitoring Monitor courier-wise performance on a daily basis across key metrics such as: Delivery % RTO % NDR % NDR conversion First-attempt delivery % Delivery TAT Ageing shipments SLA adherence Fake / incorrect attempts Customer complaints Identify deterioration in courier performance and take immediate corrective action. Track performance at courier, hub, pincode, zone, and shipment level wherever required. Maintain daily and weekly courier scorecards and highlight underperforming lanes or partners. Compare actual courier performance against agreed benchmarks and SLAs. 2. Courier Escalation Closure Act as the primary operational point of contact for assigned courier partners. Aggressively follow up on delayed, ageing, stuck, misrouted, or incorrectly updated shipments. Escalate recurring courier issues to the appropriate courier SPOCs and internal stakeholders. Challenge: Fake delivery attempts Incorrect NDR remarks Premature RTO Missed reattempts False customer-unavailable updates Operational delays Ensure every escalation has: Clear ownership Defined action Closure timeline Verified outcome Do not consider a case closed merely because it has been escalated; closure should mean that the required action has actually been completed. 
 3. NDR RTO Performance Management Track NDR performance across courier partners and identify high-risk cases. Ensure timely reattempts and appropriate courier action based on customer confirmation. Coordinate with Customer Support for customer-side closure and required delivery instructions. Identify avoidable RTO caused by courier or internal process gaps. Track courier-wise and pincode-wise RTO trends and initiate corrective actions. Support initiatives aimed at improving NDR-to-delivery conversion and reducing avoidable RTO. 4. Delivery TAT SLA Control Track dispatch-to-delivery performance against committed TAT. Identify shipment ageing and delivery delays before they become customer escalations. Monitor courier adherence to pickup, first attempt, reattempt, and delivery SLAs. Escalate abnormal delays by courier, hub, or geography. Work with courier partners on recovery plans where service levels consistently deteriorate. Maintain visibility of SLA breaches and ensure repeated issues are escalated appropriately. 5. Cross-Functional Coordination Coordinate with Warehouse teams for pickup, handover, manifest, and dispatch-related issues. Work with Customer Support for customer feedback, address correction, refusal validation, and delivery coordination. Coordinate with Product / Technology teams where systemic courier issues require process or platform improvements. Ensure there is no ambiguity in ownership between internal teams and courier partners. Drive closure of cross-functional dependencies impacting shipment performance. 
 Key Traits Required Strong follow-up and ownership mindset. Comfortable holding courier partners accountable. Data-oriented and comfortable identifying performance deterioration. Ability to work with high shipment volumes and multiple courier partners. Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills. High attention to detail. Ability to escalate firmly but professionally. Strong bias toward closure rather than only reporting problems. Comfortable working in a fast-paced ecommerce environment. 
 Skills Required Good understanding of ecommerce logistics, last-mile delivery, NDR, and RTO. Strong working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets. Ability to analyze operational reports and courier MIS. Good verbal and written communication skills. Experience working with courier dashboards, logistics aggregators, or shipment management platforms preferred. Basic knowledge of courier rate cards, zones, weight slabs, and billing will be an advantage. 
 Qualification Experience 
 Graduate in any discipline. 1-3 years of experience in ecommerce logistics, courier operations, last-mile operations, or supply-chain operations. Experience with a D2C brand, ecommerce company, logistics aggregator, or courier company preferred. Candidates with hands-on experience managing multiple courier partners will be preferred. 
 Work Experience: 1-3 years Working days: Monday - Saturday Location: Head Office - Okhla Phase 1 - Delhi 
 Perks: - Friendly atmosphere - High learning personal growth opportunity - Flexible Timings - Diverse work environment

As a part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn Nutrabay new things, solve new problems, build your competence and be a part of an innovative marketing-and- tech startup that s revolutionising the health industry. 
 Working with Nutrabay can be fun, and a place of a unique growth opportunity. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. description:

 We are looking for a Senior AI Architect to own the end-to-end technical architecture of a production-grade, multi-agent AI platform deployed within US-regulated financial institutions . This is a hands-on architecture role , not an advisory or strategy position. The architect will be responsible for critical design decisions across AI/ML platforms, cloud architecture, security, compliance, scalability, deployment, and operational reliability . The role involves working with Azure and GCP, Kubernetes, BYOC deployments, confidential computing, agentic AI, RAG, LLMOps/MLOps, identity and access management, encryption, and immutable audit architecture . Key Responsibilities 1. Platform Architecture Own the overall architecture of a multi-agent AI platform across Azure and GCP . Define component boundaries, data flows, integration patterns, and deployment topologies. Architect the Model Abstraction Layer for multi-model and multi-cloud flexibility. Design Blue-Green deployment strategies, traffic shifting, rollback, and regression gates. Design scalable AKS/GKE Kubernetes architectures including namespace isolation, node pools, workload identity, and resource management. 2. Security Architecture Architect BYOC / tenant-isolated deployments ensuring customer data remains within the client's cloud environment. Design offline cryptographic licensing using RSA/JWT-based mechanisms . Define encryption architecture using Azure Key Vault / GCP Cloud KMS, CMEK and TLS 1.3 . Design confidential-computing architecture for secure data processing. Architect private networking using Azure Private Link/Endpoints and GCP VPC Service Controls/Private Service Connect . Design Entra ID / Google Cloud Identity, SSO, Workload Identity Federation and RBAC . Define immutable, tamper-evident audit logging covering agent actions, HITL decisions, evidence retrieval, and output versions. 3. AI System Architecture Architect multi-agent / agentic AI pipelines , workflow orchestration, agent handoffs, HITL gates, and failure handling. Design RAG architectures , including embeddings, vector databases, chunking, indexing, retrieval optimization, and context management. Design deterministic tool architectures separating AI reasoning from data retrieval. Ensure tool access, evidence validation, errors, and data operations are fully auditable. Architect stateless and reproducible agent execution . 4. Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture Design multi-cloud architectures across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) . Architect persistence using Azure SQL / PostgreSQL, Azure Blob Storage / GCS . Design cloud-native observability using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging . Define secure container supply chains using Sigstore, Binary Authorization, Azure Container Registry and Google Artifact Registry . Establish Kubernetes admission and image-signing controls. 5. Enterprise Integration Architecture Design integrations with ERP, IAM, GRC and workflow platforms across on-premise and cloud environments. Architect GRC integrations using APIs and file-based interfaces . Define data mappings and output formats including JSON, PDF and CSV . Design deployment packages using Helm, Terraform and signed container images . Establish secure, zero-Anaptyss-access deployment processes. 
 Required Experience & Skills Architecture & Cloud 8+ years of enterprise software architecture experience. At least 3 years of AI/ML platform architecture experience. Experience designing production systems in regulated environments , preferably financial services. Strong cloud-native architecture experience with Azure and/or GCP . Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, IAM, encryption, networking and managed cloud services . Experience with BYOC / tenant-isolated deployment models . Architecture-level experience with confidential computing such as Azure Confidential Computing or GCP Confidential VMs. AI / ML Architecture Strong understanding of LLM inference architecture , model serving, API integration, latency optimization, token economics, and production failure handling. Hands-on experience architecting agentic AI / multi-agent systems . Experience with RAG architecture , embeddings and vector databases such as: pgvector Pinecone Weaviate Vertex AI Vector Search Equivalent technologies Strong understanding of LLMOps / MLOps , model versioning, Blue-Green deployments, regression testing, monitoring, and output-quality controls. Understanding of LLM security risks including prompt injection, data exfiltration, and context manipulation . Security & Compliance Strong knowledge of RSA, JWT, asymmetric cryptography and key management . Experience with cloud security architecture covering: CMEK TLS Secrets management Network security Confidential computing Strong knowledge of SAML/OIDC, SSO, Workload Identity Federation and RBAC . Experience designing immutable audit logs and tamper-evident audit trails . Familiarity with US banking technology-risk frameworks such as OCC, Federal Reserve SR Letters and FFIEC guidance . Engineering & Documentation Ability to create detailed architecture artefacts including: Component architecture diagrams Data-flow specifications Interface contracts Security boundaries Deployment topologies Experience preparing technical documentation for enterprise architecture, information security, model risk and regulatory review . Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript sufficient to review code and prototype architectural concepts. Good to Have Experience working directly with bank technology risk, information security or enterprise architecture teams . Multi-cloud architecture experience across both Azure and GCP . Confidential computing implementation experience including attestation, enclave programming or sealed storage . Experience designing software licensing and IP protection systems for customer-hosted deployments. Experience with SOC 2 Type II audit preparation . Why Join Us? title: Chief Sales Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY 
 
Chief Manager Sales will be responsible for driving Order Booking, Revenue Growth, Customer Engagement, and overall business development for the region. The incumbent will own the complete Order-to-Cash (O2C) cycle, build strategic customer relationships, identify new business opportunities, and work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver profitable growth. 
 Key Result Areas: 
 Business Growth & Sales 
 Deliver annual and quarterly Order Booking (OB), Revenue and Gross Margin targets for the Western Region. Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with the company's business objectives. Identify and convert new business opportunities across Utilities, EPC Contractors, Renewable Energy, Metro Rail, Railways, Data Centers, Industries and Infrastructure sectors. Drive market penetration for MV, HV and EHV Power Cable solutions. Customer Relationship Management 
 Build and nurture long-term relationships with key decision-makers across: State & Private Transmission Utilities Distribution Utilities EPC Contractors Renewable Energy Developers Metro Rail Corporations Industrial & Infrastructure Customers Consultants and Project Developers Engage with CXOs, procurement teams, consultants and project execution teams to enhance customer satisfaction and increase wallet share. Position Sterlite Electric as the preferred partner for strategic projects. End-to-End Order-to-Cash (O2C) Ownership 
 Own the complete sales lifecycle from opportunity identification to final payment realization. Lead customer qualification, solution selling, techno-commercial discussions and negotiations. Coordinate with Tendering, SCM, Engineering, Projects, Finance, Legal and Commercial teams to ensure seamless order execution. Monitor order execution, dispatches, billing, payment milestones and collections. Drive timely receivable collections and ensure healthy cash flow and working capital management. Tendering & Commercial Excellence 
 Lead strategic bidding decisions and pricing discussions. Review commercial risks, contractual terms and bid strategies. Support preparation of competitive techno-commercial proposals. Participate in customer negotiations and contract finalization. Market Intelligence & Business Development 
 Track upcoming projects, government investments and market trends. Monitor competitors, pricing strategies and emerging business opportunities. Develop account growth plans for strategic customers. Identify opportunities for cross-selling and new product introductions. Cross-Functional Leadership 
 Work closely with Product Management, Tendering, Engineering, SCM, Projects and Finance teams. Ensure timely internal approvals and customer clearances. Drive collaboration to improve conversion ratio, execution efficiency and customer experience. Reporting & Governance 
 Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast. Review regional business performance periodically. Ensure compliance with company policies, governance and ethical business practices. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Achievement of Order Booking (OB) Targets Revenue Achievement Gross Margin Achievement Sales Pipeline Development and Conversion Customer Acquisition & Key Account Growth Tender Success Rate Timely Completion of Order-to-Cash (O2C) Cycle Receivable Collections & Reduction in Outstanding Debtors FCFO Contribution through Improved Collections Customer Satisfaction & Relationship Development Market Share Growth across Western India Preferred Experience 
 15-18 years of experience in Sales, Business Development or Key Account Management within the Power, Electrical or Infrastructure sectors. Strong exposure to HV/EHV Power Cables, Conductors, Electrical Equipment, EPC or Transmission & Distribution businesses. Experience working with Utilities, EPC Contractors, Renewable Energy Developers, Metro Rail Projects or Industrial customers. Proven track record of achieving large order booking and revenue targets. Experience in managing strategic customer relationships and large-value commercial negotiations. 
 Educational Qualification 
 Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (preferred). Engineering graduates with relevant industry experience may also be considered. MBA in Marketing or Business Management will be an added advantage. 
 Key Competencies 
 Strategic Sales & Business Development Key Account Management Customer Relationship Management Techno-Commercial Negotiation Tendering & Contract Management Financial & Commercial Acumen Market Intelligence Leadership & Team Collaboration Analytical Thinking Influencing & Stakeholder Management Results Orientation Strong Communication & Presentation Skills

title: Autonomy Specialist, India (R6015)
description:
Job Summary 
 Shield AI is seeking a high-performing Business Development / Account Executive to drive growth for Hivemind Autonomy across India, with a primary focus on India defense and government customers. This role is responsible for identifying, shaping, and closing complex opportunities while building enduring customer relationships and executing disciplined capture strategies. You will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Product, Engineering, and Strategic Engagement teams to align customer needs with Hivemind's autonomy capabilities and deliver mission-critical outcomes. The ideal candidate is a customer-first, technically credible seller with strong capture instincts, experience navigating defense acquisition processes, and a proven track record of winning and expanding strategic accounts. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Own and drive the full sales lifecycle for Hivemind opportunities across assigned accounts/territories (pipeline generation through close) Develop and execute territory and capture strategies for priority pursuits, aligning with Shield AI's long-term strategic plan Identify, qualify, and shape new business opportunities through deep understanding of customer missions, budgets, and acquisition pathways Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, program offices, and influencers across defense and government customers Lead proposal development in partnership with BD Operations and cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and value propositions Conduct competitive analysis and position Hivemind effectively in complex, multi-stakeholder environments Partner with Product, Engineering, and Solutions teams to translate customer needs into compelling technical and operational solutions Manage deal progression with rigor (qualification, deal strategy, forecasting accuracy, CRM hygiene) Represent Shield AI at industry events, conferences, and customer engagements to expand market presence and pipeline Communicate clearly with internal stakeholders and leadership on pipeline status, risks, and key milestones 
 
 Measures of success (First 6-12 months) 
 Strong pipeline generation and progression within assigned accounts and territories Successful execution of capture strategies resulting in qualified opportunities and wins Improved deal velocity and win rates through disciplined qualification and positioning Establishment of trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders and partners Consistent, accurate forecasting and high-quality CRM and pipeline hygiene Meaningful contribution to revenue growth across the International Hivemind business 
 
 Required qualifications 
 10-15+ years of experience in business development, sales, or capture roles in technically complex domains (AI/ML, autonomy, SaaS, aerospace/defense, or similar) Proven track record of owning and closing deals, particularly within U.S. government or defense markets Deep understanding of defense acquisition processes and government procurement lifecycle Strong experience developing and executing capture strategies for complex opportunities Technical aptitude and ability to engage credibly with Engineering, Product, and Operational stakeholders Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills Self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of operating in a fast-paced environment Bachelor's degree required Fluent in: English 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience selling autonomy, AI/ML, or unmanned systems (UAS) solutions a plus Prior military experience Established relationships within defense, government, or aerospace customer sets Experience working with Large Systems Integrators (LSIs) and strategic partners Ability to travel as needed for customer engagements and industry events Active or eligibility for security clearance MBA or equivalent graduate degree

Partners with the Milestone HR manager in communicating benefit program trends, outcomes, return on investment, and targeted improvement solutions leadership. Prepares agendas and meeting materials. Develops and reports on benefit metrics. Leverage data from HRIS, vendors and brokers to create analytics to make data-driven strategy decisions. title: Senior Field Sales Manager
description:
Senior Field Sales Manager Manufacturing • Delhi NCR Full-time • Field-first • 2 openings • Reports directly to the founder COMPENSATION 60,000 - 1,00,000 / month fixed Commission: 3-7% on every deal you source. Also covered Petrol reimbursed THE ROLE Factory owners don't find software on Google. They buy from people they trust — people who've walked their belts for years. That's you. Your job in one line: work your network, walk the clusters, build our introducer channels, put founders in front of owners in pain. Your territory is the industrial heart of your city: NCR: Faridabad, IMT Manesar, Okhla, Noida, Sahibabad, Bhiwadi. Your week runs on four motions: Your Network — the owners who already know your face from years in the belt. You re-open those doors, now for Facto. Factory visits — walking clusters, meeting owners and plant heads, scoring their pain against our framework, booking demo meetings that the founders close. The back doors — machine dealers, CAs, suppliers, bank RMs, ex-Tally/Marg partners, association circles. You recruit them as introducers (they earn on every deal they bring), keep them warm, and own this channel. Referral chains — every conversation, even the rejections, ends with “Which owner-friend of yours has this same problem?” You'll sell shoulder-to-shoulder with the founders : you get us into the room and own the relationship; founders run the demo and the close — for now. Master the product, and the close becomes yours. That path is real, and it's written down. WHAT YOUR WEEK LOOKS LIKE — HONESTLY Full field days walking clusters — 7–10 factory visits on door days, one belt at a time, on your own two-wheeler, in every season Chai meetings with dealers, CAs, and connectors who become your referral engine Conversations in Hindi with promoters, GMs, plant heads — past gates, past gatekeepers; a plant floor at 9 am and a promoter's cabin at 11 am Every visit and every partner touch logged in Neev the same day — what isn't written didn't happen, and that rule applies to everyone here A daily 15-minute sync and a weekly ride-along with the founders Rejection, heat, chai at the gate — and the owner who says “finally, someone gets it.” That last one is why the job exists. Read that list again. If any of it made you hesitate, this job isn't for you — and that's the point of this section. WHO THRIVES HERE 10 - 15 years of field sales to factory and business owners — machinery, industrial consumables, SME lending, or the Tally/Marg/Busy ecosystem — and you are still personally in the field today. If you've graduated to a desk and a team, this isn't your job. A live network: owners in your city's belts who would take your call this week. In the interview, we'll ask you to open your phone and show us. We mean it. Street smart over MBA smart — you know who the real decision-maker is, who influences them, and how to move both Trusted first, then bought from — because you're genuinely curious, not because you read a sales book Fluent Hindi, own vehicle, already living in your city's industrial world Hungry: you've hit the ceiling where you are, and you want a job where the ceiling is yours to set You don't need polished English, a SaaS background, ji or an MBA. We'll teach you the product. We can't teach hunger, trust, or years of relationships.

 About Swaran Soft 
Swaran Soft is an enterprise AI and digital transformation company headquartered in Gurugram, India, with offices in the UAE, Estonia, and the USA. Our Agentic AI Consulting & Managed Services division our fastest-growing practice builds intelligent automation platforms for large Indian and Middle Eastern enterprises across BFSI, telecom, healthcare, and manufacturing.
 
We combine open-source infrastructure, India-localised AI (including sovereign models such as Sarvam AI, BharatGen, and Krutrim), and deep integrations with WhatsApp, Microsoft Teams, CRM, and telephony stacks to deliver AI that speaks the enterprise's language literally.
 
Our entry point with clients is a fixed-fee, 8-week Agentic AI pilot a no-competition proposition that gives enterprise buyers a low-risk path to demonstrable ROI. Beyond pilots, we offer full rollout, managed services, and custom application development.
 
Visit www.swaransoft.com to explore our services, case studies, and what life looks like at Swaran Soft.
 
 The Role 
This is a consultative, solution-selling role not a product sales job. You will be selling transformation, not licences. Your buyers are CXOs, IT Heads, and VP-level decision-makers at mid-to-large enterprises who are evaluating Agentic AI as a genuine business lever.
 
You will own the full sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, solution design conversations, proposal development, stakeholder navigation, and deal closure. You will work closely with our technical consulting team to shape pilot proposals and full-scale AI transformation roadmaps.
 
If you have sold complex technology solutions to enterprise clients and want to now sell AI at the frontier where every conversation is about genuine business impact this role was built for you.
 
 
 What You Will Sell

3) Managed AI Services ongoing LLM tuning, agent monitoring, SLA-backed support, and performance optimisation

8) AI for Middle East Enterprises sovereign-data-compliant, VPC and on-premise deployable AI platforms 
 Senior Enterprise Sales Manager / Business Development Lead (6-10 Years Experience) 
 You are a seasoned enterprise sales professional who has closed large, complex, multi-stakeholder technology deals. You can build a territory from scratch, manage a team, and represent Swaran Soft at the most senior levels of enterprise engagement in India and the Middle East. 
 Responsibilities 
 Own and grow Swaran Soft's enterprise sales pipeline across India and Middle East markets

¢ Experience with multilingual or India-localised enterprise software propositions

title: Digital Marketing Executive / Specialist
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING EXECUTIVE / SPECIALIST 
 Join PRNV Services and Grow With a Fast-Expanding Digital Platform 
 Company: PRNV Services Location: Hyderabad Work From Office Employment Type: Full-Time Experience:1.5 to 5 Years Salary: 1,80,000 6,00,000 Per Annum Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Working Days: 6 Days a Week Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred 
 --- 
 About PRNV Services 
 PRNV Services is a growing advertising and service marketplace focused on connecting customers with service professionals while providing transparent and affordable service solutions. 
 We are looking for a creative, experienced, and result-driven Digital Marketing professional who can strengthen our online presence, generate leads, improve search visibility, increase customer engagement, and grow our digital channels. 
 The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on knowledge of digital marketing and be capable of taking ownership of marketing activities from planning and execution to performance analysis and optimization 
 Candidates with 1.5–5 years of experience will be considered based on their practical skills, experience, and ability to deliver results. 
 --- 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Digital Marketing Strategy & Execution 
 * Plan and execute digital marketing activities across multiple online channels. * Develop and implement digital marketing campaigns aligned with business objectives. * Identify opportunities to increase website traffic, leads, customer engagement, and brand visibility. * Create integrated and cost-effective digital marketing strategies. * Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimize activities. 
 SEO & Website Optimization 
 * Perform keyword research, competitor analysis, and search-intent analysis. * Implement On-Page, Off-Page, Technical, and Local SEO activities. * Optimize website pages including: 
 * Meta Titles * Meta Descriptions * H1 / H2 headings * Internal Linking * Content * Image optimization * URLs * Monitor keyword rankings and organic traffic. * Work with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. * Identify technical and content-related SEO opportunities. * Coordinate with the development and content teams for website improvements. 
 Social Media Marketing 
 * Manage and improve PRNV Services' social media presence. * Plan and coordinate content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms. * Develop social media campaigns and promotional activities. * Coordinate with the Graphic Design and Content teams. * Monitor audience engagement and identify new content opportunities. * Stay updated with social media trends and recommend new campaigns. 
 Paid Advertising 
 * Assist with and independently manage Google Ads campaigns based on experience. * Work on Meta Ads campaigns for brand awareness and lead generation. * Monitor advertising budgets, clicks, conversions, CPL, and campaign performance. * Test and optimize advertisements, audiences, keywords, and landing pages. * Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance and cost-effectiveness. 
 Analytics, KPIs & Reporting 
 * Monitor website traffic, keyword rankings, leads, conversions, and campaign performance. * Track important digital marketing KPIs. * Measure campaign ROI and performance. * Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly digital marketing reports. * Analyze data and provide actionable recommendations. 
 Lead Generation 
 * Develop digital strategies for generating quality leads. * Track leads from different digital channels. * Analyze lead sources and conversion performance. * Work with the sales/customer-support team to improve lead conversion. * Identify new digital channels and opportunities for customer acquisition. 
 Competitor & Market Research 
 * Conduct competitor and market research. * Monitor competitor websites, SEO strategies, social media, advertisements, and campaigns. * Identify new trends and marketing opportunities. * Recommend new strategies based on market insights. 
 Team & Cross-Functional Coordination 
 * Coordinate with Marketing, Sales, Design, Content, and Development teams. * Provide digital marketing requirements and briefs to the relevant teams. * Ensure consistency across PRNV's digital channels. * Candidates with higher experience may be responsible for guiding and managing junior marketing team members. 
 --- 
 Required Skills 
 * 1.5 to 5 years of practical experience in Digital Marketing. * Good knowledge of SEO and keyword research. * Understanding of On-Page, Off-Page, Technical, and Local SEO. * Working knowledge of Google Search Console. * Working knowledge of Google Analytics. * Basic to advanced knowledge of Google Ads depending on experience. * Knowledge of Meta Ads. * Experience with social media management. * Good understanding of digital marketing channels and best practices. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Good communication and interpersonal skills. * Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks. * Good knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets for reporting and data tracking. 
 --- 
 Preferred Skills 
 * Local SEO * Google Business Profile * Google Keyword Planner * Ahrefs * SEMrush * CRM tools * Lead-generation campaigns * Email Marketing * WhatsApp Marketing * Content Marketing * Conversion Rate Optimization * Marketing Analytics * AI marketing tools * Prompt Engineering 
 --- 
 Technical / Website Knowledge – Advantage 
 Basic understanding of web technologies will be an advantage, especially for candidates working closely with the development team. 
 Frontend 
 * HTML * CSS * Tailwind CSS * React * Next.js 
 Backend 
 * Laravel * Filament Admin * MySQL 
 API 
 * Laravel API 
 Mobile 
 * React Native * Expo 
 Note: Candidates do not need to be developers. Basic technical understanding and the ability to communicate website/SEO requirements with developers will be an advantage. 
 --- 
 What We Are Looking For 
 We are looking for someone who can think, execute, analyze, and improve . 
 The candidate should be able to: 
 Plan Execute Monitor Analyze Optimize Report Improve 
 For candidates with 3–5 years of experience , additional responsibility may include: 
 * Developing overall digital marketing strategies. * Managing campaigns independently. * Guiding junior team members. * Planning marketing activities and budgets. * Managing KPIs and ROI. * Developing inbound marketing strategies. * Taking greater ownership of PRNV's digital growth. 
 --- 
 Qualification 
 * Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a relevant field. * Digital Marketing certification is an advantage. * 1.5–5 years of relevant practical experience. 
 --- 
 What We Offer 
 * Salary: 1.8 LPA – 6 LPA , based on experience, skills, and performance. * Opportunity to work with a growing startup and technology-driven service marketplace. * Hands-on experience across SEO, social media, paid advertising, lead generation, analytics, and content marketing. * Opportunity to work with modern AI and digital marketing tools. * Opportunity to take ownership of digital marketing activities. * Learning and professional growth opportunities. * Performance-based career growth. * Exposure to PRNV's expansion and digital growth initiatives. 
 --- 
 Immediate Joiners Preferred 
 Candidates who can join immediately or within a short notice period will be given preference. 
 --- 
 Selection Process 
 1. Resume Screening 2. Digital Marketing Practical Assessment 3. Technical Interview 4. HR Interview 5. Final Management Discussion 
 Selection will be based on practical knowledge, experience, creativity, analytical ability, communication skills, and ability to deliver measurable results . 
 --- 
 How to Apply

title: AI SEO / AEO / GEO & Content Marketing Intern
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 AI SEO / AEO / GEO & Content Marketing Intern 
 iLogBC | International Logistics & Blockchain Consulting | www.ilogbc.com 
 Location : Noida | Hybrid - maximum 2 days per week from office 
About the Role
We are looking for a curious, analytical and execution-oriented intern to work with the iLogBC team on building visibility across traditional search engines, answer engines and generative AI platforms. The role will combine AI-first search research, SEO, AEO, GEO and B2B content development, with a strong focus on logistics, shipping, supply chain, infrastructure, manufacturing, India market entry, finance, transactions and advisory services.
What You Will Work On
 Conduct AI-focused keyword research and identify high-value commercial and informational search opportunities. Research search intent, conversational queries and the way users ask questions through AI-powered search experiences. Map keywords and questions to relevant website pages and identify priority pages and content opportunities. Support SEO research and prepare recommendations for targeted pages, including SEO title tags and meta descriptions. Conduct AEO research covering question-based searches, FAQs, answer opportunities and featured-answer opportunities. Research GEO opportunities by analysing topics, entities, AI-search queries, topical authority and opportunities for stronger brand association. Support the development of topic clusters and content themes around iLogBC's specialist industry areas. Identify content opportunities and help build an editorial/content calendar. Create and refine SEO-focused, AEO-focused and GEO-focused content, including industry insights and expert-led content. Support content publishing and maintain basic content-performance tracking. Track visibility across branded, high-value commercial, FAQ/conversational and AI-oriented search queries. Document findings, recommendations and progress in clear, structured reports and working sheets. What We Are Looking For
 0 to 2 years of experience in SEO, digital marketing, content marketing, market research, AI search, communications or a related area; freshers with strong aptitude are encouraged to apply. Good understanding of Google Search, keywords, search intent and basic SEO concepts. Strong interest in how ChatGPT and other generative AI/search platforms influence how people discover information, companies and services. Strong research and analytical ability and comfortable finding patterns, comparing search results and converting observations into actionable recommendations. Good written English with the ability to write clear, concise and professional business content. Comfort with Excel/Google Sheets, presentations and basic digital research tools. Ability to learn independently, ask good questions and work with subject-matter experts. Attention to detail and willingness to execute repetitive research tasks accurately. Interest in B2B, logistics, shipping, supply chain or technology is an advantage. Key Skills
 SEO & Keyword Research Search Intent Analysis AI Search / Generative AI Research Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) Content Research & Writing Topic & Entity Mapping Content Planning Data Analysis & Reporting Excel / Google Sheets Research & Documentation What You Will Learn
 How modern search is evolving from conventional search engines toward answer and generative AI experiences. Practical application of AI SEO, SEO, AEO and GEO in a B2B consulting environment. How search intent, questions, entities and topical authority influence discoverability. How to translate research into content strategy, page recommendations and measurable search opportunities. How industry expertise can be structured into content that is useful to business decision-makers. Exposure to the logistics, shipping and supply-chain industry and its technology ecosystem. Performance & Conversion
This is a 3 to 6 month internship designed as a hands-on learning and execution role. Interns will be evaluated on research quality, analytical thinking, content quality, ownership, accuracy, consistency, learning agility and ability to convert findings into useful business outputs. Based on performance and business requirements, the internship may lead to a full-time employment opportunity. Conversion is not automatic or guaranteed.
Who Should Apply
This opportunity is particularly suited to candidates who enjoy research, writing, digital marketing and emerging AI technologies and want to build practical expertise rather than only perform routine social-media or promotional activities.
How to Apply 
Please share your CV along with 2 to 3 examples of relevant work, if available (SEO research, articles, blogs, content projects, academic research, digital marketing projects or similar). Email contact@ilogbc.com
