title: Management Trainee - Target Market Management
description:
We are looking for candidates with 1 to 3 years experience in Building Material/Construction Chemical/Paint Industry. Bachelors in Civil Engineering + Masters in Construction Management. This is 18 month Traineeship Program with Regional Level exposure. Subjective to performance, Trainee will be confirmed as Full Time employment with Sika post completion of Training. 
 Title: Management Trainee- Target Market Management 
 Location: Nerul, Navi Mumbai 
 Mentor: Director Target Market & Product Management 
 About the Programme Kick-start your career through our structured 18-month Management Trainee Programme , designed to develop high-potential talent into future professionals and leaders within our organization. The programme offers an accelerated learning journey that combines structured on-the-job training, formal learning, mentoring, coaching, and project-based assignments. Throughout the programme, you will progressively build technical expertise, business acumen, and leadership capabilities while gaining valuable hands-on experience in your chosen function. 
 As a Management Trainee, you will be assigned to a sponsoring department and follow a structured learning journey tailored to your function. While developing specialized knowledge within your department, you will also participate in company-wide learning initiatives, cross-functional exposure, and programme milestones that support your overall professional growth. 
 The programme consists of three developmental phases , each with clearly defined learning objectives, competency milestones, and performance reviews to ensure continuous growth throughout your journey. 
 Throughout the programme, you will receive guidance and coaching from experienced mentors and leaders who are committed to supporting your development and helping you succeed. If you are passionate about learning, enjoy solving complex challenges, and aspire to build a rewarding career in a dynamic multinational environment, we invite you to begin your journey with us. 
 About the Department The Target Market Management Department plays a strategic role in translating market opportunities into focused business growth for Sika India. The department is responsible for understanding target segments, identifying growth opportunities, developing market strategies, supporting product positioning, driving segment initiatives, and enabling stronger specification-led and project-led sales outcomes. As a Management Trainee in Target Market Management, you will gain exposure to market analysis, segment planning, product portfolio understanding, customer and influencer mapping, project opportunity tracking, and cross-functional collaboration with sales, specification, product management, technical services, marketing, and operations. This is an exciting function for trainees who want to build strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of how market insights are converted into business growth. 

 Key Responsibilities Programme Responsibilities As a Management Trainee, you will: Complete all learning milestones and development activities throughout the programme. Participate actively in training programmes, workshops, coaching sessions, and other learning opportunities. Learn and apply company policies, business processes, systems, and best practices. Support departmental operations and contribute to assigned projects and business initiatives. Conduct research, analyse information, and prepare reports, presentations, or recommendations where appropriate. Collaborate with colleagues across different functions to support business objectives. Demonstrate initiative, accountability, professionalism, and a continuous learning mindset. Build strong working relationships with mentors, managers, and stakeholders. Comply with company policies, procedures, and health, safety, quality, and compliance standards. Successfully complete programme assessments and performance reviews. Department-Specific Responsibilities As a Management Trainee in Target Market Management, you will support the department in market intelligence, target market development, product positioning, project opportunity analysis, and cross-functional business initiatives. Support preparation of target market plans, segment strategies, and business development initiatives. Conduct market research, competitor benchmarking, and analysis of trends, applications, and customer needs across priority segments. Assist in market sizing, opportunity mapping, and project pipeline analysis for selected target markets. Prepare dashboards, reports, presentations, and management review inputs related to target market performance and initiatives. Coordinate with sales, specification, product management, technical services, marketing, and operations to support segment growth actions. Support product positioning, value proposition development, launch support, and promotion of key solutions for selected applications. Participate in customer, consultant, applicator, contractor, and project-related engagements to understand market requirements and business opportunities. Track and analyze sales data, product performance, project leads, and conversion trends to support decision-making. Contribute to training content, internal communication, case studies, and knowledge-sharing material for target market initiatives. Support special projects, strategic initiatives, and other assignments given by the department mentor or manager. 

 Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering with Masters in Construction Management. Candidates with up to two (2) years of relevant working experience are encouraged to apply. Strong academic achievements and active involvement in extracurricular activities will be an added advantage. Good analytical and critical thinking skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint). Willingness to travel or undertake cross-functional assignments where required.

description:
POSITION TITLE : Accountant S2P Junior Accountant 
 LOCATION : BANGALORE

 
 
 COMPANY 
 
TE Connectivity Ltd. is a $12 billion global technology and manufacturing leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. For more than 75 years, our connectivity and sensor solutions, proven in the harshest environments, have enabled advancements in transportation, industrial applications, medical technology, energy, data communications, and the home. With 80,000 employees, including more than 7,500 engineers, working alongside customers in approximately 150 countries, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com 
 
 BU / FUNCTION DESCRIPTION 
 
In order to drive efficient back office operations, TE Connectivity will establish global shared service center located in Bangalore to support centralized processing of select finance functions including Source to Pay (S2P) processes. 
 
 ROLE OBJECTIVE 
 
This position will report to the Process Delivery Supervisor and be a member of S2P teams focused on Invoice Processing and discrepancy management. The key purpose of this role is to perform accounting and clerical duties related to the efficient processing of S2P transaction.

title: Manager - Internal Auditor (Corporate Role)
description:
Job description: 
 Larsen & Toubro Ltd, commonly known as L&T, is an Indian multinational conglomerate company, with business interests in engineering, construction, manufacturing, technology, information technology and financial services, headquartered in Mumbai. The company is counted among world's top five construction companies. 
 The L&T Group comprises of 93 subsidiaries, 5 associate companies, 27 joint ventures and 35 jointly held operations, operating across basic and heavy engineering, construction, realty, manufacturing of capital goods, information technology, and financial services. 
 Job Role: Internal Auditor 
 This role is based out of Chennai. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Audit Planning: Develop and implement risk-based internal audit plans for project operations. Identify key risks associated with project execution, including financial, operational, and compliance risks. Design audit scopes, objectives, and timelines for reviewing projects. 
 Internal Control Evaluation: Assess the effectiveness and efficiency of internal controls related to project activities, including procurement, budgeting, financial reporting, and resource allocation. Identify weaknesses in controls and recommend improvements. 
 Project Financial Audits: Review financial records of projects to ensure accuracy and compliance with accounting standards. Conduct audits of project budgets, funding, cost allocation, and expenditure. Monitor adherence to contractual obligations and project funding agreements. 
 Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure that project activities comply with relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies. Identify potential risks in project management processes and suggest strategies to mitigate them. Conduct audits related to regulatory compliance, contract management, and external reporting requirements. 
 Project Performance Audits: Evaluate the performance of projects, ensuring that objectives are being met within budget, timeline, and scope. Review the efficiency of project resource utilization (staff, equipment, etc.). Conduct post-implementation audits to assess the success and sustainability of projects. 
 Reporting and Recommendations: Prepare audit reports with findings, conclusions, and recommendations for management. Present audit results to project managers, senior leadership, and other stakeholders. Follow up on audit recommendations to ensure corrective actions are implemented. 
 Advisory and Improvement Initiatives: Provide consultative support to project teams to strengthen internal controls and enhance risk management strategies. Offer insights for process improvements and opportunities for cost-saving and efficiency in project management. 
 Coordination and Collaboration: Collaborate with project managers, finance teams, and other stakeholders to gather audit evidence and ensure transparency. Work closely with external auditors where necessary, providing required documentation and insights. 
 Documentation and Record-Keeping: Maintain thorough documentation of audit processes, findings, and follow-up actions. Ensure all audit work is conducted in accordance with established standards, guidelines, and best practices. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications: 
 Education: CA Compulsory 
 Experience: Proven experience (7-12 years) in internal auditing, preferably within project-driven environments (e.g., construction, IT, engineering). Familiarity with project management methodologies such as Agile, PRINCE2, or PMP is advantageous. 
 Technical Skills: Strong understanding of internal control frameworks, audit techniques, and risk management principles. Proficient in audit software and ERP systems. Strong knowledge of accounting standards (GAAP, IFRS) and regulatory requirements. 
 Work Environment: This position will require travel to project sites for on-site audits (2 weeks in a month). The auditor should be comfortable working in a dynamic project environment with multiple ongoing initiatives.

title: Business Finance Executive
description:
Job Title : Business Finance Executive 
 Job Summary 
We are seeking a commercially driven finance professional who can transform financial and operational data into meaningful business insights. This role is focused on management reporting, business analytics, profitability analysis, budgeting support, and performance monitoring rather than routine accounting or taxation.
The ideal candidate should be highly proficient in Excel, comfortable working with large datasets, and capable of preparing insightful MIS reports that enable management to make informed business decisions.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Management Information System (MIS) Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management. Develop dashboards to monitor key business and financial metrics. Automate recurring reports to improve efficiency and accuracy. Ensure timely dissemination of business performance reports. 
 Business Analytics Analyse sales trends across products, brands, territories, channels, and customer segments. Identify opportunities for improving revenue, margins, and operational efficiency. Perform profitability analysis at product, customer, channel, and business-unit levels. Track KPIs and highlight key business exceptions and trends. 
 Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Assist in annual budgeting and periodic forecasting. Conduct budget vs. actual variance analysis with detailed commentary. Monitor departmental spending against approved budgets. Prepare financial models to support strategic decision-making. 
 Commercial Finance Analyse pricing, discounts, promotional schemes, and contribution margins. Evaluate the financial impact of new business initiatives. Support management with investment and cost-benefit analysis. Prepare business cases for new projects. 
 Data & Process Improvement Build Excel-based analytical models and dashboards. Work closely with ERP, Sales, Operations, and Accounts teams to ensure data accuracy. Recommend automation opportunities to reduce manual reporting. Standardize reporting formats across the organization. 
 Cross-functional Coordination Liaise with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Accounts teams. Translate business requirements into actionable financial insights. Present analytical findings to senior management. 
 Candidate Profile: 
 Education B.Com / BBA / MBA (Finance) CA Inter / CMA Inter preferred but not mandatory. Experience 3 to 6 years in Business Finance, FP&A, MIS, Commercial Finance, or Financial Analysis. Experience in B2C, Retail, E-commerce, Healthcare, Pharma, FMCG, or Consumer Goods businesses preferred. 
 Technical Skills: Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Power Query, Power Pivot). Strong analytical and financial modelling skills. Experience with ERP systems. Power BI or Tableau experience would be a significant advantage. SQL knowledge is an added benefit. 
 Key Competencies: Strong analytical mindset. Commercial understanding of business operations. Ability to interpret numbers and explain business implications. Excellent presentation and communication skills. High attention to detail. Problem-solving and critical thinking. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. 
 Key Deliverables: Daily Sales MIS Gross Margin & Contribution Analysis Product-wise Profitability Report Customer-wise Profitability Report Budget vs Actual Analysis Sales Trend Analysis Working Capital Dashboard Inventory Ageing & Slow-moving Stock Analysis Branch/Region Performance Dashboard Cash Flow MIS Executive Dashboard for Leadership Monthly Business Review (MBR) presentations 
 Success Metrics (KPIs): Accuracy and timeliness of MIS reports. Actionable insights generated for business improvement. Reduction in manual reporting effort through automation. Quality of budget and forecast analysis. Improvement in reporting turnaround time. Effectiveness of dashboards and management presentations. 
 Ideal Candidate 
Someone who doesn't just report numbers but asks why the numbers changed . Should be curious, commercially aware, and able to convert raw data into recommendations that improve profitability, optimize costs, and support strategic decisions. The role serves as a finance business partner to leadership, enabling faster and better-informed decisions.

Key Skills: Financial Planning and Analysis,Budgeting and Forecasting,Business Finance,Management Information System,Corporate Finance,Financial Analytics,Cash Flow Analysis,Working Capital

title: Customer Success Manager in Digital Marketing Agency
description:
Customer Success Manager Digital Marketing Agency 
 Role Type: Full-Time
 Location: Remote 
 Salary Range: 8-11 LPA, depending on experience
 Department: Client Success / Account Management 
 **About the Role** 
 We are looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager to become the main point of contact for a portfolio of digital marketing clients. 
 You will be responsible for managing client relationships across SEO, Google Ads, website builds, and broader digital marketing campaigns . At any given time, you may be looking after approximately 1530 client accounts , depending on the size, complexity and service mix of the portfolio. 
 This role requires someone who is confident speaking with business owners, directors, managers and key decision makers . You must be able to explain campaign performance clearly, educate clients on digital marketing success, coordinate internal deliverables, and ensure each client feels informed, supported and professionally managed. 
 Experience working with Australian businesses, Australian agency clients or Australian digital marketing campaigns will be highly regarded. The ideal candidate will understand the expectations of Australian business owners and be comfortable communicating professionally with clients in the Australian market. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Act as the main day-to-day contact for a portfolio of client accounts. Manage client relationships across SEO, Google Ads, website builds and other digital marketing services. Look after approximately 15–30 accounts at any given time. Conduct dedicated monthly client sessions to review campaign results, explain progress and discuss next steps. Educate clients on digital marketing performance, realistic expectations, campaign strategy and growth opportunities. Review SEO reports, Google Ads reports, website project updates and campaign deliverables before communicating with clients. Coordinate with internal service delivery teams, including SEO specialists, Google Ads specialists, web designers, developers, copywriters and project coordinators. Ensure client requests, deliverables and campaign actions are clearly briefed to the relevant internal team members. Follow up on deadlines and make sure work is completed on time. Keep clients regularly updated on campaign progress, project milestones, outstanding items and next actions. Identify risks, concerns or client dissatisfaction early and escalate when required. Maintain strong client relationships and help improve client retention. Prepare meeting notes, action items and follow-up communication after client calls. Ensure all client communication is professional, accurate and timely. Support upsell and growth opportunities where appropriate by identifying additional services that may benefit the client. Maintain internal CRM/project management updates so the wider team has visibility over client status. Ensure client invoices are current and up to date. 
 Required Experience 
 Previous experience in a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, Client Success, Digital Account Manager or Client Relationship Manager role. Experience working in a digital marketing agency or managing digital marketing clients is strongly preferred. Experience working with Australian businesses, Australian agency clients or Australian digital marketing campaigns is highly preferred. Understanding of SEO, Google Ads, website builds and general digital marketing strategy. Ability to confidently communicate with business owners and key decision makers. Experience managing multiple accounts, priorities and deadlines at the same time. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Strong time management and project coordination skills. Ability to explain campaign results in a simple, clear and professional way. Ability to manage client expectations and keep clients informed throughout the campaign lifecycle. Comfortable working with internal delivery teams to coordinate tasks and outcomes. 
 Must-Have Skills 
 Client relationship management SEO understanding Phone and email skills Google Ads understanding Website project coordination Digital marketing reporting Australian client or Australian agency experience preferred Strong written English Confident and strong verbal communication Meeting management Time management Deadline management Internal team coordination Problem-solving and a can-do attitude Attention to detail and ability to work autonomously Ability to manage 15–30 client accounts Ability to deal with business owners and senior decision makers 
 Ideal Candidate 
 The ideal candidate is organised, confident, professional and highly client-focused. You are someone who is hungry to succeed, enjoy speaking and creating strong working relationships with clients, deal extremely well with pressure and fast-paced requests and have a can-do attitude with an eagerness to continually expand your skills. 
 You do not need to be the person physically doing every SEO task, Google Ads optimisation or website development task, but you must understand these services well enough to communicate clearly with clients, ask the right questions internally, follow up on delivery, and explain campaign performance. 
 You should be comfortable leading client meetings, presenting results, managing expectations and making sure clients always know what is happening with their campaigns. 
 You must also be proactive. We are looking for someone who does not wait for the client to chase updates, but instead keeps clients informed, follows up with the team, manages deadlines and makes sure accounts are being looked after properly. 
 The ideal person will also have experience working with Australian clients or Australian digital agencies , and understand the level of communication, professionalism and responsiveness expected when dealing with Australian business owners. 
 Monthly Client Management Expectations 
 For each client portfolio, you will be expected to: Maintain regular communication with clients. Schedule and conduct monthly campaign review sessions. Review campaign performance before each client meeting. Explain what has been completed, what results have been achieved and what is planned next. Renew marketing agreements as well as upgrade packages Cross-selling to expand marketing channels to reach business goals Coordinate required work with the delivery team. Track outstanding actions and deadlines. Ensure clients feel supported, informed and valued. Escalate risks before they become major issues. 
 Key Performance Indicators 
 Success in this role will be measured by: 
 Client retention Account growth and upsell opportunities Client satisfaction Timely client communication Monthly review meetings completed Accuracy and quality of client updates Internal task coordination Deadline follow-through Reduction in client complaints/escalations Quality of meeting notes and follow-up actions 
 Tools & Platforms 
 Experience with the following will be highly regarded: 
 Google Analytics 4 Google Search Console Google Ads Google Business Profile SEO reporting tools Project management systems such as Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp or similar CRM systems WordPress or website CMS platforms Google Workspace Reporting dashboards 
 Salary 
 The salary range for this role is 8–11 LPA , depending on experience, communication ability, digital marketing knowledge, account management experience and exposure to Australian clients or Australian agency environments. 
 Candidates with strong Australian agency experience, excellent English communication skills and proven ability to manage multiple client accounts independently will be considered at the higher end of the range. 
 How to Apply 
 Please submit your resume and include examples of: Client portfolios you have managed Types of digital marketing campaigns you have worked with Number of accounts you have managed at one time Experience with SEO, Google Ads or website projects Experience working with Australian clients or Australian agencies Examples of how you have improved client retention, communication or campaign outcomes

Key Skills: Communication Skills,Online Advertising,Time Management Skills,Campaign Planning,Campaign Management,Digital Campaigns,Campaign Strategy,Digital Marketing

title: Data Curation SME - Liquid tumors
description:
Part of the Oncology Clinical Team, working on building and developing Oncology Data dictionaries, liquid tumor pipeline from scratch and SOP creation by acting as an SME for the liquid tumor portfolio, along with secondary duties of Curation/Abstraction etc.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Curation Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Liquid Cancers to join our Oncology Clinical Team. This role will focus on the review of clinical data specifically related to hematologic malignancies (e.g., leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma), and contribution to the development of data dictionaries, SOPs, and AI training pipelines to support oncology trials. Abstraction and curation may also be required based on project requirements. 

Essential Job Functions:

Serve as the oncology data curation SME for various liquid tumor types.
Develop and maintain liquid tumor data libraries; coordinate with cross-functional teams to meet project-specific requirements - from a data curation/RWE perspective.
Contribute proactively to pipeline optimization for liquid tumors.
Apply critical thinking to identify, troubleshoot, and escalate issues during data pipeline operations.
Proactively contribute to streamlining processes specifically to the liquid tumor pipeline.
Ability and flexibility to render support to other projects when there is a team requirement.
Conduct additional duties as assigned, including review of selected medical records to assess eligibility for new project, performing second level reviews/QC review of medical records.
Screening of cases for relevant clinical trials across various projects and/or disease subtypes. 
Knowledge related to cancer trials is essential and required, including understanding their inclusion and exclusion criteria.
Respond promptly to queries issued by the Lead Data Abstractor, Operations Manager or other project personnel.
Access electronic data systems for review of medical records and enter specific data into congruent electronic data systems.
Ability to understand the Inclusion, Exclusion criteria, adverse event, hospitalization data, medications details and categorize the data accordingly.
Review project specific documents, as needed, to develop familiarity with project goals and with the Abstractor tasks in each project.
Ability to understand the diagnostic, pathology and other reports and obtain the exact information required according to trial specific SOPs.
Use other resources as needed to gain the knowledge required to perform Abstractor work on new projects.
Share medical knowledge and project-specific procedural knowledge with other Data Abstractors as needed.

Qualification:

Minimum 4-5 years experience across data abstraction/curation, with a strong focus on liquid tumors and/or expertise is essential - Previous experience in a data curation SME role is desirable.
In depth knowledge across the liquid tumor domain with a solid understanding of foundational liquid tumor concepts is also essential. 
Oncology experience is preferable; familiarity with how cancer is treated from diagnosis through treatment and recovery and an understanding of cancer terminology is essential.
Experience in clinical research or related fields, especially in oncology trials is preferred.
An advanced level of clinical knowledge associated with chronic disease states is required.
Experience in clinical research or reviewed medical data for clinical trials.
Certification done in clinical research or clinical data management.

Education: 

B.Sc (Nursing), BDS, BAMS, BHMS, MDS, BPharm, MPharm 

Skills and Abilities:

Flexibility: Flexibility in coping with changing work assignments, changing project requirements, varying training meeting schedules, and database resources that may not always function optimally.
Innovation and Proactiveness: Should be able to foresee the probable functionalities and/or think out of the box as complex problems may sometimes require innovative solutions.
Language: Strong communication skills both written and verbal to work with multiple internal and external clients in a fast paced environment.
Reasoning: Ability to make independent judgments in abstracting medical data and the knowledge of when to seek input from other staff.
Computer: Ability to create and maintain documents using Microsoft office( word, excel, outlook and powerpoint)

Why Join US ?

We are revolutionizing a unique industry that has the potential to impact and benefit patients from all over the world - you can create impact at scale.
We have had company - sponsored workations in Bali, Sri Lanka, and Manali and take pride in our hard-working yet super fun culture .
We are working on a few of the most challenging problems in a highly regulated industry which provides you an opportunity to solve some of the most interesting things.
You will get a chance to work with experts from multiple industries and the best in the industry compensation.

title: Operation Manager - PG & Serviced Apartments
description:
FARGO HOMES is looking for a responsible, proactive and hands-on Operations Manager to manage the day-to-day operations of our PG/hostel and serviced-apartment properties. The role will involve overseeing approximately 250 PG/hostel beds , along with serviced apartments, residents, guests, staff, vendors and property maintenance. 
 This is a field-oriented, hands-on operations role . The ideal candidate should be comfortable visiting properties, interacting with residents and guests, coordinating staff and vendors, inspecting properties and personally following up until operational issues are resolved. 
 The Operations Manager will report directly to the Owner/Management and will act as the primary day-to-day operational point of contact for the business. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. PG / Hostel Operations Manage day-to-day operations of approximately 250 PG/hostel beds. Monitor occupancy, vacancies, admissions, renewals and move-outs. Coordinate resident onboarding and check-out processes. Coordinate Leave & Licence agreements, KYC/documentation and police verification. Maintain accurate and updated resident records. Handle resident queries, complaints and routine operational issues. Conduct regular property inspections. Ensure cleanliness, hygiene and overall property upkeep. Coordinate housekeeping, repairs and maintenance activities. Monitor staff attendance, punctuality and performance. Ensure residents and employees follow company rules and operating procedures. 2. Serviced Apartment Operations Manage daily operations of serviced apartments. Coordinate guest check-ins and check-outs. Ensure rooms/properties are guest-ready before every arrival. Coordinate housekeeping, maintenance and linen requirements. Handle routine guest queries and complaints. Communicate with guests through telephone, WhatsApp and other channels. Monitor guest feedback and ensure timely follow-up. Maintain required standards of cleanliness, presentation and service. 3. Reservations & Enquiry Coordination Monitor PG and serviced-apartment enquiries received through various channels. Ensure timely responses to telephone, WhatsApp and online enquiries. Coordinate with the reservations/customer-service team. Follow up with prospective residents and guests. Monitor enquiry-to-booking/admission conversions. Maintain an updated enquiry and follow-up database. Escalate pricing and other commercial decisions to management when required. 4. Staff Management Allocate daily responsibilities to operational staff. Monitor attendance, punctuality and performance. Ensure assigned tasks are completed on time. Train and guide employees whenever required. Prepare staff duty schedules. Address routine performance and discipline issues. Maintain professional conduct and accountability within the team. 5. Vendor & Maintenance Management Coordinate with plumbers, electricians, carpenters, AC technicians, pest-control agencies, housekeeping vendors and other service providers. Obtain quotations where required. Assign and track maintenance requests. Verify completion and quality of work before closing maintenance requests. Maintain records of pending and completed maintenance. Monitor recurring maintenance problems and identify corrective action. Escalate major repairs/expenditure to management for approval. Ensure vendors submit proper bills/invoices. 6. Rent & Collection Coordination Monitor PG rent due dates. Follow up on outstanding payments. Maintain an updated rent-outstanding report. Coordinate with the Accounts/Admin team. Escalate persistent payment defaults to management. Ensure move-in and move-out financial formalities are completed. The Operations Manager will coordinate collections and follow-ups but will not independently waive, reduce or settle financial dues without management approval. 
 7. Property Quality Control Conduct regular inspections covering: Cleanliness and hygiene Bedrooms and bathrooms Furniture and fixtures Electrical equipment Air conditioners Plumbing and water supply Wi-Fi Kitchen and common areas Safety equipment Overall property condition All deficiencies should be documented, assigned to the responsible person/vendor and followed up until closure. 
 8. Daily Operations Reporting Submit a concise daily operational report covering: Total occupancy Vacant beds New enquiries Property visits Admissions Move-outs Rent outstanding Maintenance complaints Maintenance completed Serviced-apartment bookings Guest complaints Staff attendance Important issues requiring management attention 9. Management Escalation The Operations Manager is expected to independently resolve routine operational matters within company policies and approved limits. The following should be escalated promptly to management: Major resident or guest disputes Significant financial claims Legal notices or disputes Major repairs or expenditure Unusual refunds or compensation requests Security incidents Police matters Vendor disputes Serious employee misconduct Major property damage Authority & Accountability The Operations Manager will be responsible for the smooth functioning of day-to-day operations across the properties. The position will have authority to: Coordinate employees and vendors. Allocate operational responsibilities. Resolve routine resident/guest issues. Follow up on maintenance and service requests. Take routine operational decisions within company policies and approved expenditure limits. The Operations Manager will report directly to the Owner/Management . The key objective of this role is to reduce the management's involvement in routine operational matters and ensure that issues are resolved at the appropriate level without unnecessary escalation. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Performance will be evaluated based on: Smooth day-to-day functioning of all properties. Timely resolution of resident and guest complaints. Property cleanliness, upkeep and maintenance standards. Staff attendance, discipline and productivity. Timely completion of maintenance work. Reduction in recurring operational complaints. Accuracy of occupancy and resident records. Timely rent follow-up and reporting. Response time to operational issues. Accuracy and timeliness of daily/weekly reports. Resident and guest satisfaction. Ability to independently resolve routine issues without unnecessary management escalation. Desired Profile: We are looking for someone who is: Responsible and honest. Proactive and well organised. Calm under pressure. Solution-oriented. Punctual and dependable. Comfortable taking ownership. Professional in communication. Capable of making sensible decisions independently. Comfortable managing multiple properties and priorities. Willing to work in a hands-on, field-oriented environment. Required Qualifications & Experience: Graduate in any discipline, BHM is highly Preferred. 3+ years of relevant experience in PG, hostel, co-living, serviced apartments, hotels, property management or related operations. Experience managing residential/guest properties and operational teams will be preferred. Key Skills: Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good spoken and written English. Hindi is essential. Marathi will be an advantage. Good knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets . Comfortable using WhatsApp, email and smartphone applications. Strong organisational and follow-up skills. Ability to manage multiple properties, staff and tasks. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Staff and vendor management. Customer-service orientation. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Mature and responsible approach to handling residents, guests and confidential business information. Important Requirement: 
 This is a hands-on Operations Manager position. We are not looking for someone who only sits in the office and delegates work . The successful candidate should be comfortable: Visiting properties regularly. Speaking directly with residents and guests. Inspecting rooms and common areas. Checking cleanliness and maintenance. Coordinating staff and vendors. Following up personally on pending issues. Taking ownership until problems are resolved. The successful candidate will effectively function as the day-to-day operational point of contact for the business , enabling the owners to focus on business development, finance, marketing, strategy and expansion.

description:
About The Role  
Skill required: Financial Planning Analysis - Financial Planning and Analysis (FPA)

 
Designation: Delivery Lead Manager

 
Qualifications: Any Graduation 

 
Years of Experience: 13 to 18 years 

 Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song” all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. 

 
What would you do
 The primary responsibility of the role is to proactively manage the delivery of Group Management and Statutory Reporting information in line with the agreed service level agreements by acting as a PL owner. Group Management information will include financial information and scenarios required for SOP meetings, H1 and FY targets. This will include challenging assumptions and coordination data inputs in all internal reporting systems, running the forecasting process activities, preparation and generation of financial information accurately and performing quality review with key finance senior stakeholders prior to releasing to the customer for approval. Drive independent analysis and provide insightful recommendations to the senior stakeholders.The objective of this role is to enable the Area Finance team to meet their business objectives by consolidating area financials, tracking actuals delivery vs budgets, providing key insights for Finance leadership team, as well as managing monthly dashboards and providing executive summary for Finance leadership team along with insights on key drivers.This role will partner senior stakeholders across various functional teams (Marketing Directors, Commercial Directors, Heads of Finance, Supply Chain Directors, etc) to provide strategic financial guidance on key financial performance in the market. Specific responsibilities include, but not limited to, overseeing financial forecasts, industry value projections, regulatory impacts to the category, price war analysis, etc.The ideal candidate will proactively and collaboratively work across the organization to develop a competitor framework that can effectively be used as a platform to provide insights revenue and resource allocation and drive recommendations on potential course of action. This position requires an excellent knowledge of financials, strategic thinking, analytical expertise, and leadership skills. information.

 
What are we looking for
 
Qualifications:CAs CFAs 8–12 years of progressive finance experience Proven track record in budgeting, forecasting, and strategic financial analysis. Experience in global FMCG / CPG / Tobacco industries or similar dynamic environments is an advantage. Demonstrated ability to manage teams, influence senior stakeholders, and drive process improvements. Advanced Excel (macros, pivot tables, etc.), ERP systems (SAP), FPA tools, BI dashboards, Alteryx, Agentic AI, Lean Six Sigma, Tableau Knowledge of FPA tools (SAP BPC, Hyperion, Anaplan,) In-depth knowledge of PL, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow management. Strong ability to convey financial information clearly to senior leadership. Excellent analytical skills and ability to handle large volumes of data accurately. Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills; able to work across all levels and functions. Ability to work under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and adapt to rapidly changing conditions. Ability to proactively identify risk, perform sensitivity analysis and drive risk mitigation Detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of rational decision-making and problem-solving. 

 

Roles and Responsibilities: Own / Lead the preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts, ensuring accuracy and alignment with business objectives. Conduct variance analysis on actual vs. budget/forecast, identify key drivers to the variances, analyze trends, risks, and opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations. Develop financial models for scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and long-range forecasting to support strategic initiatives. Deliver timely and accurate financial reports and dashboards, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to influence decision-making, optimize costs, and ensure resource allocation aligns with strategic priorities. Drive efficiency through automation and implement best practices for FPA processes, reporting, and data accuracy. Ensure adherence to financial policies, internal controls, and regulatory requirements across all FPA activities. Manage and mentor FPA analysts, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and high performance. Act as a vital member of the Consumer Leadership team in GBS, focusing on the Commercial Finance experience Support the Consumer Delivery Lead in creating value across product categories Present forecasts, performance, and potential risks/opportunities across all product lines including new categories and prepare strategies for senior stakeholders, considering competitor actions Perform financial modelling, sensitivity, and scenario analysis to accurately reflect the impact of proposed changes on the operating results of the business and to support informed business decisions. Evaluate the financial impact of regulatory change Lead and coordinate efforts for process improvement and efficiency within the commercial finance team, providing timely insights Undertake ad-hoc projects as needed Contribute to developing integrated business strategies for portfolio, pricing, excise, and trade, considering all elements of the mix Conduct competitor reviews and share key insights with Top Management, incorporating them into pricing and excise discussions Establish governance and risk guidelines for pricing and excise activities to ensure strong controls and SOx compliance (where applicable) Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

 Qualification Any Graduation

title: Fleet Manager / Fleet In- Charge
description:
Fleet Manager / Fleet In-Charge Company: Vishal Tour & Travels (VTT) Location: Faridabad, Delhi NCR Job Type: Full-time Experience: 3 + years in commercial vehicle / fleet management Salary: 25,000 – 35,000 per month, depending on experience and capability About Vishal Tour & Travels Vishal Tour & Travels (VTT) is a leading B2B transportation company based in Faridabad, Delhi NCR, serving the travel industry since 1986. VTT currently operates a 30-vehicle premium passenger transport fleet, comprising Force Urbania, luxury mini coaches, premium travellers and 22 large AC coaches. Our fleet is predominantly made up of recent BS6 vehicles, with the oldest active vehicle being a 2022 model. With further fleet expansion planned during January–March 2027, we are looking for an experienced Fleet Manager / Fleet In-Charge to take complete ownership of the maintenance, mechanical condition and readiness of our fleet. Role Objective The Fleet Manager will be responsible for ensuring that every VTT vehicle is: Safe • Reliable • Well Maintained • Mechanically Fit • Trip Ready The person will take ownership of preventive maintenance, servicing, repairs, breakdown management, workshop coordination and overall vehicle condition. Key Responsibilities 1. Fleet Maintenance & Preventive Maintenance * Take day-to-day responsibility for the mechanical health of the complete fleet. * Conduct regular vehicle inspections. * Prepare and maintain vehicle-wise preventive maintenance schedules. * Monitor servicing, oils, filters, brakes, suspension, tyres, batteries, AC systems, electrical systems and other mechanical requirements. * Identify potential problems before they result in breakdowns. * Ensure vehicles are properly checked before being released for trips. * Maintain vehicle-wise maintenance and service history. 2. Vehicle Readiness & Availability * Maintain a daily status of vehicles that are: * Available * On trip * Under maintenance * Scheduled for service * Temporarily unavailable * Coordinate maintenance schedules with the Operations team so that planned bookings are not affected. * Ensure vehicles are returned to service only after necessary repairs/checks are completed. 3. Breakdown Management * Take ownership of vehicle breakdowns and mechanical emergencies. * Coordinate with drivers, mechanics and workshops for immediate resolution. * Arrange appropriate technical assistance during outstation breakdowns. * Coordinate with Operations if a replacement vehicle is required. * Maintain a record of breakdowns and identify recurring problems. 4. Workshop & Vendor Management * Coordinate with authorised/approved workshops, mechanics and service centres. * Obtain and verify repair estimates. * Monitor the quality and necessity of repairs. * Verify spare-parts requirements and replacement recommendations. * Monitor labour and repair costs. * Ensure unnecessary repairs and expenditure are avoided. * Develop reliable workshop/vendor relationships. 5. Driver & Ground-Team Coordination * Take maintenance-related complaints from drivers seriously and ensure timely action. * Inspect vehicles based on driver feedback. * Ensure drivers report mechanical problems immediately. * Coordinate with mechanics/helpers for maintenance-related work. * Ensure VTT’s premium vehicle condition and presentation standards are maintained. 6. Spare Parts & Inventory * Monitor critical spare parts and consumables. * Coordinate procurement of required parts. * Maintain records of parts purchased and used. * Ensure proper control over inventory and avoid unnecessary purchases. 7. Maintenance Cost Control * Monitor vehicle-wise maintenance expenditure. * Identify vehicles with unusually high repair costs. * Compare workshop estimates where appropriate. * Ensure preventive maintenance is prioritised over expensive breakdown repairs. * Maintain proper records of major repairs and replacements. 8. Fleet Reporting The Fleet Manager will maintain regular reports covering: * Vehicle availability * Service due / service completed * Vehicles under repair * Breakdown history * Pending maintenance * Tyre and battery requirements * Major repairs * Workshop expenses * Vehicle downtime * Recurring mechanical issues Candidate Requirements We are looking for an experienced, hands-on fleet professional, preferably from the commercial passenger transportation industry. Preferred Experience Candidates with experience handling: * Tourist buses / coaches * Force Traveller / Urbania * Ashok Leyland buses * Luxury travellers * Mini coaches * Employee transportation fleets * School/college transportation * Travel & tourism fleets * Commercial passenger vehicle fleets will be preferred. Candidates currently working as or having experience as: Fleet Manager / Fleet In-Charge / Fleet Supervisor / Transport Supervisor / Vehicle Maintenance Supervisor / Workshop Supervisor / Transport Manager are encouraged to apply. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate should: * Have practical knowledge of commercial vehicle maintenance. * Understand preventive maintenance rather than only breakdown repair. * Be comfortable dealing with mechanics, drivers and workshops. * Be capable of handling breakdown situations under pressure. * Have good knowledge of tyres, batteries, servicing and common mechanical issues. * Be disciplined with maintenance records and follow-ups. * Have a strong sense of ownership and accountability. * Be capable of working independently without constant supervision. * Preferably have experience handling a fleet of approximately 20–50+ commercial vehicles. Important This is a hands-on fleet management position. We are not looking for a candidate whose experience is limited to office administration or basic vehicle coordination. The selected candidate will be expected to take ownership of the physical condition, maintenance and readiness of VTT’s fleet and proactively identify issues before they become operational problems. Candidates who require extensive training in basic fleet management are not suitable for this position. Reporting & Coordination The Fleet Manager will work closely with the Operations Manager for vehicle availability and deployment requirements. Operations will handle vehicle documentation, deployment, driver allocation and trip operations. The Fleet Manager will primarily own: Vehicle Maintenance + Mechanical Health + Preventive Maintenance + Workshop Management + Breakdown Management + Fleet Readiness Location Vishal Tour & Travels Shop No. 114, Tikona Park, Faridabad, Delhi NCR Candidates based in Faridabad / Delhi NCR will be preferred. Salary 25,000 – 35,000 per month Final compensation will depend on relevant experience, fleet-handling capability and overall suitability for the role. Candidates are requested to mention in their application: 1. Total years of fleet/transport experience 2. Number of vehicles previously handled 3. Types of vehicles handled 4. Previous designation 5. Current/last salary 6. Expected salary 7. Notice period 8. Current location

Key Skills: Vehicle Management,Fleet Operations,Fleet Management,Transport Management System,Vehicle Quality,Vehicle Maintenance,Breakdown Maintenance,Preventive Maintenance
